It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Number of Openings: 1
Hiring Priority: Active Hiring


The DCX Client Services - Home-Based E-Commerce Associate will be the tactical expert who supports the day-to-day operations of the client's online business while also having hands-on expertise with e-commerce and marketing automation platforms. You will manage and monitor the brands on the e-commerce platform and collaborate with external partners.

REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES


  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with meticulous attention to detail
  • A highly proficient communicator in both spoken and written English
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Superior project follow-through ensuring timely completion
  • Familiarity with web-based applications

WHAT YOU WILL DO


  • Build web stores with functionality that supports the client’s needs.
  • Keep web stores updated with pricing, product maintenance, and graphics, and understand how each store types of invoices to the customers.
  • Oversee and update existing customer e-commerce sites based on input from an online ticketing request system.
  • Review landing pages, product details, checkout processes, and all other vital e-commerce website elements for visual appeal, accuracy, and user-friendliness.
  • Collaborate with integrated partners to coordinate the integration and testing of templates and products on external systems.
  • Manage project timelines for e-commerce site builds and adhere to service-level agreements for site maintenance requests.
  • Coordinate the production of orders and ensure timely communication with suppliers about orders using an e-commerce platform.
  • Provide administrative and project support for a variety of e-commerce projects.
  • Ad hoc tasks aligned with those mentioned above.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR


  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, and Business Administration, or any related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years in a customer service or order management role.
  • Language Proficiency: Strong verbal, written, and English communication skills.
  • Working schedule: Ability to work overnight/graveyard shifts in Philippine time or within US operating hours.
  • Technical Skills: Proficient in both Microsoft and Google applications. Basic exposure to Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Canva is ideal.
  • Industry Specific Software/Knowledge:
  • Direct experience in the promotional industry or comparable e-commerce experience is beneficial.
  • Previous store-building experience with Shopify or other platforms is a plus, but not necessary.
  • Knowledge of various e-commerce platforms is a great advantage.
  • Various promotional industry-specific software (i.e., Shopify, Bigcommerce, Sage, ESP, CommonSku, Syncore)

WHAT WE OFFER


  • Salary Range: PHP 45,000 - 48,000
  • Industry: Promotional Products
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Work Shift: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST (USA)
  • Workdays: Monday through Friday (USA)
  • Work Setup: #DCXWorkFromHome

BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US


  • Industry-leading salary packages
  • Permanent work-from-home setup
  • Company equipment provided
  • Government Mandated Benefits Employer Share
  • Internet stipends upon regularization
  • HMO Coverage upon regularization (with an option to enroll as early as Day 1)
  • PTO credits and service incentive leaves
  • Major spring and winter company live events
  • Monthly employee appreciation virtual events
  • Company-provided career skills training courses
  • A company culture focused on your personal and professional growth

WHO WE ARE


DCX stands out as a leading BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) company that takes pride in assisting growth-focused small and medium-sized businesses across the United States to discover the perfect global talent to enhance their teams.


At DCX, our core beliefs center around fostering growth and making hiring easy. We are dedicated to helping business owners, executives, and industry leaders, primarily within the promotional products industry, in their search for superstar team members.


If you are on the lookout for a company that values growth and places a strong emphasis on its people-centered culture, then DCX is the place for you. As we say around here, LET'S GROW!

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

raw.description:
Description

Are you a bilingual English/Spanish customer service professional with strong communication skills and experience supporting customers by phone?

We are hiring Customer Service Representatives to work from home in Mexico for a growing healthcare-related customer service program.

This is an excellent opportunity for experienced contact center professionals who are comfortable handling inbound calls, answering member questions, working toward performance goals, and delivering a professional, empathetic customer experience.

What You'll Do

As a Customer Service Representative, you will provide prompt, courteous support to health plan members and representatives while assisting with questions related to transportation services and other member support programs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Answering inbound calls from health plan members and representatives
  • Listening carefully to understand customer needs and responding professionally
  • Providing accurate information and assistance regarding available transportation services
  • Handling customer questions and concerns with patience, empathy, and professionalism
  • Entering and maintaining accurate customer information and data
  • Meeting established performance and quality expectations
  • Following all HIPAA and compliance requirements when handling protected health information (PHI)
  • Escalating transportation or customer service concerns to the appropriate leadership team
  • Participating fully in required training and coaching
  • Completing all required compliance and training courses
  • Maintaining professional conduct and appearance during training and ongoing coaching
  • Participating on camera during required training and meeting sessions

Compensation & Work Arrangement

  • $5.50 USD per hour
  • Paid weekly in arrears
  • Independent Contractor position
  • Fully Remote; Work From Home in Mexico

Schedule & Training

Training Schedule:

  • Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-4:30 PM EST

Production Schedule:

  • Potential shifts scheduled between 8:00 AM-6:00 PM EST

Candidates must be able to commit to their scheduled hours and meet attendance and punctuality expectations.

﻿

Technical Requirements (Essential)

To be considered, candidates must meet all technical requirements below:

  • Windows 11 PC (Mac not supported)
  • 16 GB RAM
  • Dual monitors
  • Webcam and Wired USB Headset
  • i5 processor or higher
  • Fibre internet with a wired connection (Ethernet cable)
  • Backup power solution
  • Microsoft Teams / Office 365

Applications that do not meet the minimum technical requirements may not move forward in the process.

﻿Hiring Process

To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process.

Our process includes:

  1. Resume Review
  2. Pre-Screen Questionnaire
  3. Short One-Way Video Interview
  4. Pre-Screen interview
  5. Background Check

Please Note

  • All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position.
  • As part of the selection process, candidates may be required to complete a cultural fit assessment.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is a fluent English/Spanish bilingual customer service professional who communicates clearly, stays calm under pressure, and consistently delivers a positive customer experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 6 months of inbound contact center experience OR transferable healthcare experience
  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong data-entry skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced call environment
  • Comfortable handling difficult or emotional customer situations
  • Professional and courteous communication style
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing demands
  • Moderate experience with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Word
  • Must maintain a professional appearance and demeanor
  • Must be available to be on camera during training and required meetings
  • Must meet attendance and punctuality expectations
  • Must have a download speed of approximately 80-100 Mbps
  • Must have an upload speed of approximately 12-20 Mbps
  • Must have a quiet, distraction-free workspace during scheduled working hours
  • Must have no conflicting responsibilities that would interfere with scheduled work hours
  • Must provide their own equipment to perform the job

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Customer Service - Handles difficult or emotional customer situations with patience and professionalism; responds promptly to customer needs; provides helpful and accurate assistance; follows through on commitments; and consistently works to deliver a positive customer experience.
  • Professionalism - Communicates respectfully and tactfully with customers, colleagues, and leadership; remains calm and professional under pressure; takes responsibility for their actions; follows established procedures; and follows through on commitments.
  • Adaptability - Adapts effectively to changes in the work environment and customer needs; manages competing demands and priorities; adjusts their approach when situations change; and remains flexible when handling unexpected events, delays, or challenges.

raw.description:
Writer/Director, Veritasium

An opportunity to join an exciting, well-funded and fast-growing creator economy business.

Electrify is a dynamic new digital media company that invests in and scales creators with an established YouTube presence. We have invested in various leading channels and Veritasium is one of the leading channels in our portfolio.

Veritasium is a world-leading physics and science education YouTube channel, with content spanning more than a decade and amassing more than 4.5 billion lifetime views. We create videos for a curious, engaged audience that never stops asking the big questions, combining rigorous research with high-quality, visually captivating production.

Our mission is ‘to reveal the truth and to inspire wonder so people can live more meaningful lives in alignment with the way the world really is’ and we need great writer/directors to help us realise that ambition.

Come and build the future of media with us!

About the role

We are looking for a Writer/Director to join our remote digital team. We’re looking for someone who’s passionate about Physics, Maths, and Engineering. And has a great general understanding of science. The ideal person is highly proactive, has great attention to detail, and wants to be the very best at what they do.

You will be responsible for taking an initial idea all the way through to the deeply researched fascinating video our audience expects. Research, writing scripts, and directing the video edit. You’re essentially the leader of your video – and making the best possible video is your main responsibility.

Note: All new writer/directors will start their time with us with a stint in the research team. We have found that this gives new editorial hires the best grounding in our working standards and sets them up for success in the long term.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make the best possible video!

  • Deliver videos in a timely manner and lead your team.

  • Research various topics related to Physics, Maths, Engineering, and more, and propose video ideas.

  • Source experts in the field to interview or collaborate with, either on-site or virtually.

  • Focus on accuracy and engaging storytelling, going extremely deep in research to trace stories back to scientific papers and original sources.

  • Stay up to date on new research, scientific discoveries and advancements in the field and incorporate them into video scripts.

  • Conceive and communicate the vision for your video.

  • Be a team player. Brief animators and video editors, and work side by side with researchers while receiving and actioning feedback from editorial leadership.

Skills and experience

  • A (minimum of a) bachelor's degree or higher in Physics, Maths, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Excellent research, reading comprehension, and fact-checking skills.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.

  • A passion for and knowledge of science YouTube content.

  • Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work well under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality content that meets Veritasium's standards.

  • Passionate about educating and inspiring others about Physics and science in general.

Desirable

  • Proven experience in long-form or feature science communication.

Electrify Culture

  • Dynamic environment - We are dedicated to providing a world-class creative culture where our employees can thrive. We’re looking for self-starters with an entrepreneurial mindset who want to be part of our success story. You’ll discover new opportunities, take ownership of important initiatives and learn at a fast pace.

  • Work anywhere - We are a remote team with employees around the world. This means you are free to work from anywhere with a good internet connection.

  • Our Values – We are committed to fostering a culture that values innovative, diverse ways of thinking and the ability to drive positive change. DEI is in our DNA, and our DEI Committee and Social Hub initiatives reflect this commitment.

  • Force for good -We believe in unlocking the power of Electrify to tell stories that change lives. Digital media has the opportunity to propagate inspiring ideas and knowledge that can generate extraordinary change.Electrify Impactprovides initiatives and resources to support emerging creators and positive impact organisations amplify their voice. In support ofthe United Nations 17 sustainable development goals (SDGs), we actively encourage support on our mission to make the world a better place for all.

What we offer

  • Work from anywhere with an allowance for tech

  • Flexible hours

  • Employee referral program

  • The opportunity to work in a fast-paced, vibrant, dynamic, and innovative environment where you can learn and grow quickly

  • A supportive, inclusive and collaborative team

Salary range: £50,000-70,000 (depending on experience. This will be converted into the currency of where you are based).

Electrify is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

This position serves as a working supervisor with oversight and management of all call center associates and functions as they relate to maintaining quality of HealthPort services and continued profitability of the company. This position trains customer service associates and develops and implements policies and procedures to ensure customer satisfaction.

You will:

  • Plan, prepare, and devise work schedules, according to budget, call volume and production needs.
  • Assess all aspects of the current customer service model for potential opportunities for service efficiencies and quality enhancements.
  • Assist with appraising performance, addressing complaints and resolving problems
  • Ensures each associate in call center has the skills and knowledge necessary to provide excellent consumer service.
  • Manage difficult customer situations and solicit customer feedback for process improvement.
  • Track incoming and outgoing calls in order to provide data to upper management, allowing for implementation of necessary changes.
  • Develop short and long term strategies to improve morale.
  • Monitor individual and department results to address potential productivity and customer concerns.
  • Assist with development and implementation of other programs that benefit the organization and its customers.
  • Communicate with management regarding creative concepts and objectives, which may benefit the company.

What you will bring to the table:

  • Must have at least 2 years supervisory or management experience in a call center or customer oriented environment, preferably with a mid to large customer service team.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite or similar tools
  • Proven organizational skills
  • Effective verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to work with others and be extremely team oriented
  • Ability to sustain continuous pressure, withstand conflicting requirements
  • Proficient time management, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Must be able to work effectively in a fast paced environment
  • Ability to work professionally, effectively, and efficiently in a team environment with customers, management and co-workers.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience OR an Associate's degree and 4 years supervisory or management experience in a call center or customer oriented environment

Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Software Engineer codes software applications based on business requirements. The Lead Software Engineer works on problems of diverse scope and complexity ranging from moderate to substantial.

The Lead Software Engineer standardizes the quality assurance procedure for software. Oversee testing and debugging and develops fixes. Research complaints and make necessary adjustments and/or recommendations to resolve complex software related issues. Advise executives to develop functional strategies (often segment specific) on matters of significance. Exercise independent judgment and decision making on complex issues regarding job responsibilities and related tasks, and works under minimal supervision, Uses independent judgment requiring analysis of variable factors and determining the best course of action.


Use your skills to make an impact

Key Responsibilities

  • MVP and Product Ownership: Own AI products from initial concept through MVP, pilot, and production readiness. Define the product and technical approach, make pragmatic scope decisions, and take direct responsibility for delivering solutions that create measurable value for clinicians, members, and internal teams.
  • Rapid Prototyping and Iteration: Build and launch proofs of concept and working MVPs quickly. Use feedback, experimentation, and real-world usage data to validate assumptions, refine requirements, and continuously improve product capabilities.
  • Clinical and Product Partnership: Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, clinicians, and data stakeholders to understand care delivery workflows and translate them into well-scoped, AI features.
  • Technical Decision-Making and Delivery: Make and clearly communicate foundational architecture and technology decisions while balancing speed, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk. Establish lightweight engineering practices that enable rapid delivery without compromising quality.
  • HIPAA Compliance and Responsible AI: Ensure all AI systems are designed, deployed, and monitored in compliance with HIPAA and Humana's Responsible AI standards, including participation in AIRB and Responsible AI Council review processes where applicable.

Required Qualifications

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience
  • Deep, hands-on experience building with large language models and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent)
  • Strong proficiency in Python, Typescript and modern ML tooling (Hugging Face, PyTorch, or similar)
  • Proven experience designing and deploying RAG pipelines and vector search systems in production
  • Working knowledge of model fine-tuning approaches (LoRA, RLHF, instruction tuning, or equivalent)
  • Experience designing and building multi-agent AI systems, including agent orchestration, tool use, and sandboxed execution environments
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex AI systems end-to-end, from architecture through production operation
  • Understanding of HIPAA requirements and secure handling of protected health information (PHI)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and LLM coding harnesses (Claude Code, Pi Agent, Cursor, Codex, or similar)
  • Experience collaborating with Product Management to shape product direction, gather requirements, and lead the design and development of scalable, customer-focused applications.
  • Experience rapidly building prototypes using agent coding harnesses (claude code, codex, etc)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, clinical informatics, or other highly regulated industries
  • Experience designing and implementing custom LLM and agent evaluation frameworks, including automated eval pipelines, benchmark construction, and output quality assessment at scale
  • Exposure to clinical NLP, medical coding, or EHR/FHIR data standards
  • Experience operating AI systems at scale on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

raw.description:
Position: Zuora Systems Analyst – Revenue Recognition
Location: 100% Remote | USA / Nearshore LATAM
Working Hours: U.S. Pacific Time (Mandatory – No Exceptions)
Employment Type: Contract
Contract Duration: Initial 6 months, with potential extension through August 2027
Schedule: Full-Time | 8 Hours per Day
Start Date: ASAP

Position Overview

Our client is seeking an experienced Zuora Systems Analyst – Revenue Recognition to support a critical enterprise financial systems implementation and integration project.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Zuora Revenue, Zuora Billing, Workday, and revenue recognition processes, combined with technical expertise in system configuration, data integration, financial reporting, and troubleshooting.

This position requires a professional who can bridge the gap between Finance, Accounting, and IT teams, translating complex business requirements into effective technical solutions.

The selected candidate will play a key role in configuring revenue recognition rules, supporting financial system integrations, resolving data discrepancies, and ensuring accurate revenue reporting in compliance with applicable accounting standards.

This is a fully remote opportunity requiring full availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours, without exceptions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Zuora Revenue Configuration & Revenue Recognition

  • Configure and maintain revenue recognition rules within Zuora Revenue.
  • Support revenue recognition processes in accordance with ASC 606 and applicable accounting requirements.
  • Configure revenue schedules, allocation rules, and recognition methodologies.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot revenue recognition issues and system discrepancies.
  • Ensure accurate processing of revenue transactions and financial information.

2. Systems Integration & Data Management

  • Support integrations between Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, Workday, and related enterprise financial systems.
  • Monitor data flows across billing, revenue management, and accounting platforms.
  • Identify and resolve integration errors, missing transactions, and data inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to improve system performance and data accuracy.
  • Assist with system configuration, validation, and implementation activities.

3. Financial Close & Operational Support

  • Support month-end financial close processes and revenue reconciliation activities.
  • Monitor transaction processing, error queues, and system workbenches.
  • Troubleshoot posting errors, invoice discrepancies, and revenue adjustments.
  • Execute and validate automated revenue processing jobs.
  • Work closely with Finance and Accounting teams to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.

4. SQL / ZOQL & Financial Reporting

  • Develop and execute SQL and ZOQL queries to investigate financial data and identify discrepancies.
  • Extract, analyze, and validate billing and revenue information.
  • Support financial reporting, reconciliations, and data analysis.
  • Assist with identifying missing transactions, incorrect postings, and integration issues.
  • Provide technical support for reporting and financial data validation.

5. Business Requirements & System Testing

  • Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and business stakeholders to gather and document requirements.
  • Translate revenue recognition and accounting requirements into functional system specifications.
  • Support system configuration changes and enhancements.
  • Participate in system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Validate new revenue recognition rules and system functionality before production deployment.
  • Document testing results, technical issues, and corrective actions.

6. Compliance & Audit Support

  • Support compliance with SOX and ASC 606 requirements.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of revenue recognition configurations and processes.
  • Generate system audit logs and supporting documentation.
  • Assist internal stakeholders with audit preparation and financial controls validation.
  • Ensure system changes follow established financial governance and control procedures.

7. Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration

  • Participate actively in daily meetings, technical discussions, and implementation activities.
  • Collaborate with U.S.-based stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Provide timely updates on project progress, system issues, and implementation risks.
  • Support critical project milestones and production readiness activities.

Project Environment

This position is part of an enterprise financial systems implementation involving Zuora and Workday.

The project requires professionals who can work independently, communicate effectively, and contribute to the successful delivery of complex financial technology solutions.

The implementation includes critical milestones leading to a targeted go-live in August 2027.

Work Arrangement

  • 100% Remote: Candidates based in the United States or eligible Nearshore LATAM locations may be considered.
  • Pacific Time: Full availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours is mandatory.
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day.
  • Contract: Initial 6 months, with potential extension through August 2027.
  • Availability: Active participation in daily meetings and live technical discussions is required.
  • Project Commitment: Additional scheduling restrictions may apply during critical release, pre-go-live, and go-live periods.

Why Join This Project?

This opportunity offers experienced Zuora professionals the chance to contribute to an enterprise financial technology implementation, collaborate with international Finance and IT teams, and apply their expertise in revenue recognition, financial systems integration, and process optimization.

Our client is moving quickly with the selection process, and qualified candidates may be contacted for immediate interviews.

CONFISA Group | Executive Search & Talent Acquisition

  • Proven experience as a Zuora Systems Analyst, Revenue Systems Analyst, or in a similar technical-functional role.
  • Hands-on experience with Zuora Revenue (RevPro) and revenue recognition processes.
  • Strong understanding of ASC 606 revenue recognition standards and financial operations.
  • Experience with Workday and integrations between financial and enterprise systems.
  • Proficiency in SQL and/or ZOQL for data analysis, reporting, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience configuring, maintaining, and supporting Zuora Revenue Recognition systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot system issues, analyze data discrepancies, and support technical resolutions.
  • Experience with system integrations, data validation, testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Familiarity with month-end close activities, revenue reporting, and financial reconciliation processes.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, Accounting, IT, and business stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work independently in a 100% remote environment.
  • Mandatory availability to work Pacific Time (PT) business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based companies or international finance teams.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems and financial automation.
  • Previous experience with complex revenue recognition implementations or system optimization projects.
  • Experience working in Agile or cross-functional technical environments.

This is a 100% remote opportunity supporting U.S.-based operations. Candidates must be available to work during Pacific Time (PT) business hours.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Zuora Revenue Recognition, financial systems integration, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Qualified candidates should demonstrate excellent English communication skills, the ability to work independently in a remote environment, and experience supporting complex financial systems.

CONFISA Staffing Services is committed to connecting qualified professionals with specialized career opportunities across the United States and Latin America.

All applications will be reviewed based on relevant experience, technical qualifications, and alignment with the position requirements.

We encourage qualified candidates to apply.

Our client is a U.S.-based organization currently undertaking a major enterprise technology transformation initiative focused on financial systems modernization, revenue management, and business process optimization.

The organization is implementing and integrating advanced enterprise platforms, including Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, and Workday, to enhance financial operations, automate revenue recognition processes, strengthen financial reporting, and support compliance with accounting standards.

As part of this initiative, our client is expanding its technology implementation team and seeking highly qualified professionals with specialized expertise in enterprise financial systems, revenue recognition, and systems integration.

Through CONFISA Group, we are supporting our client's search for an experienced Zuora Systems Analyst – Revenue Recognition to contribute to this business-critical implementation project.

This opportunity offers the chance to collaborate with U.S.-based stakeholders, finance teams, and technology professionals in a fully remote, international working environment.

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote | U.S. Pacific Time working hours required.

CONFISA Group | Connecting Talent with Opportunity.

raw.description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit . Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Director, Legal

The Director, Legal (Commercial and Medical Review) will serve as the lead legal reviewer for promotional and medical materials. This individual will represent Legal in the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review process, will sit on the Promotional Review Committee (PRC) and Medical Review Committee (MRC), and will help design the standards and procedures that allow the company to review materials quickly, through planned launch and into commercialization. This is a hands-on role for an attorney who is comfortable giving clear, practical advice in a fast-moving, remote environment and appreciates autonomy.

Reporting to the VP, Commercial Legal, this role is accountable for providing practical legal guidance across advertising and promotion, medical affairs activities, commercial operations, market access initiatives, and product launch planning.

This role requires strong interpersonal skills and significant cross-functional interaction across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal and Compliance. Experience with patient support programs and related materials would be an asset to the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the Legal representative on the PRC and MRC, reviewing HCP-facing, patient-facing, medical, and corporate materials for compliance with the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, FDA advertising and promotion regulations, FTC requirements, and other relevant and applicable industry codes
  • Provide advice across pre-launch and launch activities, balancing legal risk with business objectives
  • Review patient materials, including patient education, disease awareness, website and digital content, and patient support program communications, to ensure compliance with relevant regulations
  • Evaluate claims for substantiation, fair balance, and net impression, including comparative, subgroup, and pharmacokinetic claims, and provide clear direction to reviewers and authors
  • Advise on pre-approval communications, including scientific exchange, disease awareness, medical education, congress activity, and the boundaries between investor and corporate messaging and promotion of an investigational product
  • Review non-promotional and medical affairs materials, including responses to unsolicited requests, payor and formulary communications, and digital and social media content
  • Provide guidance on compliantly navigating the regulatory landscape in business activities such as disease education, HCP engagement, and patient-facing materials
  • Support corporate legal matters and business development initiatives as needed

Qualifications

  • JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar
  • 6+ years of legal experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry
  • Strong knowledge of FDA advertising, promotion regulations, and commercial legal requirements
  • Knowledge of product launch planning and commercialization activities
  • Experience reviewing HCP and patient materials, and advising on patient support programs, including hub services, co-pay assistance, and nurse or educator programs
  • Experience supporting a product launch, ideally with a pre-commercial or newly commercial biotechnology company

Core Competencies

  • Strong business judgment with a practical, solutions-oriented approach to risk management
  • Ability to balance legal risk and apply appropriate mitigation strategies
  • Ability to influence and advise in a matrixed environment
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex legal and regulatory concepts into actionable business guidance
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building skills
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment
  • High degree of autonomy, accountability, and execution focus

Travel

  • This position requires up to 10% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

This position is eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

US Salary Range: $200,000 - $232,000

A Day in the Life of a Data Analytics Engineer at MetLife Legal Plans:

MetLife Legal Plans is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data Insights team, reporting to the Senior Director of Data Insights. In this role, you will help modernize and scale our data platform by designing and building robust data models, pipelines, and analytics solutions using DBT Cloud, AWS, Python, and SQL. You will partner closely with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to transform complex data into trusted, actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making across the organization. The ideal candidate is a curious problem solver with strong technical expertise in data engineering, cloud technologies, and data modeling who enjoys uncovering answers to complex business questions and driving continuous improvement through data.

Duties include:

  • Model and build data structures using DBT Cloud to modernize our data platform
  • Utilize DBT Cloud to transform raw data into business focus, semantic layer for data analysis and insights
  • Work with Data Analysts to design data models and data structures to empower self-service analytics
  • Data analysis, such as research into data issues and communication of findings
  • Building data driven solutions to business problems and opportunities
  • Business process optimization and defining core business logic
  • Ensuring data security is enforced within data models and data structures

You should be familiar with hunting for answers to complex business questions and running experiments to gather additional data when necessary.

You should feel comfortable using a product suite of DBT Cloud, GitHub, Visual Studio Code, Python, and Tableau desktop/server to create and manage data pipelines.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience using DBT Cloud.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Bash, and experience with Spark.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, and Redshift.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling and schema design.
  • 1+ years of experience with workflow management tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
  • Familiarity with data governance, data quality, and data security best practices.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with Tableau
  • Experience with Terraform or other IaaC, Kubernetes Cluster, IBM I DB2, AWS CLI (Command Line Interface)
  • Integration experience with: Delighted, Zendesk, Salesforce, AWS Aurora Databases
  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university

Travel:

  • Up to 5% travel

Who We Are:

MetLife Legal Plans is the country's largest provider of legal voluntary benefits. We have more than 40 years of experience in employee legal services and are committed to providing excellent care to our plan members, sponsors and 18,000+ attorneys.

We are trusted by nearly 7 million families and more than 200 Fortune 500 companies who offer our service as an employee benefit.

It’s an exciting time to join our team. We are growing quickly and have a bold vision for our future as we evolve our company to dream bigger, move faster, and use creativity and technology to build products people love.

MLP's Core 4:

  • Be the Best

At Denver Health, we take care of the people who take care of our community. As Colorado’s primary, and essential, safety-net healthcare system, Denver Health is a mission-driven organization that has provided millions in uncompensated care for the uninsured each year.

Located near downtown Denver, Denver Health is just minutes away from many of the cultural and recreational activities Denver has to offer.


Denver Health is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We value the unique ideas, talents and contributions reflective of the needs of our community. raw.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director of Technology Innovation Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic leadership role responsible for governing and advancing the evaluation, selection, and deployment of emerging technologies across the supply chain organization. This individual will own and continuously refine a structured stage gate process for vetting technology innovations — ensuring that investments are rigorous, aligned to business priorities, and positioned to deliver measurable supply chain value.

This leader will serve as the bridge between technology vendors, internal stakeholders, and executive decision-makers, championing a disciplined yet agile approach to innovation.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


Stage Gate Process Ownership

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve a multi-stage gate framework for evaluating, piloting, and scaling supply chain technology innovations
  • Define clear criteria, scoring rubrics, and decision checkpoints for each gate (e.g., ideation, feasibility, pilot, scale, sunset)
  • Lead cross-functional gate review committees, facilitating structured go/no-go decisions with executive stakeholders
  • Maintain a transparent innovation pipeline dashboard, tracking all active and archived technology candidates

Technology Evaluation & Scouting

  • Proactively identify emerging technologies relevant to supply chain operations (e.g., AI/ML, robotics, IoT, digital twins, blockchain, autonomous systems)
  • Develop and maintain relationships with technology vendors, startup ecosystems, and industry research bodies (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, industry consortiums)
  • Conduct structured technology assessments including market analysis, vendor due diligence, and total cost of ownership modeling
  • Represent Cencora at industry forums, innovation councils, conferences, and strategic vendor engagements; maintain awareness of supply chain innovation trends and benchmark practices across industries.

Stakeholder Engagement & Governance

  • Partner with Supply Chain operations, IT, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to ensure holistic vetting of technology candidates
  • Build and manage a Technology Innovation Advisory Board comprising internal subject matter experts and external advisors
  • Develop executive-ready business cases and investment proposals for technologies advancing through the pipeline
  • Drive alignment between innovation initiatives and the broader supply chain strategic roadmap

Portfolio & Performance Management

  • Manage the innovation portfolio budget, ensuring appropriate resource allocation across stages of the gate process
  • Establish KPIs and success metrics for piloted and deployed technologies, measure realized benefits including cost savings, productivity improvements and service enhancements and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
  • Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and refine the vetting framework over time

Team Leadership & CoE Culture

  • Lead and mobilize a cross-functional network of internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, driving innovative outcomes through influence rather than direct authority
  • Build trust and credibility across Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Operations, and other functions by demonstrating deep expertise, active listening, and collaborative problem-solving
  • Create alignment around a shared innovation vision by engaging stakeholders early and often throughout the stage gate process
  • Design and facilitate working sessions, workshops, and forums that draw out subject matter expertise and foster co-ownership of technology evaluation decisions
  • Cultivate a culture of curiosity and structured experimentation across the stakeholder community, encouraging teams to surface and champion emerging technology ideas

QUALIFICATIONS:


Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 10+ years of experience in supply chain operations, strategy, or technology — with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role
  • Demonstrated experience designing or managing a stage gate, innovation pipeline, or technology governance process
  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across distribution, logistics, procurement, or inventory management
  • Proven ability to build executive-level presentations and facilitate senior leadership decision-making forums
  • Experience managing cross-functional programs from concept through implementation

Preferred

  • Master's degree (MBA, MS Supply Chain, or related)
  • Experience in pharmaceutical distribution, healthcare supply chain, or highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as Stage-Gate®, Lean Startup, or Design Thinking
  • PMP, Agile, or related certifications
  • Experience working with or evaluating enterprise technology vendors (ERP, WMS, TMS, AI platforms)

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. For details, visit

Full time

Ranges in Colorado/California/Washington/NewYork/Hawaii/Vermont/Minnesota/Massachusetts/Illinois State-specific locations may be up to 10% lower than the minimum salary range, and 12% higher than the maximum salary range.

raw.description:
Summary

Chobani’s Consumer Loyalty Team brings the vision and experience of the Chobani Brand to life on all our channels. We ensure that every consumer walks away with best in brand experience despite their original position. We’re dedicated and proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and that comes through in all our interaction.

Our team is responsible for defending the brand, carrying a knowledge of every product—ingredients, nutrition, regulatory compliance, community, sustainability, farming and everything about our company including our amazing founder and leader. We’re working to build brand loyalty, upsell our products and ensure that all messaging addresses the needs of the audience. We’re also responsible to meet consumers where they are and must be knowledgeable about a variety of channels with which we speak with consumers.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the care of consumers to ensure a best-in-class experience, while collecting valuable data and conveying the most important details about Chobani, our products, our mission and our values
  • Manage expanded duties within the department that go outside the daily expectations of consumer engagement, including building programs, overseeing system, and process improvements
  • Overseeing specific programming on behalf of the team to build stronger systems shared
  • Represent the company as an expert in products, including product specs, descriptions, nutritionals, ingredients and social issues to address incoming questions
  • Accurately record information gathered in transactions with consumers into CRM (Consumer Relations Management) system
  • Report on Quality and Feedback to provide the business with necessary data that will ensure productivity improvements and business decision making on behalf of consumers
  • Leading and serving as a mentor to junior members of the team to ensure their ongoing success
  • Answer questions or address concerns about Chobani ads, brand messaging and developing news
  • Meet quality and productivity requirements as it relates to engaging the needs of the consumer
  • Escalate business-critical complaints
  • Perform other duties as necessary

Requirements

  • College Degree or High School Diploma combined with relevant experience required
  • Minimum of 4-6 years of relevant experience required
  • Ability to serve as a leader and encourage the support and success of the team
  • Ability to understand and convey the ideals and culture of the Chobani brand
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to quickly learn new material and information
  • Ability to handle stressful situations while managing proper tone and messaging
  • Ability to work in a team environment and independently with little supervision
  • Must be able to travel to our Norwich or New Berlin locations within an hour and a half

About Us

Chobani is a food maker with a mission of making high-quality and nutritious food accessible to more people, while elevating our communities and making the world a healthier place. In short: making good food for all. In support of this mission, Chobani is a purpose-driven, people-first, food-and-wellness-focused company, and has been since its founding in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya, an immigrant to the U.S. The Company manufactures yogurt, oat milk, and creamers – Chobani yogurt is America's No.1 yogurt brand, made with natural ingredients without artificial preservatives. Following the 2023 acquisition of La Colombe, a leading coffee roaster with a shared commitment to quality, craftmanship and impact, the Company began selling cold-pressed espresso and lattes on tap at cafés nationwide, as well as Ready to Drink (RTD) coffee beverages at retail. In 2025, Chobani acquired Daily Harvest, a modern brand offering consumers nutritious, delicious and convenient ready-to-make meals.

 

Chobani uses food as a force for good in the world – putting humanity first in everything it does. The company's philanthropic efforts prioritize giving back to its communities and beyond. Chobani manufactures its products in New York, Idaho, Michigan and Australia, and its products are available throughout North America and distributed in Australia and other select markets. 

For more information, please visit  www.chobani.com or follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn. 

Chobani is an equal opportunity employer. Chobani will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on any basis including, but not limited to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, military and/or veteran status, marital status, predisposing genetic characteristics and genetic information, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws.

The salary range for this full-time position is $24.25 - [[cust_onetenpermidpay]], + bonus + equity + benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Chobani provides a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, disability insurance, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, and tuition reimbursement. To help save for the future, all employees are eligible for a 401k match of 100% on up to 5% of eligible pay. To support growing families, we provide fertility and childcare assistance, and 12 weeks of parental leave at full pay after six months of continuous employment. In addition, we provide wellness resources which include an employee assistance program, fitness discounts, a wellness reimbursement, on-site gym access (certain locations) and a monthly wellness newsletter to connect you with resources and timely information. We offer various types of paid time of including: 120 hours of paid time off, 11 holidays, and paid volunteer time off.

raw.description:
Position: Zuora Systems Analyst – Revenue Recognition
Location: 100% Remote | USA / Nearshore LATAM
Working Hours: U.S. Pacific Time (Mandatory – No Exceptions)
Employment Type: Contract
Contract Duration: Initial 6 months, with potential extension through August 2027
Schedule: Full-Time | 8 Hours per Day
Start Date: ASAP

Position Overview

Our client is seeking an experienced Zuora Systems Analyst – Revenue Recognition to support a critical enterprise financial systems implementation and integration project.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Zuora Revenue, Zuora Billing, Workday, and revenue recognition processes, combined with technical expertise in system configuration, data integration, financial reporting, and troubleshooting.

This position requires a professional who can bridge the gap between Finance, Accounting, and IT teams, translating complex business requirements into effective technical solutions.

The selected candidate will play a key role in configuring revenue recognition rules, supporting financial system integrations, resolving data discrepancies, and ensuring accurate revenue reporting in compliance with applicable accounting standards.

This is a fully remote opportunity requiring full availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours, without exceptions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Zuora Revenue Configuration & Revenue Recognition

  • Configure and maintain revenue recognition rules within Zuora Revenue.
  • Support revenue recognition processes in accordance with ASC 606 and applicable accounting requirements.
  • Configure revenue schedules, allocation rules, and recognition methodologies.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot revenue recognition issues and system discrepancies.
  • Ensure accurate processing of revenue transactions and financial information.

2. Systems Integration & Data Management

  • Support integrations between Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, Workday, and related enterprise financial systems.
  • Monitor data flows across billing, revenue management, and accounting platforms.
  • Identify and resolve integration errors, missing transactions, and data inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to improve system performance and data accuracy.
  • Assist with system configuration, validation, and implementation activities.

3. Financial Close & Operational Support

  • Support month-end financial close processes and revenue reconciliation activities.
  • Monitor transaction processing, error queues, and system workbenches.
  • Troubleshoot posting errors, invoice discrepancies, and revenue adjustments.
  • Execute and validate automated revenue processing jobs.
  • Work closely with Finance and Accounting teams to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.

4. SQL / ZOQL & Financial Reporting

  • Develop and execute SQL and ZOQL queries to investigate financial data and identify discrepancies.
  • Extract, analyze, and validate billing and revenue information.
  • Support financial reporting, reconciliations, and data analysis.
  • Assist with identifying missing transactions, incorrect postings, and integration issues.
  • Provide technical support for reporting and financial data validation.

5. Business Requirements & System Testing

  • Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and business stakeholders to gather and document requirements.
  • Translate revenue recognition and accounting requirements into functional system specifications.
  • Support system configuration changes and enhancements.
  • Participate in system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Validate new revenue recognition rules and system functionality before production deployment.
  • Document testing results, technical issues, and corrective actions.

6. Compliance & Audit Support

  • Support compliance with SOX and ASC 606 requirements.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of revenue recognition configurations and processes.
  • Generate system audit logs and supporting documentation.
  • Assist internal stakeholders with audit preparation and financial controls validation.
  • Ensure system changes follow established financial governance and control procedures.

7. Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration

  • Participate actively in daily meetings, technical discussions, and implementation activities.
  • Collaborate with U.S.-based stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Provide timely updates on project progress, system issues, and implementation risks.
  • Support critical project milestones and production readiness activities.

Project Environment

This position is part of an enterprise financial systems implementation involving Zuora and Workday.

The project requires professionals who can work independently, communicate effectively, and contribute to the successful delivery of complex financial technology solutions.

The implementation includes critical milestones leading to a targeted go-live in August 2027.

Work Arrangement

  • 100% Remote: Candidates based in the United States or eligible Nearshore LATAM locations may be considered.
  • Pacific Time: Full availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours is mandatory.
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day.
  • Contract: Initial 6 months, with potential extension through August 2027.
  • Availability: Active participation in daily meetings and live technical discussions is required.
  • Project Commitment: Additional scheduling restrictions may apply during critical release, pre-go-live, and go-live periods.

Why Join This Project?

This opportunity offers experienced Zuora professionals the chance to contribute to an enterprise financial technology implementation, collaborate with international Finance and IT teams, and apply their expertise in revenue recognition, financial systems integration, and process optimization.

Our client is moving quickly with the selection process, and qualified candidates may be contacted for immediate interviews.

CONFISA Group | Executive Search & Talent Acquisition

  • Proven experience as a Zuora Systems Analyst, Revenue Systems Analyst, or in a similar technical-functional role.
  • Hands-on experience with Zuora Revenue (RevPro) and revenue recognition processes.
  • Strong understanding of ASC 606 revenue recognition standards and financial operations.
  • Experience with Workday and integrations between financial and enterprise systems.
  • Proficiency in SQL and/or ZOQL for data analysis, reporting, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience configuring, maintaining, and supporting Zuora Revenue Recognition systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot system issues, analyze data discrepancies, and support technical resolutions.
  • Experience with system integrations, data validation, testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Familiarity with month-end close activities, revenue reporting, and financial reconciliation processes.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, Accounting, IT, and business stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work independently in a 100% remote environment.
  • Mandatory availability to work Pacific Time (PT) business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based companies or international finance teams.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems and financial automation.
  • Previous experience with complex revenue recognition implementations or system optimization projects.
  • Experience working in Agile or cross-functional technical environments.

This is a 100% remote opportunity supporting U.S.-based operations. Candidates must be available to work during Pacific Time (PT) business hours.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Zuora Revenue Recognition, financial systems integration, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Qualified candidates should demonstrate excellent English communication skills, the ability to work independently in a remote environment, and experience supporting complex financial systems.

CONFISA Staffing Services is committed to connecting qualified professionals with specialized career opportunities across the United States and Latin America.

All applications will be reviewed based on relevant experience, technical qualifications, and alignment with the position requirements.

“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit . Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Director, Legal

The Director, Legal (Commercial and Medical Review) will serve as the lead legal reviewer for promotional and medical materials. This individual will represent Legal in the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review process, will sit on the Promotional Review Committee (PRC) and Medical Review Committee (MRC), and will help design the standards and procedures that allow the company to review materials quickly, through planned launch and into commercialization. This is a hands-on role for an attorney who is comfortable giving clear, practical advice in a fast-moving, remote environment and appreciates autonomy.

Reporting to the VP, Commercial Legal, this role is accountable for providing practical legal guidance across advertising and promotion, medical affairs activities, commercial operations, market access initiatives, and product launch planning.

This role requires strong interpersonal skills and significant cross-functional interaction across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal and Compliance. Experience with patient support programs and related materials would be an asset to the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the Legal representative on the PRC and MRC, reviewing HCP-facing, patient-facing, medical, and corporate materials for compliance with the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, FDA advertising and promotion regulations, FTC requirements, and other relevant and applicable industry codes
  • Provide advice across pre-launch and launch activities, balancing legal risk with business objectives
  • Review patient materials, including patient education, disease awareness, website and digital content, and patient support program communications, to ensure compliance with relevant regulations
  • Evaluate claims for substantiation, fair balance, and net impression, including comparative, subgroup, and pharmacokinetic claims, and provide clear direction to reviewers and authors
  • Advise on pre-approval communications, including scientific exchange, disease awareness, medical education, congress activity, and the boundaries between investor and corporate messaging and promotion of an investigational product
  • Review non-promotional and medical affairs materials, including responses to unsolicited requests, payor and formulary communications, and digital and social media content
  • Provide guidance on compliantly navigating the regulatory landscape in business activities such as disease education, HCP engagement, and patient-facing materials
  • Support corporate legal matters and business development initiatives as needed

Qualifications

  • JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar
  • 6+ years of legal experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry
  • Strong knowledge of FDA advertising, promotion regulations, and commercial legal requirements
  • Knowledge of product launch planning and commercialization activities
  • Experience reviewing HCP and patient materials, and advising on patient support programs, including hub services, co-pay assistance, and nurse or educator programs
  • Experience supporting a product launch, ideally with a pre-commercial or newly commercial biotechnology company

Core Competencies

  • Strong business judgment with a practical, solutions-oriented approach to risk management
  • Ability to balance legal risk and apply appropriate mitigation strategies
  • Ability to influence and advise in a matrixed environment
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex legal and regulatory concepts into actionable business guidance
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building skills
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment
  • High degree of autonomy, accountability, and execution focus

Travel

  • This position requires up to 10% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

This position is eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

US Salary Range: $200,000 - $232,000

You will partner closely with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to transform complex data into trusted, actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making across the organization. The ideal candidate is a curious problem solver with strong technical expertise in data engineering, cloud technologies, and data modeling who enjoys uncovering answers to complex business questions and driving continuous improvement through data.

  • Ensuring data security is enforced within data models and data structures

You should feel comfortable using a product suite of DBT Cloud, GitHub, Visual Studio Code, Python, and Tableau desktop/server to create and manage data pipelines.

raw.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director of Technology Innovation Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic leadership role responsible for governing and advancing the evaluation, selection, and deployment of emerging technologies across the supply chain organization. This individual will own and continuously refine a structured stage gate process for vetting technology innovations — ensuring that investments are rigorous, aligned to business priorities, and positioned to deliver measurable supply chain value.

This leader will serve as the bridge between technology vendors, internal stakeholders, and executive decision-makers, championing a disciplined yet agile approach to innovation.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


Stage Gate Process Ownership

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve a multi-stage gate framework for evaluating, piloting, and scaling supply chain technology innovations
  • Define clear criteria, scoring rubrics, and decision checkpoints for each gate (e.g., ideation, feasibility, pilot, scale, sunset)
  • Lead cross-functional gate review committees, facilitating structured go/no-go decisions with executive stakeholders
  • Maintain a transparent innovation pipeline dashboard, tracking all active and archived technology candidates

Technology Evaluation & Scouting

  • Proactively identify emerging technologies relevant to supply chain operations (e.g., AI/ML, robotics, IoT, digital twins, blockchain, autonomous systems)
  • Develop and maintain relationships with technology vendors, startup ecosystems, and industry research bodies (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, industry consortiums)
  • Conduct structured technology assessments including market analysis, vendor due diligence, and total cost of ownership modeling
  • Represent Cencora at industry forums, innovation councils, conferences, and strategic vendor engagements; maintain awareness of supply chain innovation trends and benchmark practices across industries.

Stakeholder Engagement & Governance

  • Partner with Supply Chain operations, IT, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to ensure holistic vetting of technology candidates
  • Build and manage a Technology Innovation Advisory Board comprising internal subject matter experts and external advisors
  • Develop executive-ready business cases and investment proposals for technologies advancing through the pipeline
  • Drive alignment between innovation initiatives and the broader supply chain strategic roadmap

Portfolio & Performance Management

  • Manage the innovation portfolio budget, ensuring appropriate resource allocation across stages of the gate process
  • Establish KPIs and success metrics for piloted and deployed technologies, measure realized benefits including cost savings, productivity improvements and service enhancements and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
  • Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and refine the vetting framework over time

Team Leadership & CoE Culture

  • Lead and mobilize a cross-functional network of internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, driving innovative outcomes through influence rather than direct authority
  • Build trust and credibility across Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Operations, and other functions by demonstrating deep expertise, active listening, and collaborative problem-solving
  • Create alignment around a shared innovation vision by engaging stakeholders early and often throughout the stage gate process
  • Design and facilitate working sessions, workshops, and forums that draw out subject matter expertise and foster co-ownership of technology evaluation decisions
  • Cultivate a culture of curiosity and structured experimentation across the stakeholder community, encouraging teams to surface and champion emerging technology ideas

QUALIFICATIONS:


Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 10+ years of experience in supply chain operations, strategy, or technology — with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role
  • Demonstrated experience designing or managing a stage gate, innovation pipeline, or technology governance process
  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across distribution, logistics, procurement, or inventory management
  • Proven ability to build executive-level presentations and facilitate senior leadership decision-making forums
  • Experience managing cross-functional programs from concept through implementation

Preferred

  • Master's degree (MBA, MS Supply Chain, or related)
  • Experience in pharmaceutical distribution, healthcare supply chain, or highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as Stage-Gate®, Lean Startup, or Design Thinking
  • PMP, Agile, or related certifications
  • Experience working with or evaluating enterprise technology vendors (ERP, WMS, TMS, AI platforms)

What Cencora offers

In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more.
