raw.title: Senior Community Loyalty Associate (Remote, NY, US)
raw.excerpt: Summary Chobani’s Consumer Loyalty Team brings the vision and experience of the Chobani Brand to life on all our channels.
raw.description:
Summary

Chobani’s Consumer Loyalty Team brings the vision and experience of the Chobani Brand to life on all our channels. We ensure that every consumer walks away with best in brand experience despite their original position. We’re dedicated and proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and that comes through in all our interaction.

Our team is responsible for defending the brand, carrying a knowledge of every product—ingredients, nutrition, regulatory compliance, community, sustainability, farming and everything about our company including our amazing founder and leader. We’re working to build brand loyalty, upsell our products and ensure that all messaging addresses the needs of the audience. We’re also responsible to meet consumers where they are and must be knowledgeable about a variety of channels with which we speak with consumers.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the care of consumers to ensure a best-in-class experience, while collecting valuable data and conveying the most important details about Chobani, our products, our mission and our values
  • Manage expanded duties within the department that go outside the daily expectations of consumer engagement, including building programs, overseeing system, and process improvements
  • Overseeing specific programming on behalf of the team to build stronger systems shared
  • Represent the company as an expert in products, including product specs, descriptions, nutritionals, ingredients and social issues to address incoming questions
  • Accurately record information gathered in transactions with consumers into CRM (Consumer Relations Management) system
  • Report on Quality and Feedback to provide the business with necessary data that will ensure productivity improvements and business decision making on behalf of consumers
  • Leading and serving as a mentor to junior members of the team to ensure their ongoing success
  • Answer questions or address concerns about Chobani ads, brand messaging and developing news
  • Meet quality and productivity requirements as it relates to engaging the needs of the consumer
  • Escalate business-critical complaints
  • Perform other duties as necessary

Requirements

  • College Degree or High School Diploma combined with relevant experience required
  • Minimum of 4-6 years of relevant experience required
  • Ability to serve as a leader and encourage the support and success of the team
  • Ability to understand and convey the ideals and culture of the Chobani brand
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to quickly learn new material and information
  • Ability to handle stressful situations while managing proper tone and messaging
  • Ability to work in a team environment and independently with little supervision
  • Must be able to travel to our Norwich or New Berlin locations within an hour and a half

About Us

Chobani is a food maker with a mission of making high-quality and nutritious food accessible to more people, while elevating our communities and making the world a healthier place. In short: making good food for all. In support of this mission, Chobani is a purpose-driven, people-first, food-and-wellness-focused company, and has been since its founding in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya, an immigrant to the U.S. The Company manufactures yogurt, oat milk, and creamers – Chobani yogurt is America's No.1 yogurt brand, made with natural ingredients without artificial preservatives. Following the 2023 acquisition of La Colombe, a leading coffee roaster with a shared commitment to quality, craftmanship and impact, the Company began selling cold-pressed espresso and lattes on tap at cafés nationwide, as well as Ready to Drink (RTD) coffee beverages at retail. In 2025, Chobani acquired Daily Harvest, a modern brand offering consumers nutritious, delicious and convenient ready-to-make meals.

 

Chobani uses food as a force for good in the world – putting humanity first in everything it does. The company's philanthropic efforts prioritize giving back to its communities and beyond. Chobani manufactures its products in New York, Idaho, Michigan and Australia, and its products are available throughout North America and distributed in Australia and other select markets. 

For more information, please visit  www.chobani.com or follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn. 

Chobani is an equal opportunity employer. Chobani will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on any basis including, but not limited to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, military and/or veteran status, marital status, predisposing genetic characteristics and genetic information, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws.

The salary range for this full-time position is $24.25 - [[cust_onetenpermidpay]], + bonus + equity + benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Chobani provides a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, disability insurance, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, and tuition reimbursement. To help save for the future, all employees are eligible for a 401k match of 100% on up to 5% of eligible pay. To support growing families, we provide fertility and childcare assistance, and 12 weeks of parental leave at full pay after six months of continuous employment. In addition, we provide wellness resources which include an employee assistance program, fitness discounts, a wellness reimbursement, on-site gym access (certain locations) and a monthly wellness newsletter to connect you with resources and timely information. We offer various types of paid time of including: 120 hours of paid time off, 11 holidays, and paid volunteer time off.

raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Tenant
raw.excerpt: What We’re BuildingHoneycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do!
raw.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Honeycomb is an observability platform that helps engineering teams understand how their software behaves in production. Our Tenant team is behind Honeycomb Private Cloud, a brand new product that allows customers to have their own Honeycomb instance.

What you'll do

  • Own delivery of Honeycomb Private Cloud — the infrastructure, tooling, and operational processes that let enterprise customers run Honeycomb inside their own cloud environment.
  • Grow the product — we anticipate significant growth in the next year; help us meet sales goals and build relationships to support it.
  • Work at the customer boundary — partner with Field Engineering, Support, and Sales on PoCs, security reviews, access negotiations, and contract asks, and help the team know when to take feedback and when to help us show the customer what good looks like.
  • Lead across the org — Private Cloud depends on many engineering teams across the org. We maintain a tight drift between SaaS and Private Cloud, and this role will need to be able to understand and prioritize work that touches all parts of our engineering org.
  • Feedback loops for developers. We learn a lot about Honeycomb as a product while building Honeycomb. Ensure that we push Private-Cloud-inspired tooling back into our SaaS infrastructure so each side continues to make the other better.
  • Build the team — grow and develop a small, tenured, senior, very high-context team; remove the single points of failure that come with that; hire and onboard the next engineers to scale the team as the product offering scales.

What we're looking for

  • 1+ year as an Engineering manager for a highly technical, senior team.
  • You have a solid track record as an engineer, influencing without authority, and leaving things better than you found them.
  • You've managed or led a team that carried a real production on-call rotation, and you treat operational health as a core requirement.
  • Experience shipping and operating software in environments you don't fully control — on-prem, private cloud, BYOC, or managed single-tenant. You know what version skew, partial telemetry, and customer security constraints do to a roadmap.
  • Enough Kubernetes and AWS fluency to review a design, ask the challenging questions, and be useful in an incident review. You don't need to be the person writing the Terraform.
  • Comfort being customer-facing with enterprise buyers: security questionnaires, access models, procurement, escalations.
  • Ruthless prioritization on a small team with an enormous surface area — you can name what you decided not to do, and why.
  • Hiring and onboarding engineers into a domain with a steep ramp.
  • Comfort with AI tooling, and a point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

Bonus points

  • Familiarity with observability / OpenTelemetry (Honeycomb's domain).
  • You're still hands-on and enjoy contributing to and reviewing code (welcome, but it won't be your primary role here).
  • Background in Go, Terraform, Kafka, and large-scale data infrastructure.
  • FedRAMP, GovCloud, or regulated-industry compliance experience.
  • A field-adjacent past — solutions architecture, consulting, or deployment engineering.
Base Salary based on level of experience
$208,260—$234,000 USD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes.
For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice.
If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact . Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

raw.title: Scrum Master (Information Technology/Software/Remote)
raw.excerpt: Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc).
raw.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

raw.title: Account Manager - E-commerce Marketing Agency
raw.excerpt: The main purpose of the Account Manager is to manage their assigned clients and their stores by planning, briefing, monitoring, and executing marketing campaigns aimed at driving conversions and sales.
raw.description:
The main purpose of the Account Manager is to manage their assigned clients and their stores by planning, briefing, monitoring, and executing marketing campaigns aimed at driving conversions and sales.

This includes managing, overseeing, and taking charge of the client-agency relationship for all the clients that have been assigned to you. It also includes developing and executing marketing strategies, handling client communications, writing client reports, and communicating the client’s marketing needs to other team members. You will be responsible for supplying the information your team needs to ensure that all marketing campaigns are written, designed, and executed as well as possible. Your goal as an Account Manager is to assist your clients in meeting their revenue goals using the products and services of our company.

The Account Manager will report directly to the Head of Account Managers, the Account Managers’ Leads, and the Service Director while working collaboratively with other departments.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Account Manager is to be in charge of maintaining a good relationship with your assigned clients while ensuring that our products and services are bringing results for our clients. This will include coming up with innovative ideas for clients’ marketing campaigns, monitoring the performance of such marketing campaigns, and keeping an open channel of productive and fruitful communication with our clients.

You will also be responsible for leading teams consisting of professional Copywriters, Designers, and Account Managers’ Associates to ensure that your assigned clients’ marketing campaigns are executed smoothly. This involves activities such as outlining the client's campaign calendar, briefing new campaigns, delegating creative work, and ultimately overseeing the timely delivery of marketing campaigns.

General Responsibilities:

  • Effectively managing, overseeing, and ensuring that the marketing campaigns of your assigned clients are executed and performing well
  • Building and maintaining a strong relationship with your assigned clients to ensure peak productivity, open communication, and establishing trust between our clients and Hustler Marketing
  • Being in charge of the planning, development, and execution of marketing strategies (consisting of email campaigns, SMS campaigns, pop-ups, and flows) for your assigned clients (meaning that you’ll be managing about 40 unique marketing campaigns per month)
  • Ensuring that the needs and expectations of your assigned clients are managed and met
  • Working to improve the results from email marketing for your assigned clients
  • Collaborating with team members to respond to client requests promptly
  • Working alongside a team of experienced marketing professionals productively and harmoniously to ensure that the highest quality marketing campaigns are delivered to our clients
  • Continuously staying in contact with your assigned clients, including leading and attending regular meetings with your clients
  • Collecting and analyzing data to understand the consumers’ demographics and trends to forward the clients' marketing agenda and drive better results, setting new goals weekly
  • Regularly reporting on the performance of the email marketing campaigns for your assigned clients, including reporting on aspects like revenue from email marketing, best-performing campaigns, results from A/B testing, and the measures taken to improve and optimize client revenue
  • Working with the Service Department to maintain high work standards and ensuring that the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Keeping a tight grip on client churn (especially for your assigned clients), and implementing strategies to prevent clients from leaving the company, with the assistance of the Service Director
  • Troubleshooting and assisting with any issues related to clients’ satisfaction and the performance of marketing campaigns as developed and executed by our team
  • Being able to effectively and productively work with any type of client with minimal supervision
  • Working on various tasks as part of the team of Account Managers
  • Participating in the Account Managers’ group calls
  • Participating in the training and skill-building sessions for Account Managers within the Service Department to improve their skills, performance, and overall expertise
  • Acting as a liaison between clients and cross-functional teams to ensure the successful implementation of new services and products offered by Hustler Marketing
  • Continuously working to identify new opportunities to expand services offered to clients through regular communication and relationship building
  • Using data analysis techniques to create targeted campaigns for upselling our services to our client segments, and to present these service offers to clients in a compelling manner
  • Continuously working to discover industry-wide best practices and standards and present your findings to the Account Managers’ Lead, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director
  • Being available to assist with all internal service-related needs from other departments
  • Directly reporting to the Account Managers’ Leads, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director (in that structural order)

Positions Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

The ideal candidate must be someone with extensive working experience in managing client accounts effectively, as well as experience in email marketing. Such experience should include managing a team consisting of marketing professionals (such as Account Managers’ Associates, Designers, Copywriters, and other team members) to deliver marketing campaigns that are focused on driving sales.

The Account Manager must be able to act swiftly upon receiving urgent requests from clients and must be able to work consistently with high levels of accountability.

The right person will be professional and also have considerable leadership and managerial experience, as well as strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with clients and internal teams. Having been an Account Manager before, or having any agency experience is a great advantage.

Familiarity with various tools such as Slack, Hubstaff, Asana, Klaviyo, and Google Workspace Suite is a must for this role. The candidate should also feel comfortable working in a remote environment. Availability, accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, and consistency are highly important factors for us, so the Account Manager should display these qualities when it comes to workload commitments and general availability during office hours.

Key Requirements:

  • At least 12 months of experience working in a digital marketing role, together with at least 6 months of working experience in an email marketing field (Preference will be given to candidates who have worked with remote teams and team members from different countries or have any account management or agency experience)
  • A proven track record of achieving success in a leadership role is a must, especially leading a team of creatives to deliver quality work that meets the needs of clients
  • Must have the ability to work independently without compromising on work standards
  • Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines
  • Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically / analytically, as these skills are essential for meeting the needs of our clients and resolving any issues or queries
  • Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism
  • Any remote work experience is a major advantage
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with clients as well as marketing professionals in our Service Department
  • Must possess great problem-solving skills as it is essential for working with clients and resolving any queries, complaints, or issues
  • Must have the ability to learn and adapt quickly, and possess excellent time management skills and high levels of focus, productivity, and efficiency
  • Any knowledge or experience with email marketing, e-commerce, or Klaviyo is a huge plus
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your time (remote work experience is a plus)

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

raw.description:
Assume a vital position as a key member of a high-performing team that delivers infrastructure and performance excellence. Your role will be instrumental in shaping the future at one of the world's largest and most influential companies.

As a Remote Access Lead Infrastructure Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Corporate Sector- Employee Platforms, you apply deep knowledge of software, applications, and technical processes within the infrastructure engineering discipline. You own the design and build of the infrastructure that delivers secure remote access to virtual desktops and applications for a global workforce. That estate covers application delivery controllers, access gateways, session brokers, and the certificate, network, and authentication services that support them across a multi-region global data center footprint. This is a hands-on engineering role with design authority where you will set the reference architecture and configuration standards, engineer capacity and regional failover, harden the externally reachable access path, and automate build and validation so the estate stays consistent as it scales in an environment that is tightly controlled. Continue to evolve your technical and cross-functional knowledge outside of your aligned domain of expertise.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the engineering design, build, and lifecycle of global remote access infrastructure, including application delivery controllers, access gateways, virtual desktop brokers and pods, and the supporting network and certificate services
  • Define reference architecture and configuration standards across regions, retire one-off builds and legacy exceptions, and hold a multi-tenant estate to a consistent baseline
  • Engineer capacity, resiliency, and failover, including regional redundancy, recovery design, traffic distribution, and load testing against peak and contingency concurrency
  • Harden the access path end to end, covering TLS configuration, federation and multi-factor integration, device posture enforcement, firmware and vulnerability remediation, and integrity monitoring of externally reachable services
  • Automate build, configuration, and post-change validation, and lead cross-domain engineering with network, identity, security, and data center operations partners
  • Use enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate infrastructure analysis and design documentation, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements
  • Apply reuse-first, AI-assisted practices within delivery and automation routines to identify recurring issues and validate remediation options, ensuring changes are traceable/auditable and aligned to resiliency and security expectations

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Formal training or certification on infrastructure engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
  • Demonstrated experience engineering enterprise remote access, application delivery, or virtual desktop infrastructure at global scale in a regulated environment
  • Deep hands-on expertise with application delivery controllers and access gateways, such as Citrix NetScaler and Omnissa UAG (Horizon), covering multi-tenant instance provisioning, load balancing, virtual server configuration, SSL and TLS profiles, certificate lifecycle, authentication policy, and session settings
  • Strong engineering experience with enterprise virtual desktop platforms, such as Citrix and Omnissa Horizon, covering broker and connection server design, pod and image architecture, and protocol-level session delivery
  • Working command of enterprise networking and identity integration, including DNS, routing and firewall policy, TLS, SAML federation, multi-factor authentication, and directory services
  • Demonstrated capacity planning, load testing, and resiliency engineering for a high-concurrency platform, with automation built in PowerShell, Python, Terraform, or equivalent.
  • Experience in Cloudflare or Akamai
  • Deep knowledge of one or more areas of infrastructure engineering such as: hardware, networking terminology, databases, storage engineering, deployment practices, integration, automation, scaling, resilience or performance assessments
  • Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity
  • Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations
  • Deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure and multiple cloud technologies with the ability to operate in and migrate across public and private clouds

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience with zero-trust network access or cloud-delivered access services, including identity-aware proxy and outbound connector models
  • Track record of reducing internet-facing attack surface for externally reachable enterprise services without degrading user experience
  • Familiarity with thin client platforms and a diverse endpoint population across managed and unmanaged devices
  • Hands-on experience with appliance hardware refresh and firmware lifecycle in co-located data centers

As the platform continues to grow, we need someone who can take ownership of the onboarding process, support new users, and ensure providers and RBTs have everything they need to get started successfully.

You’ll be the main point of contact for users who need guidance, follow-ups, or assistance completing their profiles and onboarding requirements. Your role will be essential in ensuring users understand how to use the platform, outstanding tasks are followed up on, and nothing falls through the cracks.

This is a hands-on customer-facing role suited to someone who enjoys helping people, building relationships, and keeping processes organised. We’re looking for a dedicated onboarding and customer success professional rather than a general virtual assistant.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Onboarding & Follow-Ups

  • Guide ABA providers through the onboarding process and help them get set up on the platform.
  • Support RBTs as they register and complete their onboarding through the mobile app.
  • Follow up with users who have incomplete profiles, missing information, or outstanding onboarding steps.
  • Proactively contact users to keep the onboarding process moving and ensure tasks are completed.
  • Take ownership of follow-ups and ensure no outstanding items are overlooked.

2. Customer Support & Platform Guidance

  • Answer routine questions from providers and RBTs about the platform and onboarding process.
  • Help users understand how the platform works and guide them through the relevant steps.
  • Check in with providers to ensure they understand how to use the portal and submit coverage requests.
  • Provide a friendly, patient, and professional user experience.
  • Build positive relationships with users and help them feel confident using the platform.

3. Customer Success & Engagement

  • Monitor onboarding progress and identify users who may need additional support.
  • Follow up with providers and RBTs to encourage completion of their profiles and continued platform engagement.
  • Identify areas where users may be confused or struggling to navigate the platform.
  • Help improve the onboarding experience by sharing recurring questions, feedback, and common challenges with the team.

4. CRM & Administrative Coordination

  • Keep CRM records up to date, including contact details, onboarding stages, communication history, and next steps.
  • Track outstanding follow-ups and ensure users receive timely communication.
  • Use company phone and messaging systems to contact users and manage ongoing conversations.
  • Maintain accurate records of onboarding activity and customer interactions.

5. Issue Identification & Escalation

  • Identify potential platform bugs, technical issues, or recurring user challenges.
  • Gather relevant information and escalate technical issues to the appropriate team member.
  • Follow up on unresolved issues where necessary and keep users informed.
  • Use good judgment to distinguish between routine questions that can be handled independently and issues requiring additional support.

Requirements & Experience

  • Previous experience in customer service, customer success, client relations, onboarding, or a similar customer-facing role.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with clear communication and a professional telephone manner.
  • A friendly, patient, and personable approach when assisting different types of users.
  • Strong organisational skills and excellent follow-through.
  • Proactive and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple conversations and outstanding tasks independently.
  • Good judgment and the ability to learn new processes and systems quickly.
  • Comfortable using phone, email, messaging platforms, and CRM systems.
  • Strong attention to detail when managing user information, onboarding stages, and follow-up activities.
  • Able to work independently in a remote environment while communicating effectively with the wider team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting a healthcare, medical, or ABA-related business.
  • Familiarity with ABA services, RBTs, or healthcare staffing.
  • Experience onboarding users to a software platform, app, or online portal.
  • Experience working with a growing business or technology-enabled service.

Please note: Advanced technical skills and extensive Excel or Microsoft Office expertise are not required. The priority is finding someone with excellent communication skills, a strong customer-service mindset, and the ability to take ownership of the onboarding process.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and making their experience as smooth as possible. You should be comfortable following up without being pushy, explaining processes patiently, keeping track of outstanding tasks, and taking initiative when something needs attention.

The ideal candidate is dependable, personable, and naturally organised — someone who can build trust with providers and RBTs while ensuring the day-to-day onboarding process runs smoothly.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join a growing platform at an exciting stage of its development. You’ll play an important role in improving the customer experience, supporting platform growth, and helping build the processes needed as the business expands.

If you're a people-focused professional who takes pride in excellent service, clear communication, and getting things done, we’d love to hear from you!

Mercury is building the financial and banking* products founders actually want: one that’s fast, intuitive, and crafted to help them do more with their money. As AI changes how companies are built and run, we’re rethinking what Mercury can do for the people running them. We’re looking for a Tech Communications Lead to tell that story and to make Mercury the company founders, builders, and the broader tech world think of when it comes to AI and innovation in finance and banking. This includes:

  • Shaping and owning Mercury’s technology and innovation narrative, including how we’re building AI that helps founders and entrepreneurs run better
  • Partner with our co-founder and senior product and AI leaders to bring that story to market through integrated comms: podcasts, events, content, social, press, and more

In this role, you will report to our Head of Comms and own how the world understands Mercury’s approach to technology and AI. You’ll turn what our product and AI teams are building into stories that resonate with customers, prospects, future teammates, and investors, and you’ll put our leaders in the rooms and conversations that matter. You’ll join a creative, scrappy, and highly collaborative comms team where ideas move fast and you’ll have real ownership from day one. If you love sitting at the intersection of product, storytelling, and the startup ecosystem, and want to build something rather than maintain it, this role is for you.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:

  • Develop and own Mercury’s technology, AI, and innovation narrative, translating complex product and engineering work into clear, compelling stories for founders/entrepreneurs, SMBs, and the broader tech community
  • Partner closely with our co-founder and senior product and AI leaders to build their thought leadership platforms, including messaging, talking points, bylines, and social presence
  • Build and run an integrated comms program across podcasts, speaking opportunities, events, owned content, social media, and press to grow Mercury’s reputation in AI and innovation
  • Identify and secure high-impact podcast, conference, and media opportunities that put our leaders in front of customers, prospects, talent, and investors
  • Lead comms for product and AI launches in partnership with product marketing, ensuring every launch ladders up to a cohesive innovation story
  • Cultivate relationships with tech, AI, and startup journalists, creators, and podcast hosts
  • Create and edit content such as blog posts, executive social posts, talks, and briefing docs, and coach spokespeople to deliver them with confidence
  • Keep a pulse on the AI and fintech landscape, spotting trends, competitive moves, and moments where Mercury can lead the conversation
  • Measure what’s working and use those insights to sharpen strategy over time
  • Use AI tools to scale the team’s output and experiment with new formats, workflows, and ways of reaching our audiences

You should:

  • Have 7-10 years of experience in communications with significant time spent on tech, product, or AI storytelling at a high-growth startup or tech company
  • Be a hands-on, fluent user of AI tools in your own work, whether for research, workflow automation, or content and be excited to find new ways AI can make a small comms team punch above its weight
  • Have a track record of building executive and founder thought leadership programs, especially across podcasts, speaking, and social
  • Be able to take technical concepts like AI products and infrastructure and make them clear, human, and exciting without losing accuracy
  • Be an exceptional writer and editor with a sharp sense of narrative and voice
  • Have strong relationships with, or a clear ability to build relationships with, tech and AI media, podcasters, and creators
  • Be comfortable working directly with founders and senior leaders, earning their trust and pushing back when needed
  • Be a builder at heart: scrappy, resourceful, and energized by creating programs from scratch in a fast-moving environment
  • Be genuinely curious about AI, startups, and the founder journey

We are seeking a seasoned SAP Finance Functional Analyst to drive the optimization and strategic implementation of our financial ecosystem. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and technical SAP solutions, ensuring seamless operations across treasury, cash management, and financial planning. Your expertise will be instrumental in enhancing liquidity visibility, streamlining payment processes, and maintaining robust risk management frameworks, directly contributing to the organization's financial stability and operational efficiency.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in configuring In-House Cash, In-House Banking, and Payment Factory environments.
  • Strong technical background in FX Rate Integration and SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM).
  • Extensive experience with SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementations and migrations.
  • Ability to manage complex Banking Integrations and Electronic Bank Statement processing workflows.
  • Compensation range: ₹15-18 LPA.

raw.description:
Independent | Referral Commission | 5% of Collected Revenue

Who We're Looking For

You know people.

Executives. Business owners. HR leaders. Organizational decision-makers. People you've worked with, advised, done business with, or built professional relationships with over the years.

And every once in a while, you hear about a problem and immediately think:

I know who needs this.

SteadyState is looking for professionals who can make meaningful introductions to organizations that may need our work.

  • You don't have to become a salesperson.

  • You don't have to prospect.

  • You don't have to run the sale.

You make the right introduction. We take it from there.

What We Do

SteadyState™ Work Partners is a human capital consulting firm specializing in human capital risk mitigation.

We work with organizations when a valuable person's Heat-of-the-Moment actions or inaction are creating business consequences—and knowing better hasn't been enough to stop it.

Our proprietary TAU Core™ intervention develops the I Caught Myself Reflex™: the ability to interrupt an automatic reaction before it becomes consequential action or inaction.

TAU Core™ includes an in-person component delivered in Austin, Texas.

What Counts as a Referral

A referral is more than the name of a company. You know the person and make the introduction.

For example:

Not a referral:
“You should call ABC Company. They need this.”

A referral:
“I know the HR leader at ABC Company. I've told her about SteadyState and that the service includes participation in Austin. She's interested in talking with you. I'll introduce you.”

You don't have to sell the service or determine whether it's right for them. You make the qualified introduction. SteadyState owns the sales process from there.

We determine whether there is a business opportunity, lead the conversations, answer questions, develop the engagement, and close the business.

Your responsibility is the introduction.

Who You Might Know

You may know an organization dealing with:

  • A valuable employee they don't want to lose

  • A manager whose actions or inaction keep creating problems

  • Recurring conflict, complaints, or performance incidents

  • Customer or business consequences tied to employee behavior

  • Someone the organization has already invested substantially in developing

  • A problem that training, coaching, or other interventions haven't resolved

The organization does not have to be headquartered in Texas.

It does need to be willing to send its participant(s) to Austin, Texas, for the in-person portion of TAU Core™.

You don't need to diagnose the problem or determine whether SteadyState is the answer. If you recognize the situation, know the right person, and they're interested in the conversation, introduce us.

Compensation

5% of collected revenue on eligible new business resulting from your qualifying referral.

For example: One $25,000 engagement = $1,250 referral commission.

There is no minimum number of referrals required. Make one introduction or make several.

If an eligible referral becomes a paying SteadyState client and SteadyState collects the revenue, you get paid. If the referral does not result in collected revenue, no commission is earned.

What You Don't Have to Do

You are not responsible for:

  • Prospecting or cold calling

  • Managing a sales pipeline

  • Conducting sales meetings

  • Preparing proposals

  • Negotiating the engagement

  • Closing the sale

  • Meeting sales quotas

Your job is to open a door that you can genuinely open. SteadyState handles what happens after that.

Where You Will Work

You can be located anywhere in the United States.

There is no set schedule and no required volume of referrals.

Your connections may be in Texas or elsewhere. What matters is that the organization understands that SteadyState's in-person work is currently delivered in Austin and is willing to send participants there if it decides to engage us.

This opportunity can exist alongside your current career, consulting work, business, retirement, or other professional activities, subject to any obligations or conflict-of-interest requirements that apply to you.

The Question

Who came to mind while you were reading this?

If you know an executive, business owner, HR leader, or organizational decision-maker who should know about SteadyState—and they're open to sending their people to Austin if the service makes sense—make the connection.

About the Role

We are hiring an organized, proactive Executive Virtual Assistant to be a dependable remote operations partner for a growing family entertainment business. This role is a strong fit for someone who has supported a founder, executive, small business owner, or busy team and enjoys keeping communications, priorities, and follow-ups organized.

You will bring the strengths of a great Executive VA: sound judgment, initiative, attention to detail, and the ability to move tasks forward without constant direction. This is also a hands-on, customer-facing position that includes phone and email support, booking inquiries, sales follow-up, and community outreach, not just traditional executive calendar or inbox management.

You will help families receive timely, consistent support for birthday parties, group visits, memberships, and other inquiries. You will also coordinate follow-ups, build relationships with schools and community organizations, and help marketing and day-to-day business operations stay on track.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Communication, Booking Support & Follow-Up

  • Serve as a reliable point of contact by answering and returning customer calls, emails, voicemails, and online inquiries promptly and professionally.

  • Assist customers with questions about birthday parties, group visits, memberships, admissions, schedules, policies, pricing, and availability.

  • Track birthday inquiries, missed calls, abandoned bookings, and prospective customers, then follow through to help turn interest into confirmed bookings.

  • Keep customer notes and communications accurate and organized so information stays consistent across channels and team members.

  • Identify complaints, exceptions, or concerns that require management attention and escalate them appropriately.

2. Lead Tracking, Outreach & Relationship Coordination

  • Organize CRM contacts, opportunities, notes, pipeline stages, next steps, and follow-up dates so information is easy for the team to act on.

  • Take ownership of follow-up lists and keep active leads moving until they are booked, completed, or appropriately closed.

  • Research and conduct outreach to schools, PTOs, daycares, preschools, homeschool groups, sports organizations, churches, and community partners.

  • Support opportunities such as group visits, field trips, fundraisers, community events, birthday parties, and partnership programs.

  • Provide concise updates on outreach, open opportunities, outstanding decisions, and next actions.

3. Executive VA & Business Operations Support

  • Coordinate approved customer email campaigns, audience lists, promotions, reactivation efforts, and basic campaign tracking.

  • Maintain the marketing content calendar, schedule approved social media posts, and assist with simple graphics and promotional materials.

  • Support employee scheduling, recruiting coordination, onboarding administration, and routine communication with vendors, candidates, and partners.

  • Keep trackers, shared files, templates, task lists, documentation, and standard operating procedures organized and up to date.

  • Assist with additional administrative needs such as ordering, inventory administration, payroll preparation, reporting, or website/content updates as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong spoken and written English for professional calls, emails, follow-ups, and internal updates.

  • Confident, approachable phone presence and willingness to speak directly with customers and partners.

  • Experience as an Executive Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, Administrative VA, Operations VA, Customer Support VA, or in a similar coordination role. Relevant transferable experience is welcome.

  • Excellent organization and attention to detail across inboxes, records, shared files, and trackers.

  • Ability to prioritize competing requests, manage deadlines, and keep multiple follow-ups moving.

  • Comfortable working independently and collaborating remotely with a U.S.-based team.

  • Consistent follow-through, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to pending tasks.

  • Comfortable learning new systems, following processes, and documenting or improving workflows.

  • Availability for the Tuesday to Saturday U.S. Central Time schedule (overnight hours in the Philippines).

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is an advantage:

  • Supporting a founder, executive, small business owner, or busy team

  • CRM, lead tracking, and customer follow-up

  • Email marketing, customer segmentation, or campaign coordination

  • Content calendars, social media scheduling, Canva, or basic content creation

  • Outbound outreach, partnership coordination, or sales support

  • Hospitality, events, family entertainment, party planning, or other customer-facing businesses

Tools You May Work With

You may work with tools for CRM and email marketing, business phone management, booking/POS, employee scheduling and payroll, Google Workspace, shared file management, workflow tracking, content creation, and website administration. Current systems include Brevo, Nextiva, LilyPad, Homebase, Google Workspace, Airtable, Google Drive, Canva, ChatGPT, and Base44. Familiarity with every platform is not required; being resourceful and willing to learn is important.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful when customers receive prompt, professional responses; bookings and leads are consistently followed up; important tasks and records stay organized; outreach and marketing activities move forward; and the owner or team can rely on you to handle recurring operational work with minimal supervision.

raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Tenant
raw.excerpt: What We’re BuildingHoneycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do!
raw.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

Honeycomb is an observability platform that helps engineering teams understand how their software behaves in production. Our Tenant team is behind Honeycomb Private Cloud, a brand new product that allows customers to have their own Honeycomb instance.

What you'll do

  • Own delivery of Honeycomb Private Cloud — the infrastructure, tooling, and operational processes that let enterprise customers run Honeycomb inside their own cloud environment.
  • Grow the product — we anticipate significant growth in the next year; help us meet sales goals and build relationships to support it.
  • Work at the customer boundary — partner with Field Engineering, Support, and Sales on PoCs, security reviews, access negotiations, and contract asks, and help the team know when to take feedback and when to help us show the customer what good looks like.
  • Lead across the org — Private Cloud depends on many engineering teams across the org. We maintain a tight drift between SaaS and Private Cloud, and this role will need to be able to understand and prioritize work that touches all parts of our engineering org.
  • Feedback loops for developers. We learn a lot about Honeycomb as a product while building Honeycomb. Ensure that we push Private-Cloud-inspired tooling back into our SaaS infrastructure so each side continues to make the other better.
  • Build the team — grow and develop a small, tenured, senior, very high-context team; remove the single points of failure that come with that; hire and onboard the next engineers to scale the team as the product offering scales.

What we're looking for

  • 1+ year as an Engineering manager for a highly technical, senior team.
  • You have a solid track record as an engineer, influencing without authority, and leaving things better than you found them.
  • You've managed or led a team that carried a real production on-call rotation, and you treat operational health as a core requirement.
  • Experience shipping and operating software in environments you don't fully control — on-prem, private cloud, BYOC, or managed single-tenant. You know what version skew, partial telemetry, and customer security constraints do to a roadmap.
  • Enough Kubernetes and AWS fluency to review a design, ask the challenging questions, and be useful in an incident review. You don't need to be the person writing the Terraform.
  • Comfort being customer-facing with enterprise buyers: security questionnaires, access models, procurement, escalations.
  • Ruthless prioritization on a small team with an enormous surface area — you can name what you decided not to do, and why.
  • Hiring and onboarding engineers into a domain with a steep ramp.
  • Comfort with AI tooling, and a point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

Bonus points

  • Familiarity with observability / OpenTelemetry (Honeycomb's domain).
  • You're still hands-on and enjoy contributing to and reviewing code (welcome, but it won't be your primary role here).
  • Background in Go, Terraform, Kafka, and large-scale data infrastructure.
  • FedRAMP, GovCloud, or regulated-industry compliance experience.
  • A field-adjacent past — solutions architecture, consulting, or deployment engineering.
Base Salary based on level of experience
$285,000—$320,000 CAD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes.
For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice.
If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact . Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

raw.excerpt: COMPANY OVERVIEW Hanwha Renewables, headquartered in Irvine, California, a member of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 firm that is among the eight largest business enterprises in South Korea.
raw.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Hanwha Renewables, headquartered in Irvine, California, a member of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 firm that is among the eight largest business enterprises in South Korea. Hanwha Renewables designs, builds and manages renewable energy solutions. The company brings a decade of global leadership in renewable energy to North America, combining best-of-world technology, processes, and partnerships to deliver utility-grade energy solutions customized for local energy markets. Hanwha Renewables offers the full spectrum of energy solutions – from power plant development, design, construction, operations, and maintenance. With proven capabilities across the renewable energy value chain, Hanwha Renewables minimizes uncertainty and risk, and helps customers achieve a higher return on their investment in renewable energy.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the Sr Development Engineer will be responsible for technical diligence, design, energy performance forecasts, performance analyses and verification for hundreds of megawatts of PV and ESS development projects and operating facilities. S/he will support Project Development and Preconstruction project startup phases with hands-on design engineering, energy performance modeling, technical specifications data analysis and interpretation for Solar, Solar plus Storage and Standalone Storage projects up to 1 GW; and will provide technical support and inputs for PPA and EPC RFP Exhibit preparations. Occasional travel to project sites throughout North America will be required. Remote working from a location close to a major airport in the US will be considered for suitably experienced candidates with evidence or references regarding their ability to manage and deliver first class work in a similar situation.

The employee may be required to perform other job-related duties as requested by management. All duties will be assigned in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Consolidate project information and inputs to conduct site technical diligence, feasibility analysis, risk identification and design layouts and reviews in support of M&A acquisitions and cost estimations
  • Perform conceptual or preliminary design evaluations using Helioscope, PlantPredict, SIFT, PVCASE and/or AUTOCAD design software to support site diligence and cost estimation for Green Field and M&A projects.
  • Perform energy production forecasting modeling and analysis activities using PVSYST for all development projects and operating facilities and support technical diligence on site selection and project acquisitions.
  • Implement energy production modeling analysis and provide modeling inputs to assist with the optimization of system designs for PV and ESS projects, to achieve targets for production yield, generating capacity, capital cost, financial returns, etc.
  • Evaluate and implement energy input assessments, including 3D shading and terrain models using PVSYST, Helios 3D and other related tools to simulate associated losses; soiling estimation based on site conditions and array technology. Perform analyses to optimize forecast and actual production and enhance project value.
  • Contribute to the development of technical team capability, technology roadmap, software tools, project and engineering management processes, etc.
  • Collaborate with colleagues, consultants, and contractors, and facilitate virtual and in-person meetings to achieve efficient use of resources, meet deadlines for deliverables, minimize delays, avoid crises, and resolve conflicts.
  • Support the ongoing search for improved system performance by contributing to evaluations of new techniques, technologies, systems, and components, and being a resource regarding emerging best practices, products, technologies, and techniques in the clean energy industry.
  • Follow up on RFIs with third-party contractors and consultants for timely completion of engineering deliverables. Experience using Procore software is an advantage.
  • Contribute to the development of technical scopes-of-work, contract exhibits and specifications in support of EPC RFP process.
  • Proven ability to work independently and proactively, with experience working with cross-functional teams including Business Development, Procurement and Project Management.
  • Basic understanding of solar project schedules, cost estimation or construction is preferred.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS, MS or higher degree in Electrical, Civil or Mechanical Engineering, Renewable Energy, Physics, or closely related numerate discipline.
  • At least five years of hands-on experience in conducting project site diligence, design engineering, performance modeling and energy forecasting for Utility-scale PV, PV plus BESS in the solar project development, energy project development spaces, or specialist technical consulting environment.
  • Exposure to Plant Predict, NREL System Advisor Model, or Helioscope is an advantage.
  • Previous exposure to one or more of: PV module manufacturing quality assurance, PV module performance evaluation and testing; renewable energy project development; solar plant performance and/or operations, testing and troubleshooting of inverters or generators.
  • Strong communications skills and ability to clearly convey technical information, both verbally and in writing, to diverse audiences, including technical teams, stakeholders, and non-technical individuals.
  • Proactive and problem solver with ability to identify and address potential technical issues before they escalate. Demonstrates foresight in identifying potential challenges and proposing solutions to mitigate risks.
  • Polished interpersonal, technical writing, and presentation skills.
  • Proficient computer skills using MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook.
  • Detail-oriented and self-motivated with the ability to manage and prioritize concurrent tasks, and to work effectively in a collaborative virtual environment.
  • Ability and willingness to travel occasionally to project sites (often in remote locations), to lead or participate in meetings or seminars, and when necessary to work overtime on short notice.

COMPENSATION: $165,000 - $185,000 salary

Attention external recruitment firms, we will not accept any unsolicited resumes at this time. Please do not contact any internal member of our company to discuss the position or to solicit candidates.

Hanwha Renewables provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics.
