raw.description:
About Harper

Harper is one runtime for any workload. We combine database, cache, application logic, real-time messaging, and APIs into a single process, so enterprise teams can retire a stack of point solutions and serve data in about a millisecond. Brands like Macy's, Ralph Lauren, Verizon, HP, Ford and Bass Pro Shops run on Harper, and we sell and deliver alongside partners including Akamai.

The role

You own retention and growth across a focused book of Harper’s most strategic enterprise accounts, with revenue targets tied to renewals and expansion. Strong relationships on the customer side and inside Harper mean you’re the first to know when something isn’t going to plan, and your project management discipline gets it back on track.

This is not a technical support role. Harper’s engineers, forward-deployed engineers, and partner support teams own the technical work. You orchestrate them: route each ask through the right process, bring in the right people before the customer has to ask, and make sure nothing falls between the customer, Harper, and our partners. You’ll need enough product fluency to match Harper’s capabilities to a customer’s business needs and to recognize when an issue needs engineering.

The best person for this seat has grown large, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts and has the renewal and expansion numbers to show for it. You’re a highly organized operator who takes personal ownership of outcomes. You write a clear weekly update without being asked, you prepare a day ahead rather than an hour ahead, and you spot the next expansion opportunity before the customer’s team does.

What you'll do

Own the account

  • Be the single accountable owner for some of our most strategic enterprise accounts, from day-to-day status through renewal and expansion, partnering with Sales leadership on pricing and approvals.
  • Know each account cold and keep a written plan for it: history, champions, what was piloted and promised, open commitments, risks, renewal date, and expansion opportunities.
  • Keep a finger on the pulse of every live implementation. Track adoption and usage, and make sure customers get full value from Harper so it never becomes shelfware.
  • Stay relevant as customer priorities shift. Know their roadmap, connect Harper to their new initiatives, and advocate for what’s right for their architecture.

Run the work like a project manager

  • Run active customer initiatives (pilots, upgrades, migrations, rollouts) with a clear plan, owners, and dates, and track every open item to closure. When a follow-up is owed, it goes out within one business day.
  • Flag risk early and loudly. If a deal, pilot, or deliverable is stalled on the customer, a partner, or Harper, you say so in the right channel and keep pushing until it moves.
  • Keep a steady operating rhythm: agendas sent ahead of every customer and internal sync, notes and action items sent the same day, and a Monday plan and Friday wrap-up to the team each week.

Manage relationships across three sides

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with champions, executives, procurement, and project leads at each customer, and navigate reorgs and leadership changes so every account always has an active champion and executive sponsor.
  • Partner with our channel partners' account teams as true co-owners. Keep them informed on scope, services, and billing, and build the relationship before you need it.
  • Coordinate commercial items such as professional services scopes, SOWs, and contracts, so work is never delivered without paper.

Orchestrate Harper's internal team

  • Route technical questions through the established support and escalation paths, and bring the right Harper experts into customer conversations, brief them in advance, and own the follow-up afterward.
  • Write customer-facing documents (responses, recaps, QBR decks, and proposals) that are accurate, complete, and reviewed before they go out.
  • Bring customer feedback, references, and case studies back to Product and Marketing.

What you'll bring

Must-haves

  • 6+ years managing enterprise accounts in B2B software with Fortune 500 customers, multiple stakeholders per account, and a track record of negotiating renewals and expansions against a quota.
  • Real project management experience: you have run customer rollouts, pilots, or implementations with plans, owners, dates and status reporting.
  • Experience working with or through channel partners, resellers, or alliance partners on shared accounts.
  • Excellent communication skills. Your recaps, updates, and customer documents are clear, accurate and ready to send.
  • You can connect a customer’s goals to the right product capabilities and spot expansion opportunities from their technical roadmap.
  • Fluency with a CRM and a project tracker (for example, HubSpot or Salesforce, and Asana).
  • Experience at a startup or small team, where you built the process instead of waiting for one.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with data infrastructure, CDN, cloud or developer platforms.
  • Accounts in retail, e-commerce, media or telecom.
  • Experience scoping and contracting professional services or SOWs.
  • A PMP, CSM or similar project management credential.
  • Experience with Harper

This role is not for you if

  • You prefer hunting new logos over growing within existing customers.
  • You need a manager to remind you about follow-ups or deadlines.
  • You would rather escalate a problem than own it.
  • You prefer a slower-paced environment where the day-to-day is predictable. Here, priorities shift with customer needs, and you’ll be juggling several accounts and initiatives at once.

Compensation and benefits

  • Base salary: $125,000–$145,000, depending on experience
    On-target earnings: $250,000 at 100% of plan
    Commission: uncapped, with accelerators above quota
  • Equity, health benefits and a 401(k).
  • Fully remote, with occasional travel to customer sites and team meetups.

Interview process

  1. 30-minute screen with People Operations.
  2. 45-minute conversation with the hiring manager.
  3. 60-minute working session: you get a mock account brief and present a 30-day plan, a risk log and a customer follow-up email.
  4. 45-minute panel with an engineer and a partner-facing teammate.
  5. 30-minute conversation with Harper leadership.

What success looks like

By 90 days, every account you own has a current written plan, a known renewal path and no surprises.

Timeframe

Outcome

30 days

Met every key stakeholder at each account and partner. Written history and stakeholder map for each account. Weekly Monday/Friday updates running.

60 days

Account plan and open-items tracker live for every account. Running the recurring customer syncs yourself. Every in-flight services engagement has signed paper or a dated path to it.

90 days

Leading at least one active customer initiative to its milestones. Partner account teams engaged on every shared account. One expansion opportunity qualified and in the pipeline.

12 months

Renewals closed on time. Expansion bookings against the agreed target. At least one customer reference or case study delivered to Marketing.

How we'll measure it

  • Gross and net revenue retention on your book
  • Expansion bookings against target
  • Follow-ups and weekly updates sent on time
  • Risks flagged before they slip a date, not after
  • Feedback from the customer, partner reps and Harper engineering on how easy you are to work with
Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 / year

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Project Manager, Marketing Operations

Location: Remote – Colombia,
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Independent Contractor
Industry: Technology / Software / Marketing Operations
Compensation: $2,167–$2,667 USD/month
English Proficiency: Strong Professional Written and Verbal English

About the Company

Our client is a leading U.S.-based technology company developing innovative software and digital solutions that help individuals and businesses manage financial operations, improve productivity, and make informed decisions.

Operating in a dynamic, data-driven environment, the company brings together cross-functional teams to deliver customer-focused solutions and support business growth.

Its marketing organization works across multiple business segments and regions, requiring strong operational coordination, consistent communication, and effective execution.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Manager, Marketing Operations to support the day-to-day operating rhythm of a marketing team focused on customer acquisition across two business segments.

This role serves as the operational backbone of the marketing team, ensuring recurring meetings, status updates, action items, and cross-team coordination remain organized and on track.

You will work closely with a senior marketing leader and two regional campaign leads, providing structure, visibility, and follow-through across parallel workstreams.

This is not a campaign strategy or hands-on campaign management role. Your responsibility is to keep operations running smoothly so marketing leaders can focus on strategy, execution, and business relationships.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Support a marketing organization within a major U.S.-based technology company.

  • Work directly with senior marketing leadership and regional campaign teams.

  • Coordinate high-visibility meetings and operational initiatives.

  • Help improve communication, accountability, and execution across teams.

  • Build valuable experience in marketing operations and cross-functional project coordination.

What You'll Do

Meeting Coordination & Executive Support

  • Coordinate recurring meetings, including senior leadership revenue reviews, cross-team alignment meetings, and weekly status updates.

  • Prepare agendas, organize meeting materials, and capture key decisions.

  • Document action items, responsible owners, deadlines, and next steps.

  • Track outstanding commitments and follow up until items are resolved.

  • Provide clear, structured meeting summaries and status reports.

Marketing Operations & Cross-Team Coordination

  • Coordinate activities between two regional marketing teams supporting shared customer acquisition objectives.

  • Maintain visibility into parallel workstreams and identify duplicated efforts, delays, or operational gaps.

  • Consolidate weekly status updates from regional campaign leads.

  • Track campaign progress at a high level without directly managing campaign execution.

  • Ensure stakeholders have accurate information about priorities, progress, and pending actions.

Process Improvement & Issue Resolution

  • Identify operational bottlenecks affecting marketing workflows or team collaboration.

  • Coordinate with marketing and sales stakeholders to resolve handoff issues.

  • Help distinguish between immediate operational fixes and longer-term process improvements.

  • Maintain organized tracking systems for decisions, deliverables, and follow-up items.

  • Recommend practical improvements to meeting cadence, reporting, and internal coordination.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in project coordination, marketing operations, sales operations, business operations, or a related support role.

  • Experience organizing recurring meetings, managing action items, and coordinating follow-ups.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex discussions into clear, actionable summaries.

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams without losing track of priorities or responsibilities.

  • Strong stakeholder communication and cross-functional coordination skills.

  • Ability to identify operational issues and proactively follow through on resolutions.

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.

  • Strong professional English communication skills for collaborating with U.S.-based teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting marketing or sales operations teams.

  • Familiarity with customer acquisition processes and marketing campaign workflows.

  • Experience coordinating regional or distributed teams.

  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools.

  • General knowledge of marketing platforms, CRM systems, or marketing automation tools.

Note: Hands-on CRM administration, marketing automation expertise, and campaign execution experience are not required.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be evaluated through:

  • Recurring meetings are well-prepared, organized, and consistently documented.

  • Decisions, action items, and owners are clearly captured and followed through.

  • Regional marketing teams remain aligned on priorities and progress.

  • Weekly status updates are accurate, timely, and easy to understand.

  • Operational bottlenecks and duplicated efforts are identified early.

  • Marketing and sales handoff issues are efficiently coordinated toward resolution.

  • Senior leadership receives reliable visibility into ongoing work without needing to manage day-to-day logistics.

Why Join Us?

  • $2,167–$2,667 USD/month compensation.

  • Fully remote opportunity from Colombia, Mexico, or Chile.

  • Collaborate with an established U.S.-based technology company.

  • Work closely with senior marketing leaders and cross-functional teams.

  • Gain exposure to customer acquisition operations across multiple business segments.

  • Make a direct impact on team efficiency, communication, and operational execution.

Important Notes

This is a marketing operations coordination role, not a marketing strategy, paid media, or campaign management position.

Candidates should demonstrate strong organizational skills, structured communication, meeting coordination, and consistent follow-through.

Experience with marketing technology is beneficial but not mandatory. The role does not require hands-on CRM or marketing automation system administration.

The position is remote and open to candidates based in Colombia, Mexico, or Chile.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

raw.description:
The Academic Program Director (PD) is a key leadership position within the university; he/she/they promote and support a quality academic experience for learners by ensuring an engaging courseroom environment that facilitates achievement of program outcomes. The Program Director has oversight of curricula quality and rigor, and works to ensure curricula are professionally relevant, current, efficient, effective, and cohesive. This management position contributes to a range of activities related to excellence in curriculum design/delivery and assessment effectiveness, learner success, satisfaction and engagement. work closely with deans, assistant/associate deans, and faculty directors, as well as relevant university departments, to manage systems and processes related to curriculum creation and delivery. He/she/they coordinate with the relevant faculty directors to remain aware of issues related to discipline content. The Program Director acts as a liaison to other departments including Portfolio Strategy, Doctoral Affairs, Course Development, Center for Faculty Excellence, Faculty Hiring, HR, Accreditation and Institutional Effectiveness, Learner Affairs, and others as required.
  • Spearhead and oversee the development and revision of academic offerings.
  • Utilize analytics and evidence-based practices to develop and execute actions that drive continuous quality improvement application in learner success, teaching, engagement, academic quality, and curricula development.
  • Preside over efforts to ensure appropriate academic programmatic accreditation and/or licensure is obtained and maintained.
  • Ensure assigned academic offerings align with professional trends and standards, while seeking professional validation wherever possible (in the way of credentials, licensure, alignment with existing or emerging standards/programmatic requirements, etc.)
  • Oversight of curriculum development according to external standards and in alignment with university design principles; supervision of SME course development and leadership.
  • Lead specialized accreditation process, self-study, etc.; ensure alignment to HLC best practices in university faculty oversight of curriculum.
  • Build and nurture internal and external partnerships and relationships that drive success of the school and academic offerings.
  • Orchestrate and optimize course offering/scheduling.
  • Supervise Core faculty; conduct Core faculty performance reviews.
  • Host faculty meetings focused on program and curricula.
  • Collaborate with Faculty Director on the hiring of new faculty.
  • Address learner programmatic issues (academic, professional disposition, behaviors).
  • Teach or mentor once a quarter.
  • All other duties as assigned.

  • — Knowledge of principles and methods for curriculum development, andragogy, and assessment.
    • Knowledge of online teaching, competency-based education, and direct assessment.
    • Discipline knowledge.
    • Ability to objectively analyze program/course quality data and implement recommendations relevant to improving learner outcomes.
    • Ability to maintain program compliance with all regulatory rules, and national program accreditation standards.
    • Familiarity with program development and evaluation.
    • Ability to advise and assess learning effectiveness and quality of the education experience.
    • Ability to provide significant impact on learner retention plus direct impact on cost, revenue and quality assurance within a program area.
  • Navigation – Integration of program, academic and regulatory considerations with business strategies and plans.
    • Manage multiple academic and administrative projects.
    • Resolve multi-faceted types of problems encountered involving courses, faculty, regulatory or administrative issues.
  • Adaptability/Flexibility — Open to change.
    • Drive results despite ambiguity.

Olá, nós somos a Panini! =)

Somos uma editora e uma das principais responsáveis pela produção e distribuição de História em Quadrinhos e Álbuns de Figurinhas do Brasil. Trabalhamos com diversas licenças, como Marvel, Disney, Vertigo, DC, Maurício de Sousa entre outras, e temos a missão de levar o entretenimento e boas histórias para casa dos nossos leitores.

A Panini está em busca de Editores Freelancerspara colaborar em futuros projetos editoriais, incluindo livros, revistas, histórias em quadrinhos, mangás, álbuns, coleções especiais e produtos colecionáveis.

Buscamos profissionais criativos, organizados e com olhar editorial, capazes de transformar ideias e conteúdos em produtos relevantes, garantindo qualidade, coerência, alinhamento ao público e excelência em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento editorial.

Principais Atividades e Possíveis Projetos

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento editorial de livros, revistas, HQs, mangás, álbuns, coleções e projetos especiais;
  • Acompanhar todas as etapas do processo editorial, desde a concepção da ideia até a entrega do produto final;
  • Desenvolver conceitos editoriais, propostas de conteúdo, estruturas de publicação e direcionamentos criativos;
  • Elaborar e revisar briefings editoriais para orientar equipes internas, colaboradores e fornecedores;
  • Realizar curadoria, seleção e organização de conteúdos conforme o objetivo do projeto e o perfil do público-alvo;
  • Acompanhar traduções, adaptações, revisões e demais etapas necessárias para a produção editorial;
  • Garantir a consistência de linguagem, identidade editorial e qualidade dos materiais desenvolvidos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com tradutores, revisores, ilustradores, designers, diagramadores e equipes de produção;
  • Avaliar textos, imagens, ilustrações e elementos gráficos, garantindo alinhamento com a proposta editorial;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar projetos de colecionáveis, considerando conteúdo, formato, experiência do consumidor e apelo para colecionadores;
  • Acompanhar cronogramas editoriais, garantindo organização e cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Interagir com áreas de Marketing, Produto, Licenciamento e demais envolvidos no desenvolvimento das publicações;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de marcas e propriedades intelectuais licenciadas.
  • Experiência comprovada em edição e desenvolvimento de conteúdos editoriais;
  • Conhecimento do mercado de livros, revistas, quadrinhos, mangás, coleções ou entretenimento;
  • Habilidade para desenvolver conceitos, estruturar conteúdos e conduzir projetos editoriais;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com diferentes formatos, públicos e estilos de publicação;
  • Criatividade, senso editorial e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Organização, autonomia e comprometimento com prazos.

Informações adicionais

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com editoras, cultura pop, entretenimento, quadrinhos, mangás ou produtos licenciados;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de coleções, livros ilustrados e produtos para fãs/colecionadores;
  • Experiência com propriedades intelectuais licenciadas e aprovação de materiais com licenciadores;
  • Conhecimento de processos gráficos, produção editorial e fechamento de publicações;
  • Experiência com projetos especiais, edições comemorativas e produtos colecionáveis;

raw.excerpt: Who is ScriptPro? Imagine working at a place where innovation meets impact, and every day brings new opportunities to revolutionize the pharmacy industry!
raw.description:
Who is ScriptPro?

Imagine working at a place where innovation meets impact, and every day brings new opportunities to revolutionize the pharmacy industry! At ScriptPro, you’ll be part of a dynamic team that’s at the cutting edge of technology, creating solutions that make a real difference in people’s lives. ScriptPro develops, sells, and supports state of the art robotics and services in thousands of pharmacy settings around the United States and Canada.

ScriptPro’s Customer Service department delivers high-quality support across a range of products and systems, helping customers navigate technical challenges with confidence. This team operates in a fast-paced environment where problem-solving, adaptability, and continuous learning are key. Every interaction is an opportunity to make a direct impact by resolving issues, building customer trust, and playing a critical role in the overall customer experience.

Job Summary: The Technical Support Analyst is responsible for responding to inbound customer service calls to provide remote support problem resolution with the highest level of professionalism and courtesy. Responsible for opening service requests in a ticketing system that allows for organizing, tracking, and escalating of customer inquiries that range from general “how to” questions to more advanced technical issues. The Technical Support Analyst may also assist with customer support projects and/or research projects, as needed. This is a remote work from home position regardless of location. There will be required 3 week onsite training at our headquarters in Mission, KS.

Reporting Relationship:Supervisor, Technical Support

Shift: Sunday through Thursday 9:00 am - 5:30 pm CST. This role is primarily performed remotely, though Kansas City Metro employees may be required to work on-campus periodically according to business need. Regular, punctual, and predictable attendance is an essential function of every job at ScriptPro.

Scope of the Role:

  • Analyze, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair ScriptPro systems, hardware, and computer peripherals
  • Maintain, upgrade, or replace software systems and provide hardware support
  • Support and maintain user account information including rights, security, and systems groups
  • Maintain progressive knowledge of ScriptPro systems
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications:

  • Requires a minimum of an Associate’s degree in an engineering or technology related field or a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, or 2 years of related experience
  • Basic Windows OS Knowledge (XP/7/10/11)
  • Requires working knowledge of desktop and peripheral troubleshooting
  • Preferred familiarity with a ticketing or service desk software application and SLA driven resolution times
  • Problem solving and analytical skills
  • Positive attitude, drive and tenacity
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to multitask with varying priorities and attention to detail
  • All candidates must possess a valid driver’s license and be willing to travel by air for work-related duties if located outside the area

Preferred Skills:

  • Knowledge of ScriptPro systems
  • Experience in pharmacy

Remote Work Requirements:

  • Must have high-speed reliable internet access with a hard-wired connection
  • Must have a distraction free home office workspace
  • Must be willing to participate in video virtual meetings (camera on)

Compensation and Benefits:

The compensation range for this role has been established at $24.00 hourly or $50K annually.The final agreed-upon compensation is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to individual education, qualifications, skills, prior work experience, competencies, and geographic work location. The above compensation range represents the Company’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.

At ScriptPro, we believe that our employees are our greatest asset. That’s why we are committed to fostering a workplace that prioritizes and enhances your personal health and well-being.

  • Health: Medical, Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance & Long-Term Disability, 24/7 on campus Gym, and Vitality Wellness Program that helps lower your premium costs
  • Well-being: Paid Time Off (PTO, Maternity, Paternity, Adoption Leave), nine (9) paid holidays, paid volunteer hours, Employee Assistance Program, company-sponsored events and team-building activities, 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, financial investment services, employee discounts on products and services.

Employment Conditions:

It is ScriptPro's policy to run a comprehensive background check post job offer and you must be able to obtain Department of Defense security clearance after date of hire. See Standard Form 85 to preview requirements.

This position includes responsibilities for ensuring compliance with cybersecurity and privacy policies to support the safeguarding sensitive data, including personally identifiable information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI). Completion of annual cybersecurity and privacy awareness training is required, as the role aligns with the organization’s security posture and risk management practices. All duties are defined in accordance with standardizations to ensure consistency and accountability of the policies.

Working Conditions:

Requires routine use of standard equipment and extended computer use. Candidates must be able to sit, use hands and fingers, and occasionally lift, squat, stoop, bend, and reach. Problem-solving, practical learning, and instruction interpretation skills are essential.

ScriptPro appreciates the unique qualities of each team member, and as an Equal Opportunity employer, does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, pregnancy, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

The company utilizes internal resources for sourcing and filling positions, but when external assistance is needed, will engage only with pre-approved, contracted agency partners.

The company does not offer visa sponsorships, and all applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States.

Please visit to learn more about the mission of our company.

Senior Product Manager, AI Enablement - Analytics: Capital One Shopping (Remote-Eligible)

Come join our growing team in Capital One Shopping - the AI Enablement team builds and owns the AI products and platforms the rest of the organization runs on.


Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.


We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with deep data platform experience to own Shopping’s agentic analytics platform. Applied AI experience is a plus, and we value candidates who are builders and actively use AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to prototype rather than specify, and who’d rather ship a PoC than write a doc about it. Show us what you’ve built.


Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:


  • Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
  • Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
  • Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
  • Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
  • Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

What we are looking for:

  • Deep experience with enterprise data and how it’s defined and governed (semantic and metrics layers, data catalogs, ontologies, warehouse and BI, etc.)
  • Familiarity with tools across the modern data stack (dbt, LookML, Snowflake, Databricks, Palantir Foundry, Looker, Mode, etc.)
  • Familiarity with how AI agents work across structured data (text-to-SQL, tool use, evals, and where these systems fail)
  • Someone who has adjudicated metric disputes and made the decision stick
  • A builder who would rather be in the tools prototyping than be dependent on someone else to run them
  • Comfort with backend and internal platform products, where the users are diverse business and technical teams, and the measure is whether they trust the outputs
  • A strategic thought leader who can create a compelling vision and story to present to senior executives and inspire direct and partner teams
  • A strong communicator who can advance initiatives and create consensus through clear, concise, and contextually relevant messaging
  • Someone who works with minimal direction and a mandate that’s still taking shape
  • Deep work experience handling large data files using SQL, Python, and/or R

What you’ll do:

  • Partner with platform engineers to build and operate AI products that teams across Shopping depend on, starting with an agentic analytics platform
  • Understand the enterprise data requirements and ensure the system’s compliance with enterprise patterns
  • Define what a system needs to know to be trusted (the data, the definitions, the context behind both)
  • Set the boundaries for what agents can and can’t do, and prove those boundaries hold in practice
  • Relentlessly push to understand user and stakeholder needs and ensure they are considered in prioritization and trade-off discussions
  • Make each successive deployment cheaper and faster than the last
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with leaders and stakeholders that depend on the capabilities and performance of our platforms
  • Define, socialize, and monitor key performance indicators to understand the evolution and success of the project

Basic Qualifications:

  • At least 4 years of experience in Product Management, Solutions or Deployment Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Data Analytics experience
  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
    • A Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field), Business or Marketing
    • OR
    • Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 4 years of Product Management, Solutions or Deployment Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Data Analytics experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of Product Management, Solutions or Deployment Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Data Analytics experience, including ownership of an internal platform or a production deployment into a real operating environment
  • 4+ years of experience working directly in data, with a deep proficiency in SQL
  • Experience defining and governing metrics across teams that did not agree
  • Experience with semantic layers, metrics layers, or ontologies (dbt, LookML, Cube, Palantir Foundry, or comparable)

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.


Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at theCapital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.

raw.description:
Location: Remote (EMEA region)

Reports to: Senior Product Manager

Travel: Quarterly travel to Frankfurt or Hamburg, Germany

About Stonebranch:

Stonebranch builds IT orchestration and automation solutions that transform business IT environments from simple IT task automation into sophisticated, real-time business service orchestration. No matter the degree of automation, the Stonebranch platform is simple, modern, and secure. Using Stonebranch Universal Automation Center (UAC), enterprises can seamlessly orchestrate workloads and data across hybrid IT environments. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with points of contact and support throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, Stonebranch serves some of the world’s largest financial, manufacturing, healthcare, travel, transportation, energy, and technology institutions.

Your Part in this Growth Story:

Stonebranch is searching for an ABAP Technical Lead to own the technical direction of BatchMan, our SAP-native workload automation product. We want someone who takes full accountability for a business-critical codebase and moves it forward without waiting to be told what to build next. BatchMan runs inside SAP as an add-on. It extends SAP's native job scheduling into landscape-wide workload automation for more than 160 customers, ranging from long-established SAP enterprises to early technology adopters. The architecture decisions you make will shape how the product performs, evolves, and serves those customers for years to come.

This is a role built for where engineering is heading. We are transforming BatchMan development to an AI-first, specification-driven approach, and you'll lead that transformation. Using Claude Code as your primary AI agent, you'll write the technical specifications that drive development, then direct and verify AI-generated code with the senior judgment to catch what the AI gets wrong. That leaves your deepest focus for architecture and the hard technical decisions. On a codebase with more than 15 years of history, that judgment matters most. Knowing where classic ABAP and modern ABAP differ, and where the critical details hide, is what makes AI a force multiplier rather than a risk.

You'll join a small, focused team made up of an experienced fellow developer, AI agents, and the Senior Product Manager who owns the product. This is an individual contributor role with no people-management responsibilities. You will, however, make the high-level architecture decisions for BatchMan and set the engineering standards the codebase is built against. You'll also be the escalation point for our Customer Support team on complex technical issues, and you'll work directly with customers when an escalation calls for it. Because our customer base is largely German-speaking, business-fluent German is required.

Deep, hands-on ABAP expertise is essential. That includes experience building or maintaining a commercially shipped SAP add-on, not only customer-specific extensions. What sets you apart is ownership: the drive to make this product yours and keep it strong over the long term.

This is a remote position open to candidates based anywhere in EMEA, with a preference for candidates located near a Stonebranch office. Quarterly travel to our EMEA headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany or our Honico office in Hamburg, Germany is required. This role reports directly to the Senior Product Manager.

Your Impact on the Organization:

Technical Ownership & Architecture

  • Own the technical architecture of BatchMan and make the high-level design decisions that set the product's direction within the SAP landscape
  • Establish and maintain the engineering standards, coding conventions, and best practices that the BatchMan codebase is built against
  • Maintain and modernize a codebase that spans classic ABAP4, ABAP OO, and Java-based agent components, keeping it stable for existing customers while the product continues to evolve
  • Translate product requirements into sound technical solutions, balancing speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

AI-First Development & Code Quality

  • Lead the transformation of BatchMan's development pipeline to an AI-first approach, with Claude Code as the primary AI agent
  • Write clear, detailed technical specifications that serve as the foundation for AI-driven development
  • Direct, review, and verify AI-generated ABAP and Java code, applying senior judgment to catch errors, enforce standards, and protect architectural integrity
  • Build the documentation, context, and conventions that let AI agents work effectively and safely within a mature SAP codebase
  • Take part in peer code review to hold the codebase to a consistent quality bar

Product Development & Performance

  • Design and build new capabilities that extend SAP background processing and job scheduling into landscape-wide workload automation
  • Develop and maintain integrations through XBP/XMI, RFC, and web technologies (OData, REST) that connect BatchMan to the broader automation landscape
  • Optimize performance for high-volume job processing and large data volumes, including SQL tuning
  • Package and deliver releases through the SAP Transport System and Add-On Assembly Kit (AAK), so installations and upgrades run reliably across customer SAP environments

Customer Escalation & Collaboration

  • Serve as the technical escalation point for Customer Support, diagnosing and resolving complex issues beyond their scope
  • Engage directly with customers, in German or English, when an escalation requires hands-on technical involvement
  • Partner with the Senior Product Manager on roadmap feasibility, effort estimates, and technical trade-offs, and communicate technical direction clearly to both technical and business stakeholders
  • Collaborate closely with the team's other developer and share knowledge so that critical product expertise is not held by a single person

What You Will Bring to the Team:

Education and Experience

  • Degree in computer science or a related field, or completed vocational IT training (e.g., Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung) with equivalent professional experience
  • 10+ years of professional experience in software development
  • 8+ years of hands-on ABAP development experience, including substantial work in classic procedural ABAP (ABAP4)
  • Proven experience building or maintaining a commercially shipped SAP add-on or product, not solely customer-specific extensions or module customizations
  • Track record of owning a technical area and making the architecture decisions that shape it

Technical Skills

  • Expert-level command of ABAP4 and ABAP OO, including Dynpro UI, ALV, and the SAP Control Framework
  • Deep knowledge of SAP background processing and job scheduling:
    • SM36/SM37 for job definition and monitoring
    • SM50/SM66 for active work process analysis
    • ST22 for dump analysis on failed job steps
  • Hands-on experience with the XBP (External Batch Processing) and XMI interfaces
  • RFC programming and debugging, including configuring RFC connections in SM59
  • Strong understanding of core ABAP concepts, including authorization objects, lock objects, and LUWs
  • SQL optimization for large data volumes
  • Working knowledge of the SAP Transport System
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) and a strong interest in building an AI-first, specification-driven development workflow; experience writing specifications that drive AI-generated code is a strong plus
  • This is a hands-on technical role: day-to-day work combines writing specifications, directing AI agents, and reviewing and verifying code, with direct ABAP development where it's needed

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience packaging and delivering add-ons with the SAP Add-On Assembly Kit (AAK)
  • Java development experience, particularly with agent- or service-based architectures, including:
    • File I/O and protocols such as SFTP and SSH
    • JKS keystore management and TLS/SSL configuration
    • Reading and debugging multithreaded Java service code (Windows service / Linux daemon)
  • Experience with web technologies and data formats, including OData, REST, XML, and JSON
  • SAP Basis knowledge, including authorization configuration
  • Background with workload automation or enterprise job scheduling products

Ownership & Collaboration

  • Strong architectural thinking, with the judgment to make sound technical decisions and the accountability to own the outcomes
  • A driver's mindset: self-directed, proactive, and able to move a product forward without handholding
  • A methodical troubleshooter, able to diagnose complex issues in customer SAP environments and bring them to resolution
  • Ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions
  • Effective written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical direction and trade-offs to colleagues, customers, and non-technical stakeholders
  • A collaborative team player, comfortable working in a small, focused, international team
  • Business-fluent German (C1 minimum) and fluent English (C1 minimum), both written and verbal, are required. German is the team's primary working language, including code documentation, technical discussions, and customer support cases

Why You’ll Love Stonebranch:

At Stonebranch, you’ll be part of a team that’s passionate about innovation, collaboration, and making an impact in the world of IT automation. We believe great work starts with a great workplace – one that values people, supports growth, and celebrates success.

  • Collaborative Culture: Join an international team of experienced, high-performing professionals who value teamwork, knowledge sharing, and mutual success.
  • Growth & Development: Take advantage of continuous learning opportunities and professional development to advance your career.
  • Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Benefit from a flexible work environment with hybrid or remote options, designed to support balance and productivity.
  • Impact & Innovation: Be part of a high-growth company at the forefront of IT automation, where your contributions directly influence customer success and business outcomes.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Receive a competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with local market standards and employment regulations.

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:
You will own the IP and optical architecture for CrowdStrike's global backbone, including connectivity to traditional and neocloud providers. You'll set the multi-year roadmap governing its evolution, including traffic engineering strategy, capacity planning, and demand forecasting for the network as a whole. You'll drive the initiatives that matter most to the business, from funding case through implementation and long-term operational stewardship, and act as the senior escalation resource in the 24x7 on-call rotation when an incident exceeds the depth of the engineers already on it.

What You'll Do:

You'll own platform selection for routing and optical hardware, working directly with vendor engineering teams to influence their roadmaps, and engage director- and VP-level stakeholders across datacenter, application, and business teams to keep network strategy ahead of the company's growth. You'll set the direction for network automation and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD, GitOps), and for telemetry and analytics strategy, increasingly including frontier and open-weight AI models for tasks like telemetry analysis and automated triage, with sensitive backbone data kept in-house. Part of the role is raising the technical bar of the organization: reviewing senior engineers' designs, setting the standards they build against, and mentoring them toward this level.

What You'll Need:

  • US Citizenship or Green Card holder status
  • 12+ years designing, building, and operating large-scale backbone networks, with ownership of architecture at global scale
  • Deep expertise in IP/MPLS core technologies: IS-IS, MP-BGP, segment
  • routing (SR-MPLS/SRv6), PE/P architectures, MPLS-TE, VRFs, DDoS mitigation, CDN
  • Deep expertise in optical transport: DWDM, coherent optics (400G/800G), ROADM architectures, amplifier design (EDFA/Raman), dispersion management, alien wavelengths
  • Strong grounding in cloud networking: direct connectivity, multi-cloud routing, and hybrid cloud at scale across major hyperscalers (AWS, GCP, OCI, Azure) and neoclouds (e.g., CoreWeave, Cerebras)
  • Working depth in adjacent infrastructure domains (virtualization, containers, databases, message queuing, large-scale provisioning) sufficient to architect across boundaries
  • Proven ability to set, not just execute, network automation and IaC strategy
  • Familiarity with applying frontier and open-weight AI models to network operations (e.g., telemetry analysis, automated triage, ChatOps tooling), including self-hosting open-weight models where data sensitivity requires it
  • Experience operating or architecting networks within FedRAMP-authorized environments
  • Track record of selecting, testing, and deploying networking hardware and software organization-wide, across major vendors (Juniper, Infinera, Nokia, Arista, Cisco, etc.)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

The Director, Web Development is responsible for leading the strategy, operations, governance, and continuous evolution of insightsoftware’s global web ecosystem. This role oversees the people, processes, platforms, and external partners responsible for delivering scalable, high-performing digital experiences that support pipeline generation, brand awareness, customer engagement, and business growth.

Reporting to the VP, Digital Marketing, this individual leads the Web Experience function, encompassing web development, UX/UI design, CMS management, web publishing operations, and technical website support. The Director also owns the Web Experience operating model, including intake, prioritization, resource planning, governance, and delivery processes, ensuring the team can effectively support multiple brands and business units while advancing strategic initiatives.

  • Familiarity with modern web frameworks and architectures such as Astro, React, and related technologies, as well as cloud hosting and deployment platforms such as Vercel.
  • Strong operational leadership skills with demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent initiatives, stakeholders, and priorities.
  • Experience establishing scalable operating models, intake processes, governance frameworks, resource planning, and delivery workflows.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams spanning web development, UX/UI design, CMS operations, and web production.
  • Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, design systems, accessibility standards, responsive design, and website usability.
  • Experience managing external development agencies, vendors, contractors, and distributed technical resources.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to guide prioritization and operational decisions.

  • Experience using automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve website operations, publishing efficiency, and scalability preferred.

Minimum Experience

  • 5+ years of people leadership and team management experience.

  • Experience overseeing multidisciplinary teams, including web development, UX/UI design, and CMS operations.
  • Experience supporting large-scale website migrations, platform consolidations, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience building and managing scalable operational processes, governance models, and cross-functional delivery frameworks.

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards to enable technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Customer Engagement & Technical Leadership

  • Give high priority to direct customer engagement, especially for strategic customers, new technologies and complex application needs.
  • Build trusted technical relationships and understand customer manufacturing challenges, operational workflows and technology roadmaps.
  • Lead technical discussions, application reviews and customer-site engagements.
  • Translate customer needs into clear requirements, priorities and recommended actions for internal stakeholders.

2. Strategic Innovation & Operational Automation

  • Focus on game-changing initiatives, with particular emphasis on operational automation and solutions that materially improve customer workflows.
  • Lead or support strategic items that create business value, strengthen differentiation or enable new customer use cases.
  • Address high-value needs outside the standard Product Line coverage, including customer-specific peripheral solutions
  • Assess opportunities, define the application need and coordinate the appropriate internal owners for implementation.

3. New Product, Software & Feature Deployment

  • Provide high-priority support for New Product Introduction, including NPI and consignment systems.
  • Support deployment, qualification and adoption of new software releases.
  • Lead feature filtering and request definition by clarifying customer value, use case, priority and expected outcome.
  • Support feature implementation, field validation, customer acceptance and subsequent enhancement based on field feedback.

4. Application Leadership & Process Optimization

  • Provide advanced support for recipe setup, process qualification, optimization and manufacturing ramp-up.
  • Lead investigations of application performance and recommend improvements in quality, yield, throughput and operational efficiency.
  • Support new materials, use cases and customer-specific process requirements.
  • Create reusable application methodologies, best practices and technical documentation.

5. Escalation & Technical Case Management

  • Own or coordinate complex application-related escalations beyond standard field support capability.
  • Determine whether a case is application-related, a specification gap, a new request, or a potential software or hardware issue.
  • Coordinate technical resolution across CE, Service, PSO, Product Management and Engineering.
  • Ensure cases, actions, evidence, decisions and closure criteria are documented in the designated tracking systems

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Electronics or a related technical discipline.

  • Customer-facing experience in applications engineering, process engineering, product support or a comparable technical role.
  • Strong analytical troubleshooting, structured problem-solving and technical communication skills.
  • Experience with NPI, software or feature deployment, process qualification, or manufacturing ramp-up.
  • Ability to lead work across functions, cultures and time zones without direct authority.
  • Clear written and verbal English and willingness to travel to customer sites

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

Job Summary:

Geisinger Health Plan is making better health easier and more accessible.

We are consistently ranked for outstanding care and coverage, not just by independent reviewers, but by our members, that tells you something.

At Geisinger Health Plan, you’ll be pioneering, pairing our health plan with a network of primary care and specialty providers, hospitals and urgent and convenient care centers. And it's all to make better health easier for our community.

Job Duties:


Join Geisinger Health Plan as an RN Case Manager and make a meaningful impact through patient-centered care coordination. In this rewarding role, you'll support our vision of making better health easier while working alongside a collaborative team that is invested in your success, growth, and ability to deliver exceptional outcomes.


In this RN Case Manager role you'll support our commercial population, helping members address their individual health needs while collaborating with internal teams to advance employer-focused population health strategies and initiatives.


  • At least two (2) years of RN work experience is required.
  • Case management experience and Certified Case Manager / American Case Management Association (ACMA) is preferred.
  • BSN is preferred.
  • Knowledge of healthcare laws, regulations, and insurance coverage policies, and proficiency in healthcare IT systems and insurance claims processes preferred.
  • Ability to work autonomously and as part of a multidisciplinary team is helpful.
  • Active compact RN license is a plus.
  • A typical schedule is full-time, days.
  • This role is Exempt/salaried.

Benefits of working at Geisinger:

  • Full benefits (health, dental and vision) starting on day one
  • Three medical plan choices, including an expanded network for out-of-area employees and dependents
  • Pre-tax savings plans with healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts (FSA) and a health savings account (HSA)
  • Company-paid life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage
  • 401(k) plan that includes automatic Geisinger contributions
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) plan that allows you to accrue time quickly
  • Up to $5,000 in tuition reimbursement per calendar year
  • MyHealth Rewards wellness program to improve your health while earning a financial incentive
  • Family-friendly support including adoption and fertility assistance, parental leave pay, military leave pay and a free Care.com membership with discounted backup care for your loved ones
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Referrals for childcare, eldercare, & pet care. Access free legal guidance, mental health visits, work-life support, digital self-help tools and more.

Position Details:

Assesses, plans, implements, coordinates, monitors and evaluates all options and services with the goal of optimizing the patient or member's health status. Manages utilization and practice metrics to further refine the delivery of care model to maximize clinical, quality, and fiscal outcomes.


  • Integrates evidence-based clinical guidelines, preventive guidelines, protocols, and other metrics in the development of treatment plans that are patient-centric, promoting quality and efficiency in the delivery of healthcare for the identified population.
  • Develops systems of care that monitor progress and promote early intervention in acute care situations.
  • Assists with the design, implementation, and evaluation of the advanced patient centered care model.
  • Assesses the healthcare, educational and psychosocial needs of patients or members.
  • Designs an individualized plan of care and fosters a team approach by working collaboratively with the patient or member, family, primary care provider, and other members of the health care team to ensure coordination of services.
  • Continuously evaluates laboratory results, diagnostic tests, utilization patterns and other metrics to monitor quality and efficiency results for assigned population.
  • Works to appropriately apply benefits and utilization management serving as a resource to the patient or member and healthcare team.
  • Maintains required documentation for all case management activities.
  • Collects required data and utilizes this data to adjust the treatment plan when indicated.

Work is typically performed in a clinical environment. Accountable for satisfying all job specific obligations and complying with all organization policies and procedures. raw.description:
What if you could personally impact the future of healthcare? As part of the PocketHealth team, you will enable hospitals and clinics across North America — and more importantly, empower over 2 million patients — to discover a better healthcare experience.
PocketHealth is a patient-centric platform that enables hospitals and clinics across North America to share imaging records digitally with patients, instantly and securely. Through our platform, we enable patients to be active and engaged participants in their own care, and take control of their care journey. In addition to image sharing, which is the heart of the PocketHealth platform, we’ve grown our core functionality to enable sharing between hospitals and physicians, as well as instant image retrieval and automated importing capability. PocketHealth is a unified image management solution for over 800 hospitals and clinics across North America. We believe that by placing patients at the center of the record release process, data moves more ethically, easily and securely throughout the care journey, and we’re looking for passionate individuals to help make this vision a reality for millions more patients across North America.
We’re looking for an independent, self-motivated, and ambitious Bilingual Patient Experience Representative (Spanish) with a sincere passion for healthcare to help us grow and directly support patients in their care journey. This isn’t your average Customer Support role. Empathetic and timely support for our patient population is at the heart of what we do and we view it as fundamental to our continued success. That means we’re looking for an ambitious self-starter who is comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment.
Understanding how our patients interact with our platform lays a great foundation for growth into any role in the company, so this position is ideal for someone who wants to grow into a leadership role over time and take on new challenges as PocketHealth grows globally. Previous Patient Experience Reps have moved onto high-impact roles in Customer Success, UI/UX and Engineering within the company.
This job posting is for an existing vacancy. The salary for this position is $48,000-$50,000 annually. Salary is just one part of the story, though; this role is also eligible for equity in the form of stock options and includes a comprehensive health and benefits package. We view our compensation as a total investment in your well-being, designed to support you both in your work and in your life outside of it.

About You:

  • Ability to work Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm EST OR 10am to 6pm EST
  • Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English (verbal and written)
  • Minimum of 2-3 years in a customer service role with communication over phone and email (mandatory)
  • Outstanding organizational skills and an ability to juggle multiple tasks
  • Experience with or passion for healthcare would be an asset, but is not required
  • Technical Support experience considered an asset

Nice to haves:

  • Resourceful, flexible, hold yourself accountable and persevere in the face of obstacles
  • Hardworking and eagerly embrace the challenge of solving problems
  • Empathetic and enjoy teaching people at all levels of technical proficiency
  • A standout teammate – someone who believes in working with their team to achieve shared goals
  • Communication skills in Spanish or French (verbal and written) - not required, but would be an asset

Outcomes:

  • Patient Support: Provide timely technical support, guidance around appropriate use and general platform education to patients via email and over the phone. You will be a key contact for patients looking to access their health records and navigate the PocketHealth platform.
  • Product Vision: Use the feedback you’ve gathered from patients and providers to help our Management and Engineering teams shape the future of the PocketHealth platform.
You can do amazing things at PocketHealth. You can positively impact the healthcare journey for millions of people, while building your career and developing your skills. It doesn’t have to be one or the other. It has been a part of our mission since our founding to empower patients & make healthcare accessible to all, and we know this can only be achieved with a team of diverse perspectives that is representative of the Patient & Provider communities we serve.
People love working here for these reasons and more: working remotely, our competitive salaries and benefits (including stock options for every employee!), four weeks of paid time off, unlimited paid wellness days, extended mental health coverage, and 16 weeks of parental leave top-up.
We’re proud to foster a culture that embraces diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we believe in caring for our employees with the same thoughtfulness we offer our Patients & Providers.

Job Summary

raw.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the Role

Reports to the Operations Principal, Change. The Strategic Operations team sits between Product, Technology, and Claims Operations and owns the work that turns a new way of working into one the organization actually runs on.

Not every change at Reserv arrives with a product release behind it. Programs change, client requirements change, and the way a claim is handled changes with them. We are hiring an Operations Lead to own process design and change across claims operations, so that how work is done is written down, current, and changed deliberately.

You own the process side of the function: before-and-after process design for each change, the SOP library and how it is governed, verification that changes landed in practice, and the training and communications for process changes. You will work alongside the Operations Lead who owns product change, since most product releases also change a process, and with claims leadership, who own the work you are documenting. You will be an excellent fit if you have redesigned how an operations team works, can write a process someone will follow, and verify that changes landed in practice.

Duties & Responsibilities

Process Design: Lead the before-and-after process design for each change, product-driven or not, working with leaders, managers, and team leads on what actually shifts in their day. Write the end-to-end process so it can be followed without further explanation, and pressure-test it with the people who will run it before it goes live.

SOP Ownership and Governance: Own the SOP library across lines of business and account variants: its structure, its currency, and its governance. Draft the standard language for each change, drive it into every affected SOP through the SOP owners against a date, and build the auditability that shows who changed what and when. Partner with the Principal on the platform and workflow the library should run on.

Change Readiness for Process Changes: Run process changes against the readiness standard: documented process, approved change plan, training and communications plan, onboarding updated, and metrics defined. Assemble the evidence for sign-off and flag gaps early.

Training, Enablement, and Communications: Build and execute the training and communications for process changes for leaders, managers, and frontline teams, and coordinate with Learning & Development so new-hire onboarding teaches the current process.

Verification and Feedback: Go back after each change and verify it landed in practice, through SOP checks, time studies, and conversations with the teams doing the work. Carry what you find back to the Principal and to claims leadership, and feed it into how the next change is designed.

Metric and Data Management: This person will be responsible for continually tracking metrics to determine success and make data-driven changes to rollouts

Requirements

  • 1-3+ years in management consulting, operational transformation, operations management, or a similar role where you redesigned how a team works and documented it.
  • Proven ability to write process documentation that people follow: SOPs, process guides, and before-and-after write-ups for operational change.
  • Experience running cross-functional change against dates, with verification that it landed.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with comfort maintaining a structured record of changes, decisions, and history over time.
  • Working fluency with business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) to read what the numbers say about whether a process is being followed.
  • Active use of AI tools in your own work, and interest in applying them to process documentation and change.
  • Claims or insurance experience is helpful here and is not required.
  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications).

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

raw.description:
Flexigrant is one of the specialist software businesses within a portfolio of Fluent Software Group, which is an operating group under Valsoft Corporation, an acquirer of specialist vertical-market software businesses with a long-term, buy-and-hold approach.

Being part of the wider group provides additional stability, expertise and opportunities to collaborate with other specialist software businesses, while allowing Flexigrant to retain its own culture and market focus/ specialist market position.

You will be joining a focused business with its own identity, goals and ambitions, while benefiting from the long-term backing, shared expertise and international network of Fluent Software Group and Valsoft.

Flexigrant is cloud-based grant management software built for organisations that award funding, from community foundations to central government. It replaces spreadsheets and email with a single system covering applications, eligibility, assessment, awards, monitoring, and reporting, with a full audit trail throughout.

The platform replaces disconnected spreadsheets, emails and paper-based processes with one secure, configurable system, giving grant managers a complete and up-to-date view of every programme, application and award. Flexigrant also creates a clear audit trail of actions and decisions, helping organisations maintain transparency and meet their governance and reporting responsibilities.

Trusted by more than 100 organisations worldwide, the platform supports grant programmes of varying sizes and complexity. In the last 12 months alone, more than £6.4 billion in new grant funding was awarded through Flexigrant, demonstrating the important role its technology plays in helping funding reach research, communities and worthwhile causes efficiently.

The Role

As QA Analyst, you will own the quality of what we ship. You will plan and run testing across Flexigrant, from exploratory, functional and regression testing through to building automated tests, working closely with our developers and Product Manager to catch issues early.

This is a hands-on role for a fast learner who enjoys getting to know a complex product in depth. Much of that product knowledge is built on the job, alongside the development team, so a real appetite to learn is essential.

It is also an AI-native role. You will use AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot every day to plan, create and maintain tests, grow our automation and help build quality in as Flexigrant modernises. AI fluency will be explored at interview, so be ready to show how you work.

We are remote-first: you will work with colleagues across locations and are trusted to work wherever you are based.

Key Responsibilities

  • You will plan, design and run manual testing across Flexigrant, including exploratory, functional, regression and edge-case testing.
  • You will build and maintain automated tests and help grow our automated test coverage.
  • You will work with developers and the Product Manager to refine requirements and turn them into clear, testable acceptance criteria.
  • You will reproduce and document issues clearly, giving developers concise, actionable feedback so they can resolve them quickly.
  • You will carry out API testing and use SQL to validate data and investigate issues.
  • You will support releases each sprint, balancing planned testing with reactive support, and take part in refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
  • You will use AI tooling as a core part of your daily workflow to improve testing processes and speed up delivery.
  • You will share product knowledge across the team and help improve our QA processes and practices.

Key Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • 4+ years in a software QA or testing role, ideally within an Agile team.
  • Strong manual testing skills (exploratory, functional, regression and edge-case), including web applications across devices and browsers.
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as Selenium or Cypress.
  • API testing experience (for example Postman) and working knowledge of SQL for data validation.
  • The ability to turn requirements from meetings and conversations into test cases and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Experience with version control and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot, with the judgement to prompt, steer and critically review their output.
  • Excellent attention to detail and time management, with the ability to prioritise several test items at once.
  • A collaborative, patient communicator who builds trusted relationships with developers and product colleagues.
  • Interest or experience in AI-assisted and agentic testing workflows (desirable).
  • ISTQB Foundation (CTFL) or BCS Foundation Certificate in Software Testing, or a further ISTQB, test automation, API testing or Agile certification (desirable).
  • Familiarity with accessibility testing and WCAG (desirable).

No degree or formal qualification is required. Demonstrable QA experience matters most.
