Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

Salary Range: $100,000–$170,000 Annually
Experience Required: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Workday Developer with broad expertise across Workday configuration, reporting, calculated fields, business process design, and Workday Extend application development. The role spans technical configuration, custom report design, integration support, and lightweight application extension work, helping HR, finance, and IT stakeholders get more value from the Workday platform. The ideal candidate combines strong Workday platform knowledge with practical engineering discipline and the ability to translate business requirements into clean, maintainable Workday configurations. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop complex calculated fields, custom reports, and advanced reports using the Workday report writer.
  • Build composite reports, matrix reports, and dashboards supporting business decision-making.
  • Configure and maintain business processes, condition rules, and approval routing across HCM and Finance.
  • Develop Workday Extend applications and PRISM analytics where appropriate, packaging custom logic in supported platform extensions rather than fragile customizations that complicate future upgrades.
  • Build report-as-a-service integrations and support data export needs for downstream systems.
  • Configure security domains, role-based security, and segment-based security across complex tenants.
  • Partner with HR, payroll, and finance stakeholders to translate requirements into Workday configurations.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for business processes, calculated fields, and security models.
  • Support Workday tenant refreshes, regression testing cycles, and platform release adoption, validating configuration and reports against expected behavior before each move into production.
  • Troubleshoot configuration and report issues in production tenants, working closely with functional teams to isolate root causes, propose remediation, and prevent recurrence through configuration improvements.
  • Collaborate closely with integration developers on report-driven data flows, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Provide guidance on Workday best practices and configuration design patterns.
  • Participate in Workday community forums, brainstorms, and product feedback channels, contributing field perspective and bringing back valuable insights and emerging best practices to the broader team.
  • Stay current with Workday releases and platform innovations, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of Workday technical experience.
  • Deep expertise in Workday report writer including advanced and composite reports.
  • Strong proficiency with calculated fields across HCM and Finance.
  • Hands-on experience configuring business processes and condition rules.
  • Strong understanding of Workday security framework.
  • Experience with PRISM Analytics or Workday Extend.
  • Familiarity with Workday tenant management and release process.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Pro certifications.
  • Experience with Workday Extend application development.
  • Familiarity with PRISM data ingestion and modeling.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments.

  • Deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals, code generation, automated testing, and program correctness.

The Organisation

Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected.

Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge.

For over 85 years, we have rallied other determined optimists to transform the lives of all children in more than 80 countries.

We won’t stop until we are all equal.

Plan International’s Child Protection in Humanitarian Action (CPHA) Roster

As Plan International scales up its humanitarian impact, we are committed to becoming a leading global organisation for girls affected by crisis and disaster. Our humanitarian roster plays a critical role in delivering this ambition and we are seeking to further strengthen our roster of experienced Humanitarian Child Protection specialists who can be deployed globally to support humanitarian responses, typically for deployments lasting between two and six months.

Successful applicants will be added to our roster for Child Protection in Humanitarian Action and contacted for deployment opportunities as they arise. Whilst being a member of the roster is not paid, once you are deployed you will receive a salary as well as per diem, accommodation and travel insurance.

We maintain a close relationship with our Roster Members through regular engagement and access to online humanitarian learning, ensuring they benefit from being part of the roster both when deployed and when not deployed.

About You

The Child Protection in Emergencies specialist provides oversight and leadership to Plan International's child protection response in a specific crisis. You will be responsible for assessment, response analysis, design, coordination, capacity strengthening, implementation and monitoring and evaluation of child protection in emergency programmes as part of our broader emergency response. You will ensure that gender equality is core to our child protection in emergencies response and that our intervention meets the child protection and gender-based violence minimum standards.

Successful applicants require:

  • Solid work experience in international humanitarian settings with progressively responsible roles in designing, leading and/or coordinating Child Protection in Humanitarian Action programme responses.
  • Expertise in working with child survivors of sexual and gender based violence (SGBV).
  • Alongside proficiency in English, we require that you can comfortably work in Spanish to be considered for the roster at this time.
  • Commitment to ensuring safeguarding and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment. (PSEAH) is core to our ways of working.

Closing Date: Saturday 31st October

Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the very heart of everything that Plan International stands for.

We want Plan International to reflect the diversity of the communities we work with, offering equal opportunities to everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

Plan International is based on a culture of inclusivity and we strive to create a workplace environment that ensures every team, in every office, in every country, is rich in diverse people, thoughts, and ideas.

We foster an organisational culture that embraces our commitment to racial justice, gender equality, girls’ rights and inclusion.

Plan International believes that in a world where children face so many threats of harm, it is our duty to ensure that we, as an organisation, do everything we can to keep children safe. This means that we have particular responsibilities to children that we come into contact with and we must not contribute in any way to harming or placing children at risk.

A range of pre-employment checks will be undertaken in conformity with Plan International's Safeguarding Children and Young People policy. Plan International also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this scheme we will request information from applicants previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

Please note that Plan International will never send unsolicited emails requesting payment from candidates.

raw.excerpt: The OrganisationPlan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls.
raw.description:
The Organisation

Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected.

Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge.

For over 85 years, we have rallied other determined optimists to transform the lives of all children in more than 80 countries.

We won’t stop until we are all equal.

Plan International’s Child Protection in Humanitarian Action (CPHA) Roster

As Plan International scales up its humanitarian impact, we are committed to becoming a leading global organisation for girls affected by crisis and disaster. Our humanitarian roster plays a critical role in delivering this ambition and we are seeking to further strengthen our roster of experienced Humanitarian Child Protection specialists who can be deployed globally to support humanitarian responses, typically for deployments lasting between two and six months.

Successful applicants will be added to our roster for Child Protection in Humanitarian Action and contacted for deployment opportunities as they arise. Whilst being a member of the roster is not paid, once you are deployed you will receive a salary as well as per diem, accommodation and travel insurance.

We maintain a close relationship with our Roster Members through regular engagement and access to online humanitarian learning, ensuring they benefit from being part of the roster both when deployed and when not deployed.

About You

The Child Protection in Emergencies specialist provides oversight and leadership to Plan International's child protection response in a specific crisis. You will be responsible for assessment, response analysis, design, coordination, capacity strengthening, implementation and monitoring and evaluation of child protection in emergency programmes as part of our broader emergency response. You will ensure that gender equality is core to our child protection in emergencies response and that our intervention meets the child protection and gender-based violence minimum standards.

Successful applicants require:

  • Solid work experience in international humanitarian settings with progressively responsible roles in designing, leading and/or coordinating Child Protection in Humanitarian Action programme responses.
  • Expertise in working with child survivors of sexual and gender based violence (SGBV).
  • Alongside proficiency in English, we require that you can comfortably work in Spanish to be considered for the roster at this time.
  • Commitment to ensuring safeguarding and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment. (PSEAH) is core to our ways of working.

Closing Date: Saturday 31st October

Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the very heart of everything that Plan International stands for.

We want Plan International to reflect the diversity of the communities we work with, offering equal opportunities to everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

Plan International is based on a culture of inclusivity and we strive to create a workplace environment that ensures every team, in every office, in every country, is rich in diverse people, thoughts, and ideas.

We foster an organisational culture that embraces our commitment to racial justice, gender equality, girls’ rights and inclusion.

Plan International believes that in a world where children face so many threats of harm, it is our duty to ensure that we, as an organisation, do everything we can to keep children safe. This means that we have particular responsibilities to children that we come into contact with and we must not contribute in any way to harming or placing children at risk.

A range of pre-employment checks will be undertaken in conformity with Plan International's Safeguarding Children and Young People policy. Plan International also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this scheme we will request information from applicants previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

Please note that Plan International will never send unsolicited emails requesting payment from candidates.

Our associates have a lot in common. They have great interpersonal skills, enjoy working independently, are self-motivated, and have a relentless drive. Did we mention that while they are working hard, they also like to have fun?

We offer flexible hours, competitive pay, and great benefits for both full and part-time associates.

The Data Validation Specialist checks that data entering and moving through our systems is accurate, complete, and consistent. The Data Validation Specialist is responsible for labeling, tagging, categorizing, and reviewing large volumes of structured and unstructured data (text, images, audio, video, or multimodal content) according to detailed project guidelines. This role also validates work completed by other annotators, identifies inconsistencies or errors, and provides feedback to improve annotation quality and guideline clarity. The ideal candidate is meticulous, comfortable with repetitive, detail-oriented work, able to follow complex and evolving instructions precisely, and confident flagging ambiguity rather than guessing. As a flex position, the role scales hours up during peak periods such as new AI model launches and down when volume is lower. Assignments are checked to verify progress, through a reporting mechanism by the Artificial Intelligence Project Manager.

What would you do in this role?

DUTIES AND TASKS, including but not limited to the following:


Seeks minimum guidance on the following tasks:

  • Label, tag, transcribe, segment, or categorize data (text, images, video, audio, or sensor data) according to project-specific style guides and taxonomies.
  • Apply bounding boxes, polygons, keypoints, or segmentation masks to visual data as required by computer vision projects.
  • Maintain consistent labeling speed while meeting or exceeding minimum throughput targets without sacrificing accuracy
  • Review annotations completed by peers or vendor teams for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Identify systematic errors, edge cases, and ambiguous instructions; escalate patterns to team leads or guideline owners.
  • Perform spot-checks and full audits on annotated datasets prior to delivery or model training.
  • Track and report quality metrics (accuracy rate, error rate, agreement rate, throughput) using internal tools or spreadsheets.
  • Re-annotate or correct flagged data points and document rationale for changes.
  • Provide structured feedback on annotation guidelines, identifying gaps, contradictions, or unclear edge cases.
  • Participate in calibration sessions to align understanding of labeling standards across the team.
  • Help pilot new annotation tasks, test draft guidelines on sample data, and report findings before full-scale rollout.
  • Document recurring edge cases and contribute examples to internal knowledge bases or FAQs.
  • Work within annotation platforms to complete assigned tasks.
  • Track task assignments, deadlines, and completion status in project management tools.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and data handling protocols, especially with sensitive, proprietary, or personally identifiable data.
  • Communicate blockers, ambiguous cases, or technical issues promptly to team leads.

QUALIFICATIONS


  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Demonstrated ability to follow detailed written instructions with a high degree of precision.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistency, especially across repetitive tasks performed over long periods.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity, and skilled at flagging uncertain cases rather than guessing.
  • Basic computer literacy: comfortable navigating web-based tools, spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets/Microsoft List), and ticketing/task systems.
  • Strong written communication skills for documenting edge cases and providing feedback.
  • Ability to meet productivity and quality targets in a metrics-driven environment.
  • Preferred prior experience in data annotation, content moderation, transcription, quality assurance, proofreading, editing, or a related detail-oriented field.

Flex position details:


Expectation

  • Weekly hours - Vary, based on workload
  • Notice of schedule - At least 1 week ahead where possible
  • Core availability - Some overlap with business hours (8:00am CST – 5:00 pm CST). Occasional evening and weekend hours.

Working conditions

Computer-based work, mostly at a desk.

raw.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Embedded Android BSP Engineer to contribute as an independent contractor on a long-term B2B basis to an international engineering project focused on the development of next-generation embedded Android/Linux platforms for advanced professional products used worldwide.

As part of the international engineering project team, you will contribute to commercially deployed products where platform stability, multimedia quality, connectivity, performance, and hardware/software integration directly impact the end-user experience in enterprise, education, conferencing, and professional environments.

Work deep inside the Android platform. This is not typical Android application development. You will work close to the hardware and across the Android stack, contributing to BSP development, AOSP customization, HAL integration, native system components, debugging, optimization, and system-level problem solving.

Take ownership of complex engineering challenges. You will investigate issues that rarely have simple answers, working across multiple layers of the system to understand root causes and deliver robust technical solutions from analysis through implementation and validation.

Contribute as a senior Android platform specialist. You will collaborate with experienced hardware, firmware, Android, Linux, and product engineers across countries, while deepening your expertise in Android internals, embedded Linux, BSP engineering, platform bring-up, multimedia, and low-level


Expected Deliverables and Areas of Contribution

  • Develop and customize AOSP-based platform software for embedded audio devices.
  • Work on Android BSP, HAL layers, native C/C++ components, JNI/NDK integration, and system-level services.
  • Participate in Android version upgrades and help keep the platform aligned with the latest Android releases.
  • Integrate and troubleshoot hardware interfaces, peripheral drivers, and Linux kernel-related components.
  • Debug platform issues related to boot, performance, memory, power, threading, IPC, and hardware communication.
  • Support board bring-up and platform validation on ARM, Qualcomm-based, and other embedded hardware architectures.
  • Collaborate with hardware, software, and product teams to deliver stable embedded Android platforms.
  • Review technical designs and code and provide guidance to less experienced engineers when needed.

Required Expertise

Must have

  • 7+ years of embedded software development experience, including 2+ years with Embedded Android, AOSP, or Android platform-level development.
  • Strong C/C++ development skills for native, low-level, and performance-sensitive software.
  • Hands-on experience with Android BSP, AOSP build systems, HAL architecture, HIDL/AIDL, Android.bp/Android.mk, Soong/Ninja, and system services.
  • Experience with Android NDK, JNI, Binder, sockets, shared memory, or other IPC mechanisms.
  • Good knowledge of embedded Linux, Linux kernel interfaces, device drivers, and hardware communication concepts.
  • Experience debugging with tools such as ADB, GDB, Valgrind, Systrace/Perfetto, Wireshark, protocol analyzers, or similar tools.
  • Understanding of object-oriented design, SOLID principles, version control, and structured release/development workflows.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

Engagement Highlights

Jabil Inc. partners with experienced independent professionals who contribute their expertise to international engineering projects. Together, we create, innovate, and solve meaningful technical challenges for world-leading brands.

  • Opportunity to support engineering projects delivered for market-leading global brands.
  • Long-term project engagement with clearly defined technical objectives.
  • Engagement on a B2B basis as an independent contractor, with discretion over the manner, time, and place of service delivery under a remote cooperation model, subject to project requirements and agreed deliverables.
  • Flexibility in how and where you work, aligned with project needs and delivery expectations.
  • Collaboration with international engineering stakeholders and experienced specialists across different countries.
  • Exposure to modern technologies and complex engineering challenges across embedded systems and Android platforms.
  • Opportunity to influence technical decisions and contribute knowledge to products used globally.

  • Support opportunities primarily in stages where Product Specialists add the most value - customer needs discovery, demonstrations, and quote/configuration support.

3) Product Positioning, Competitive Strategy & Market Growth

  • Lead product-line strategy execution in-country, including competitive positioning, deal strategies, and supporting strategic growth initiatives.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of LC/MS competitive landscape and differentiators, translating them into clear customer value messaging.
  • Gather Voice of Customer (VOC) and market insights; provide feedback to global/regional stakeholders to strengthen value propositions and future roadmap alignment.

4) Sales Enablement & Capability Building

  • Lead technical competency development for the sales team and partners (product training, positioning, and solution selling).

5) Operational Discipline & Reporting

Expectations (What Success Looks Like)

  • Operate effectively in a matrix, collaborating across sales, application/workflow resources, and marketing to execute initiatives and launches.
  • Travel: typically up to ~60% (customer-facing role).

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Chemistry / Biochemistry / Life Science (or related discipline).
  • Experience:5+ years in relevant analytical/scientific/instrument industry experience with strong exposure to LC/LCMS applications and customer environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and troubleshoot/solve complex, high-impact customer problems.
  • Technical: Strong understanding of LC/MS workflows and ability to translate workflow needs into solution configurations and differentiated value.
  • Hands-on experience with LC/MS systems, such as Triple Quad LC/MS, High Resolution Mass Spectrometry (QTOF), Single Quadrupole, is an added advantage.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills; confident in engaging customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Strong cross-functional teamwork with sales and supporting functions; willing to embrace new ways of engaging customers.
  • Experience contributing to product launch activities, customer events, conferences, and workshops.

raw.excerpt: About usGoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments.
raw.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

Intro to the Regulatory and Compliance team

The Regulatory and Compliance team is responsible for supporting the regulatory and compliance aspects of our products and services and managing the compliant execution of our business. We work on exciting and challenging regulatory and compliance issues and pave the way for our company to deliver superb products in a compliant manner. We are at the forefront of GoCardless’ expansion in North America by paving the way with the right regulatory licensing strategy and the implementation of forward-thinking and appropriate processes and controls that require problem-solving and innovative thinking.

The role

You will be responsible for all US and Canada regulatory and compliance matters at GoCardless and entrusted with developing a comprehensive regulatory strategy and the deployment of the compliance programs. You will take a consultative approach and work closely with every business division and the global regulatory compliance team to implement and manage an innovative and practical, yet thorough, compliance regime that may include cross-border contractual setup with the regulated entities of the group.

What excites you

  • Developing a comprehensive regulatory strategy for the US and Canada that is fit for GoCardless’ current business and strategic objectives
  • Obtaining (if needed) and maintaining all requisite licences and authorizations (including managing of changes in scope of products and org)
  • Managing regulatory oversight, controls, reporting and engagement for the US and Canada
  • Managing regulatory examinations and audits
  • Supporting corporate governance to maintain good standing and meet obligations
  • In collaboration with product counsel and other members of the team, conducting regulatory assessments to identify regulatory risks and a path to compliance
  • As the Compliance Officer, and in collaboration with the Global MLRO and the Financial Crimes team, overseeing and managing the implementation of the AML/CTF and Sanctions compliance programs in the US and Canada
  • Supporting the implementation/localization of various compliance programs in the US and Canada
  • Supporting the relevant regulatory and compliance training of the Board, executive management, and other employees
  • Supporting the development of a network of banks and other partner financial institutions that underpin the operation of GoCardless’ products
  • Providing advice and counsel to business and product groups relating to payment scheme rule compliance and other relevant regulatory requirements regarding compliance obligations

What excites us

We are looking for someone with experience in regulated financial services and passionate about helping us continue to innovate in the fast-paced fintech industry.

You may be an experienced financial services regulatory manager, coming from a larger organisation and looking for an exciting new challenge, or perhaps you have already been through a high-growth journey in a similar role, and are excited about taking on similar challenges in a company with a great culture.

We’d love to hear from you if:

  • You have experience managing compliance for US card programs and embedded payment/finance products in a fintech or program manager capacity, including working with sponsor bank partners, card network rules (Visa/Mastercard), and regulatory frameworks such as BSA/AML, Reg E, and UDAAP.
  • You have direct experience managing a regulated financial services company in the US.
  • You can counsel and advise the business and product teams on how regulations impact the business’ products and expansion plans, helping the business to navigate a path forward.
  • You have dealt directly with financial services regulation and regulators.
  • You have experience in drafting, implementing and rolling out compliance plans, frameworks and policies across a company or department.
  • You are easy to work with, and want to work in a fun, fast-growing but demanding young company.
  • You can operate at a strategic level and demonstrate the value of compliance.
  • You have strong communication skills and thrive in a collaborative team environment.

Bonus points if:

  • You have experience interacting and building relationships with state regulators on MTL matters, and FinCEN on BSA matters.
  • You have experienced a fast-growth journey.

We recognise that the most talented people have the most unusual backgrounds, so if you’re unsure, please apply. The role will be remote and will require a small amount of international travel.

Base salary range: $180,000 - $270,000

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

(some of) The good stuff

  • Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
  • Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
  • Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
  • Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
  • Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
  • Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)

Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by ourvalues; We start with whybefore we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We make it happen, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision.

Diversity & Inclusion

As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:

Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — 25%

Neurodiverse — 9%

LGBTQIA+ — 9%

Disabled — 1%

Average age — 33

Female — 45%

Male — 55%

We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.

If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives here

Sustainability

We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability action planhere.

Find out more about Life at GoCardless via Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn.

Job Overview

The Business Development Manager (BDM) is a strategic role responsible for driving growth through acquiring new corporate clients, upselling to existing long-tail customers, and developing channel partnerships. Operating within the Sales department, which is part of the Customer Experience division, the BDM works closely with various teams to expand the corporate portfolio, focusing on web hosting, SaaS, and Online Brand Protection services.

As part of team.blue, a group of companies offering innovative digital services, the BDM will collaborate with other team.blue entities to leverage their expertise and solutions to serve our customers effectively. The role involves identifying opportunities, managing key relationships, and occasionally traveling to meet clients and partners in person to strengthen collaborations and drive business growth. The BDM will play a key role in Enartia’s growth and success by driving strategic initiatives and delivering exceptional value to our corporate clients.

Duties & Responsibilities

Corporate Client Acquisition & Portfolio Management

Provide input and feedback for training programs to enhance the team’s understanding of Corporate Sales processes and tools.

General Contributions

raw.excerpt: The OpportunityTurnitin is looking for an experienced Enterprise Data Architecture & Governance Lead to help define the future of how we use data to run our business.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

Turnitin is looking for an experienced Enterprise Data Architecture & Governance Lead to help define the future of how we use data to run our business.

Over time, our reporting capabilities have evolved across multiple functions including Finance, Revenue Operations, Product, HR and Engineering. Whilst these capabilities provide value locally, they have developed independently, resulting in inconsistent metric definitions, fragmented ownership and varying levels of confidence in enterprise reporting.

This role represents a unique opportunity to shape Turnitin's enterprise data strategy by establishing the foundations for trusted, scalable and decision-ready information.

Working closely with executive stakeholders across the organisation, you will assess our current environment, define a practical target state and provide a roadmap that enables future execution.

What you’ll do

You will:

  • Assess Turnitin's current reporting and analytics landscape;
  • Identify the root causes of fragmented reporting and conflicting metrics;
  • Define ownership and governance principles for critical enterprise data;
  • Develop a high-level target-state architecture for enterprise reporting and analytics;
  • Establish standards for enterprise metric definitions and trusted reporting;
  • Recommend an operating model that balances enterprise consistency with functional autonomy;
  • Produce a practical roadmap for future implementation and investment;
  • Facilitate alignment across executive and business stakeholders.

What success looks like

By the end of the engagement, Turnitin will have:

  • A shared understanding of its current data landscape;
  • Clear ownership of priority enterprise metrics;
  • Improved confidence in Executive and Board reporting;
  • A pragmatic governance framework;
  • A target-state blueprint for enterprise reporting and analytics;
  • A prioritised roadmap for implementation.

What we’re looking for

We're seeking a pragmatic enterprise data leader who is equally comfortable engaging with executives and technical teams.

You'll bring experience in areas such as:

  • Enterprise data architecture and governance;
  • Analytics and reporting governance;
  • Executive and Board reporting environments;
  • Metric definition and stewardship;
  • Cross-functional stakeholder management;
  • Data quality and reporting controls.

Experience in SaaS, subscription businesses or distributed analytics environments would be highly advantageous.

Why join us

This is an opportunity to define how an established global SaaS organisation measures performance and makes decisions.

You won't simply be building dashboards.

You'll help shape the principles, governance and architecture that underpin trusted enterprise insight across the business.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise data governance, architecture, analytics governance, or enterprise reporting controls.
  • Experience operating across Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, HR, Engineering, Product, and Business Intelligence functions.
  • Strong understanding of data lineage, data quality controls, source-system reconciliation, data transformation processes, and reporting controls.
  • Experience supporting Executive, Board & Investor Reporting.
  • Experience defining governance frameworks, ownership models, and metric standards.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating cross-functional agreement on enterprise metric definitions and ownership, particularly in environments where multiple functions have independently built reporting capabilities and no shared standard exists.
  • Experience designing operating models for enterprise data functions, including roles and responsibilities, decision rights, escalation mechanisms, governance forums, and resourcing requirements to sustain an ongoing data governance capability.
  • Familiarity with privacy considerations relating to the use of customer and employee data.
  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation, process design, and executive communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in SaaS, subscription, EdTech, or other data-intensive technology businesses.
  • Familiarity with sales, bookings, ARR, pipeline, retention, customer, usage, and financial reporting data.
  • Experience working with Salesforce and related GTM data structures.
  • Exposure to ERP, HRIS, and production data environments.
  • Experience supporting reporting used for Board materials, executive reviews, financial planning, or investor reporting.
  • Experience designing governance models in a distributed analytics environment where multiple functions have independently developed reporting capabilities.
  • Management consulting or specialist data advisory background, with experience leading multiple data governance or data strategy engagements across different client organisations.

Total Rewards @ Turnitin
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.

Our Mission is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.

Our Values underpin everything we do.

  • Customer Centric: Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
  • Passion for Learning: We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
  • Integrity: Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
  • Action & Ownership: We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
  • One Team: We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
  • Global Mindset: We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

Global Benefits

  • Remote First Culture
  • Health Care Coverage*
  • Education Reimbursement*
  • Competitive Paid Time Off
  • Self-Care Days
  • National Holidays*
  • 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed
  • Paid Volunteer Time*
  • Charitable contribution match*
  • Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/*
  • Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
  • Parental Leave*
  • Retirement Plan with match/contribution*

* varies by country

Seeing Beyond the Job Ad
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad. We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.

Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.

Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.

raw.excerpt: The Aspen Group (TAG) is one of the largest and most trusted retail healthcare business support organizations in the U.
raw.description:
The Aspen Group (TAG) is one of the largest and most trusted retail healthcare business support organizations in the U.S. and has supported over 23,000 healthcare professionals and team members at more than 1,300 health and wellness offices across 48 states in four distinct categories: dental care, urgent care, medical aesthetics, and animal health. Working in partnership with independent practice owners and clinicians, the team is united by a single purpose: to prove that healthcare can be better and smarter for everyone. TAG provides a comprehensive suite of centralized business support services that power the impact of five consumer-facing businesses: Aspen Dental, ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers, WellNow Urgent Care, Chapter Aesthetic Studio, and Lovet Pet Health Care. Each brand has access to a deep community of experts, tools and resources to grow their practices, and an unwavering commitment to delivering high-quality consumer healthcare experiences at scale.


As a reflection of our current needs and planned growth we are very pleased to offer an opportunity to join our dedicated team as Vice President, Field Sales supporting the ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers brand. For over 15 years, ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers has provided innovative and quality dental implant care to patients across the United States. Each center is focused on the same mission—to provide quality dental implant treatment for people who are looking for a long-term solution to chronic dental issues. ClearChoice Holdings is a provider in practice management services to a network of affiliated same-day dental implant centers. ClearChoice provides administrative and non-clinical services to dental implant centers, and a network of doctor-owned and operated dental treatment centers providing dental implant care (similar to ADMI/TAG). In 2022 we received "Top 150 Places to Work" by the Denver Post.


The Vice President, Field Sales is the senior sales leader for a +25-location, +300-employee, +$200M revenue division of ClearChoice. Reporting to the SVP of Sales Enablement, this role is primarily responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing the division's sales strategy to drive sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, patient acquisition, and case acceptance performance across the division. While supporting broader business performance, the Vice President's principal focus is leading the division's sales organization, developing high-performing sales teams, and building scalable sales processes, capabilities, and accountability systems that deliver consistent results.


To succeed in an evolving competitive landscape and support ClearChoice's continued growth, the Vice President, Field Sales must be an agile and influential leader who can translate business objectives into effective go-to-market strategies, inspire high-performing teams, leverage data to drive decisions, and lead through change.


A successful Vice President will deliver accelerated sales growth, increased patient acquisition, improved conversion metrics, stronger forecasting accuracy, enhanced team capability, and sustainable revenue performance while serving as a trusted strategic partner.


Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Growth

  • Serve as the divisional leader responsible for developing and executing sales strategies that drive year-over-year revenue growth, patient acquisition, and market expansion.
  • Establish divisional growth objectives and translate them into actionable sales plans across all locations.
  • Analyze market dynamics, competitive intelligence, referral patterns, and patient trends to identify growth opportunities and optimize commercial performance.
  • Lead the development of sales-focused initiatives that increase case acceptance, maximize revenue opportunities, and improve overall division performance.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and corporate partners to align demand-generation strategies with divisional growth objectives.
  • Support divisional people and culture initiatives that strengthen engagement, performance, and retention across the sales organization.

Divisional Sales Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine the division's comprehensive sales strategy.
  • Establish annual, quarterly, and monthly sales objectives aligned with company growth goals.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the division’s leaders and teams to achieve and exceed performance expectations.
  • Own divisional sales performance metrics, including revenue, patient acquisition, consultation conversion, case acceptance, contact rates, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy.
  • Leverage data, CRM platforms, analytics tools, and market intelligence to improve sales effectiveness and drive informed decision-making.
  • Partner with Marketing and operational leadership to optimize patient conversion funnels and referral generation strategies.
  • Develop and oversee sales budgets, forecasting processes, and resource allocation plans.
  • Create, implement, and enforce sales processes, standards, best practices, and performance management frameworks.
  • Ensure leaders and team members have the training, tools, coaching, and capabilities necessary to maximize performance.
  • Drive a culture of accountability, execution excellence, continuous improvement, and patient-focused selling.
  • Provide regular forecasting, pipeline analysis, and sales performance reporting to the Division President and executive leadership.

Financial Management & Business Performance

  • Lead revenue growth planning and forecasting activities for the division.
  • Monitor divisional financial performance with a primary focus on revenue generation, sales productivity, forecast accuracy, and profitable growth.
  • Support cost management initiatives that contribute to overall divisional profitability.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations to improve financial performance across the division.

Team Leadership & Culture Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a best-in-class sales organization capable of achieving ambitious growth targets.
  • Coach Regional Directors and General Managers to strengthen leadership capability and performance accountability.
  • Attract, retain, and develop top sales talent throughout the division, including Traveling Patient Education Consultants.
  • Champion a high-performance culture focused on results, collaboration, continuous improvement, and patient-centered care.
  • Create development pathways and support succession plans to ensure long-term leadership strength across the organization.

Travel

60-75%


Annual Pay Range: $175-190k with bonus opportunity

A generous benefits package that includes paid time off, health, dental, vision, and 401(k) savings plan with match

Job Title: Customer Acquisition Specialist

Location: Caribbean Region

Job Level: Full-Time | Fully Remote (2-year renewable contract)

Job Summary

The Customer Acquisition Specialist at The Hive Careers is responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new clients, expand the company's customer base, and strengthen client relationships through proactive outreach. This role works closely with the marketing and sales teams to generate leads, optimize conversion funnels, support client outreach initiatives, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new customers.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation: Identify and engage potential customers through various channels, including digital marketing, social media, email campaigns, networking events, and direct outreach.

Client Outreach: Conduct proactive outreach to prospective clients through email, phone calls, social platforms, and other communication channels to build relationships, introduce services, and convert leads into customers.

Marketing Funnel Optimization: Analyze and improve the customer journey from awareness to conversion, ensuring efficient processes that maximize acquisition rates.

Data Analysis: Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer acquisition and outreach efforts, providing regular reports and insights to guide strategic decisions.

Collaboration: Work closely with the marketing and sales teams to align acquisition strategies with overall business objectives and maintain consistent messaging across all platforms.

Customer Onboarding: Oversee the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a positive experience that supports long-term relationships.

Market Research: Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences to identify new growth opportunities.

Budget Management: Manage acquisition budgets effectively, ensuring resources are allocated strategically to meet targets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Proven experience in customer acquisition, client outreach, sales, or marketing roles
  • At least 3-5 years experience in B2B client acquisition

Key Skills

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proficiency in CRM software and marketing tools
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
  • Self-motivated with a results-oriented approach
  • Strong relationship-building and client engagement skill

raw.description:
Salary range:£60,000-£70,000
Location: Remote, but within the UK
Please note: We are unable to sponsor international visas at this time.

About Nexus Mods
Established in 2001, Nexus Mods is the largest video game modding platform on the internet - a household name in the PC gaming ecosystem.
  • 79M+ registered members
  • 950K+ mods for 5,000+ games
  • 26B+ mod downloads
We’re currently focused on product modernisation, driving growth and building infrastructure for the next 10 years of community-powered modding.

Our Role
We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer who’s excited about growth and has a track record of making a real, measurable impact at scale. You’ll lead design work across key growth initiatives, shaping experiences that improve acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and long-term retention across both web and app.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to spot high-impact opportunities, form clear hypotheses, and design, test, and refine solutions that move both user and business metrics. This is a hands-on, craft-driven role for someone who cares deeply about the details, thinks in systems, and designs for real.

The role sits at the intersection of user-centered design, strategy, and problem-solving. You’ll use data and research to uncover insights, simplify complex flows, advocate for users, and help teams learn and ship through experimentation and iteration.

Role Requirements

  • Significant experience in product design, UX/UI, with increasing ownership and scope.
  • A strong portfolio that shows user-centered thinking, strategic problem-solving, and measurable product impact.
  • Experience designing consumer-facing digital products; familiarity with UGC platforms or creator ecosystems is a strong plus.
  • Proven ability to simplify complex workflows and systems into clear, approachable experiences.
  • High proficiency with Figma and modern design workflows.
  • Experience working closely with engineering and product teams in agile, cross-functional environments.
  • A solid understanding of how design decisions affect metrics, performance, and long-term product health.
  • Experience designing for both web and desktop.
  • Comfortable collaborating with engineers and using prototypes (Framer, Lovable, Cursor, Figma, or code) to communicate and validate ideas.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and will use your initiative to push projects forward.
  • Familiarity with Linear for issue tracking and collaboration, is a plus.

Role Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end design for key initiatives across our network of sites and ecosystems.
  • Identify and prioritise opportunities across the full user lifecycle using research, analysis, and product intuition.
  • Define, design, and iterate on experiments that improve activation, engagement, retention, and long-term value.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Community to shape strategy, define hypotheses, and measure impact.
  • Turn complex systems and constraints into intuitive, scalable, and accessible experiences.
  • Move comfortably from low-fidelity exploration to high-fidelity, production-ready designs and interactive prototypes (code-based prototyping is a plus).
  • Contribute to and evolve our design systems to support consistency, speed, and scale as the product grows.
  • Act as a design leader within cross-functional teams by offering thoughtful critique, mentorship, and clear direction.

Benefits of Working at Nexus Mods

Benefits
  • We work a 4-day week of 32 hours, with no reduction in pay.
  • An allowance of £25 each month to spend on video games.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Private BUPA healthcare for you and your family.
  • A very flexible training budget.
  • Regular social events throughout the year. Participation is optional!
Diversity and Inclusion
We celebrate diversity and want you to bring your whole self to work. Supporting an incredible community of tens of millions of users, we thrive on engaging as many views as possible to improve our platform. We see no reason why our culture should be any different.

Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Big Sky Underwriters seeks a Binding Authority Underwriter to join our team.


Big Sky Underwriters is a leading independent Managing General Agency located in Missoula, Montana. As a General Agency, we represent many property and casualty insurance companies offering products to individuals and companies delivered solely through retail agents.


Over the years, Big Sky Underwriters has grown steadily building relationships with agents placing risks in many states including Idaho, Colorado, Montana, North Dakota, Oregon, Washington & Wyoming. The original General Agency was established in 1955 and began operating as Big Sky Underwriters in 1987.


In 2008, Big Sky Underwriters was acquired by Hull & Company, Inc. The core values of Big Sky Underwriters include integrity, quality, honesty, the highest of service standards and insurance education.


Our guiding principles support our staff, agent and company relationships by providing a relaxed, professional work environment where teamwork, courtesy, respect and active listening are values practiced every day.


WHO YOU ARE:

You believe in working as a team and thrive in fun, collaborative environments. You have a client-focused attitude and value the importance of relationships, professionalism and trust. You set goals high and aim higher. You have solid communication skills. You are detail oriented and organized. You enjoy learning new skills, systems, processes, and procedures. You are a great listener and are not afraid to ask questions. You believe that learning is vital to success.


How You Will Contribute:

  • Examines such documents as application forms, inspection reports, insurance maps, and medical reports to determine degree of risk from such factors as applicant financial standing, age, occupation, accident experience, and value and condition of property,
  • Reviews company records to determine amount of insurance in force on single risk or group of closely related risks, and evaluates possibility of losses due to catastrophe or excessive insurance,
  • Underwrite or broker risks, ensuring that all required information is obtained, proper applications are completed, quotes and binders are confirmed in writing, policies are issued promptly and accurately, state filings (where applicable) are made, and taxes paid in accordance with appropriate state laws. Secure payments on risks bound or written.
  • Review, analyze and underwrite risks submitted by Producers, rate submissions for premium and terms, analyze exposures for quotes for new and renewal business, issue written indications, quotes and binders; use inspection companies to obtain further information, quote rates, or explain company underwriting policies.
  • Markets and meets with retail agency customers to develop business and cultivate relationships in an effort to grow a book of business.
  • Understand and extend Company facilities, utilizing binding authorities or brokering risks when required to successfully negotiate a placement; be responsible for your underwriting results,
  • See that coding on specific required forms are completed and utilized.
  • Service and perpetuate existing business, produce new business, and have a keen awareness of priorities,
  • Instruct and train processors and assistants, review indications, quotes, binders, submissions and policies for completeness and accuracy.
  • Provide guidance and training to the processors and assistants, to enable them to reduce the underwriter's clerical workload, and to develop basic underwriting and brokering skills and techniques.
  • Foster and improve relationships with other departments, producers, companies and competitors.

​

Skills & Experience to be Successful:

  • Bachelor’s degree (B. A.) from four-year College or university is desired or five years insurance experience, two years of which is as an underwriting assistant.
  • P&C State licensed.
  • Proficient with MS Office Suite and paperless environment
  • Exceptional telephone demeanor.
  • Experience with excess and surplus lines underwriting agency or company.
  • This position requires routine or periodic travel which may require the teammate to drive their own vehicle or a rental vehicle. Acceptable results of a Motor Vehicle Record report at the time of hire and periodically thereafter, and maintenance of minimum acceptable insurance coverages are a requirement of this position.

Preferred:

  • CIC or CPCU candidate, thorough familiarity with applicable ISO manuals, forms, rating plans, policy forms i.e. coverages, exclusions, conditions and terms.

What We Offer:

  • Excellent growth and advancement opportunities
  • Competitive pay based on experience.
  • Paid time off
  • Full benefits package: health, dental, vision, 401(k) etc.
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

WHO WE ARE:

The Wholesale Brokerage Division of Hull & Company, a subsidiary of Brown & Brown, Inc., markets excess and surplus commercial and personal insurance products to retail insurance agencies, and reinsurance products and services to insurance companies throughout the United States. Our combined operations rank us as one of the largest wholesale brokerage operations in the excess and surplus lines marketplace.


Becoming a Teammate of Hull & Company introduces you to a career with virtually unlimited possibilities. Our unique corporate culture rewards self-starters and hard workers who adhere to our commitment to do what is best for our clients. With Hull & Company you will get the training, the mentoring and the tools you need to succeed.

Pay Range

$92,500 - $92,500 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
  • Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
  • Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations.


Recruiting Vendor Disclosure Statement

Brown & Brown does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters, recruitment vendors or employment agencies ("Recruiting Vendors"). Recruiting Vendors must have a valid written agreement and received prior written authorization from an authorized Brown & Brown representative before submitting candidates for any publicly posted role. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Brown & Brown or its employees become the property of Brown & Brown, and no fees will be paid for such submissions. Additional information regarding this policy can be found on our careers page.

The Power To Be Yourself

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment comprised of people from all backgrounds, with a variety of experiences and perspectives, guided by our Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (DIB) motto, “The Power to Be Yourself”.
