We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.


As a Financial Planner within Empower's dedicated services model, you will provide comprehensive financial wellness and retirement planning for our Large to Mega client base. You will play a critical role in guiding participants throughout all phases of their financial life, delivering tailored advice and solutions that meet their long-term goals. This role emphasizes client engagement, relationship building, and delivering expert consultations aligned with Empower’s mission of financial empowerment.

What You Will Do


  • Develop and deliver comprehensive financial plans for retirement plan participants within Empower's dedicated services model, supporting large and mega-sized institutional clients
  • Conduct personalized, needs-based financial planning consultations to assess participants' financial goals, investment objectives, retirement readiness, and long-term planning needs
  • Provide education and guidance on retirement planning, investment allocation, savings strategies, rollovers, health savings accounts (HSAs), distribution options, managed accounts, and financial wellness
  • Serve as an Investment Adviser Representative of Advised Assets Group, reviewing participant investment portfolios and providing recommendations through Empower's managed account services
  • Educate participants on Empower's My Total Retirement and other managed account solutions, facilitating enrollment when appropriate
  • Apply Empower's CONSULT model to identify participant needs, recommend suitable financial solutions, and deliver personalized financial planning experiences
  • Develop and maintain long-term participant relationships through ongoing financial guidance and service before and after retirement
  • Coordinate proactive follow-up with participants and current or former financial service providers to support implementation of financial decisions
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of participant consultations, recommendations, and follow-up activities using Salesforce and internal systems
  • Collaborate with dedicated services team members, participate in training and staff meetings, and share financial planning knowledge and best practices
  • Support applicable service and business objectives through needs-based consultations and appropriate financial product and service recommendations

What You Will Bring


  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience
  • Certified Financial Planner (CFP) certification
  • Active FINRA Series 7, 63, and 65 registrations
  • FINRA Fingerprinting required
  • Minimum of three years of experience in financial services or the 401(k)/defined contribution retirement plan industry
  • Minimum of two years of direct financial planning experience
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate comprehensive financial planning needs, including investments, retirement planning, insurance, tax planning considerations, education savings, and estate planning
  • Ability to develop and present personalized financial planning recommendations based on participant needs, financial objectives, and investment portfolios
  • Knowledge of retirement savings products, managed accounts, asset allocation, and retirement income planning

What Will Set You Apart


  • Master of Business Administration (MBA)
  • Experience conducting personalized financial planning consultations and establishing trusted, long-term client relationships
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, active listening, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple participant priorities and time-sensitive activities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail
  • Experience meeting financial services business objectives through needs-based recommendations and multiple financial product solutions
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or comparable customer relationship management (CRM) systems and financial planning software
  • Experience working in digital, paperless, cloud-based, or remote financial services environments
  • Commitment to participant financial education, retirement readiness, and personalized financial wellness solutions

#PJPW


***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$87,400.00 - $123,400.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

***For remote and hybrid positions you will be required to provide reliable high-speed internet with a wired connection as well as a place in your home to work with limited disruption. You must have reliable connectivity from an internet service provider that is fiber, cable or DSL internet. Other necessary computer equipment, will be provided. You may be required to work in the office if you do not have an adequate home work environment and the required internet connection.***

raw.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Role Title: Research Scientist - Computer Science & Computational Physics

Role Type: Contractor (flexible, Part-Time or Full-Time)

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Research Scientists in Computer Science & Computational Physics to help advance a customer’s high-impact research project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Identify and propose open problems, new bounds, or tractable research challenges in your subfield for rigorous investigation.
  2. Conduct structured research using frontier AI models and agents to attempt proofs, develop algorithms, or run computational simulations.
  3. Systematically verify research outputs by checking proofs, reproducing numerical results, or employing formal tools.
  4. Assess findings for novelty and correctness in direct comparison with recent literature and published results.
  5. Document methodologies, partial results, and encountered challenges through clear and thorough written reports.
  6. Highlight promising new directions and discoveries for deeper exploration by senior research professionals.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Advanced standing in research: late-stage PhD candidate, postdoctoral researcher, or early-career academic (0–5 years post-PhD) in computer science or mathematical/computational physics.
  2. Recognized by peer community for research excellence, such as best paper or dissertation awards at leading venues (e.g., STOC, FOCS, SODA, PLDI, SC).
  3. Strong publication track record within the past three years, including multiple top-venue papers and recent results addressing named open problems or introducing novel concepts.
  4. Hands-on expertise in computational methods, encompassing simulation, numerical analysis, and algorithmic implementation.
  5. Experience reviewing or sub-reviewing for prominent conferences in your specialty is a plus.
  6. Background in leveraging frontier models, agents, or formal computational tools (e.g., Lean, SAT/SMT solvers) in scholarly work.
  7. Publicly shared research statement or homepage outlining specific open problems currently under investigation.

Role Title: Inpatient Coder (ICD-10 / CCS / CIC)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Inpatient Coders (ICD-10 / CCS / CIC certified) to contribute their expertise to a dynamic project for a valued customer. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Annotate and review inpatient medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, operative reports, consults, lab and imaging results, and discharge summaries, ensuring precise ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS code assignment based on documentation.
  2. Identify principal and secondary diagnoses, sequence codes according to guidelines, assign Present on Admission (POA) indicators, and validate MS-DRG assignment, including the identification of CCs and MCCs, to verify and enrich data sets.
  3. Apply inpatient-specific coding conventions, such as UHDDS definitions, ICD-10-CM/PCS Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, and AHA Coding Clinic guidance, while identifying hospital-acquired conditions (HACs) and patient safety indicators.
  4. Collaborate with project stakeholders using both written and verbal communication to clarify requirements, resolve documentation ambiguities, and ensure data integrity.
  5. Deliver high-quality feedback on coding guidelines and complex cases to support project workflow improvements and enhance AI model understanding.
  6. Ensure accuracy and completeness of all coding-related annotations per current best practices and coding standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Active AHIMA Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) or AAPC Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC) credential.
  2. Thorough expertise in ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and MS-DRG methodology with hands-on inpatient coding experience.
  3. Experience coding in diverse inpatient settings, such as acute care, teaching hospitals, specialty units, surgical, trauma, oncology, cardiology, and transplant cases.
  4. Proficiency in reviewing and coding various types of clinical documentation and addressing complex coding challenges.
  5. Strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating meticulous attention to detail and clarity.
  6. Access to current ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS code sets, Official Coding Guidelines, and MS-DRG grouper tools.

raw.description:
About This Role

As a Graphic Designer, the contractor plays a central role in crafting compelling visual content for Design Pickle's customers. This role is built for a skilled, production-focused designer who brings strong design principles and communication-focused thinking to every request, translating client briefs into polished, brand-aligned assets across print, digital, and presentation formats. Visual storytelling, information hierarchy, and branded composition are core expectations regardless of deliverable type, supported by adaptable workflows across Adobe, Canva, and Affinity.

This is part of our active talent pool. We review applications continuously. Strong candidates remain under consideration and may be fast-tracked once a matching opportunity becomes available.

Work Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST/PST

Location: Remote, open to candidates in Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, Peru, the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, or India.

Specific Scope of Services:

  • Apply strong graphic design principles, including typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy, to craft professional, high-quality digital and print assets aligned to client briefs and brand guidelines.
  • Develop high-quality design assets using Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, and the Affinity Suite, while remaining adaptable across evolving creative software ecosystems.
  • Prepare and deliver print-ready files across common formats (flyers, brochures, labels, merchandise, and similar collateral), with an understanding of print production standards such as bleed, trim, and color mode requirements.
  • Design business presentations and slide decks that go beyond aesthetics, applying information hierarchy, branded slide composition, and visual storytelling to communicate ideas clearly and effectively for business audiences.
  • Handle multiple design projects per day across various clients and industries.
  • Engage regularly with customers and other team members to ensure design quality adheres to brand guidelines.
  • Engage with Design Pickle's customers, understanding their queue and overall process, and address graphic design-related concerns effectively.
  • Organize digital assets, including images, project files, and graphics, efficiently.
  • Stay updated with the latest design tools, trends, and techniques to ensure the highest-quality output.

Requirements:

  • Strong foundation in core graphic design principles including typography, color theory, composition, layout, and visual hierarchy.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply communication-focused design thinking across deliverable types, translating client goals into visually compelling, audience-appropriate assets.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign), with working knowledge of Canva and the Affinity Suite (Vector, Pixel, and Layout).
  • Ability to transition seamlessly between Adobe, Affinity, and Canva workflows based on client needs and project requirements.
  • Solid understanding of print production standards including bleed, trim, safe zones, and color modes (CMYK/RGB).
  • Proficiency in presentation tools such as Canva, Google Slides, PowerPoint, and Keynote, with demonstrated ability to design business presentations using visual storytelling, information hierarchy, and branded slide composition.
  • Experience crafting visually appealing designs aligned with brand guidelines across digital, print, and presentation formats.
  • Ability and adaptability to learn new tools and techniques quickly.
  • A growth mindset: openness to receiving feedback, learning new processes, and continuously improving your craft.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills for efficient project execution.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced production environment with multiple daily requests while maintaining high attention to detail and quality.
  • Ability to interpret creative feedback, efficiently revise work based on client and team direction, and perform thorough self-quality assurance to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to brand guidelines before delivery.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills to ensure client satisfaction.
  • Intermediate/Advanced English proficiency (Upper Intermediate B2 English level), both orally and in writing, for effective client communication and seamless team interactions.
  • A strong portfolio with examples such as:
    • Social media graphics and digital advertising
    • Branding and logo design
    • Marketing collateral (flyers, brochures, postcards, catalogs)
    • Print-ready files
    • Presentation design (PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva) demonstrating visual storytelling and slide composition
    • Infographics and data visualization
    • Merchandise and promotional products
    • Web or landing page mockups (design only)
    • Email graphics or marketing campaigns
    • Image editing and photo manipulation
    • Simple GIFs and Basic Animation

Bonus Feel free to browse our work samples on our website and review the comprehensive scope of work before applying for this position. Our vision, purpose, and values guide how we work, collaborate, and innovate every day. We look for people who will embody these principles and help move Design Pickle forward.

Important: Brine Program

Before fully joining, you’ll go through a 2-week evaluation period called Brine during EST business hours. You’ll complete real design tasks to show your skills and speed. This step is required to move forward.

Weil Durchschnitt keine Option ist. Free your mind @mindsquare!

Dein Umfeld

Du kommst in einen Salesforce-Bereich, der gerade richtig Fahrt aufnimmt: 400 % Umsatzwachstum in diesem Jahr, knapp 40 Menschen zwischen festem Team, Talentnetzwerk und externen Spezialist:innen. Du entwickelst technische Salesforce-Lösungen, die unsere Kunden wirklich voranbringen.   • Praxiserfahrung mit Integrationen zwischen Salesforce und ERP-Systemen, idealerweise mit SAP BTP/CI

Und falls dir eine Zertifizierung noch fehlt, obwohl du das Wissen längst hast: kein Beinbruch, das holst du bei uns in der Probezeit nach, mit unserer Unterstützung in Zeit und Budget.

Bewirb dich jetzt und geh mit uns den Weg in Richtung IT-Elite

Residential Cleaning Virtual Assistant

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for an organized, reliable, and customer-focused Residential Cleaning Virtual Assistant to support the daily operations of a residential cleaning business. You’ll manage cleaning schedules, coordinate bookings, communicate with homeowners, and maintain accurate client records to ensure appointments run smoothly.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys helping customers, managing multiple priorities, and keeping daily operations organized in a remote environment. Strong communication, attention to detail, and proactive follow-through are essential.

What You’ll Own

Scheduling & Calendar Management

  • Manage the daily cleaning schedule and coordinate appointments for residential clients.
  • Book new appointments, update existing bookings, and resolve scheduling conflicts.
  • Confirm appointments and communicate schedule changes to clients.
  • Keep the calendar organized and ensure important booking details are accurate.

Client Communication & Customer Service

  • Serve as the first point of contact for homeowners through phone, email, and messaging platforms.
  • Respond to client inquiries professionally and in a friendly manner.
  • Send booking confirmations, reminders, and follow-up messages.
  • Ensure clients receive timely updates and a positive service experience.

Booking & Client Intake

  • Process new service requests from initial inquiry through confirmed appointment.
  • Collect important details about the home, access instructions, and service preferences.
  • Enter booking information accurately into the relevant systems.
  • Ensure all necessary details are available before each scheduled cleaning.

Issue Resolution & Follow-Up

  • Address client concerns and coordinate rescheduling for cancelled or missed appointments.
  • Identify scheduling or service-related issues and escalate them promptly when needed.
  • Follow up on unresolved requests to ensure they reach the appropriate outcome.
  • Keep clients informed throughout the resolution process.

Administrative Support & Recordkeeping

  • Maintain accurate client profiles, booking records, and internal documentation.
  • Perform data entry and update customer information as needed.
  • Prepare simple reports and assist with routine administrative tasks.
  • Keep records organized and current so the team can access information easily.

Reviews & Customer Feedback

  • Follow up with clients after completed cleanings to gather feedback.
  • Document concerns and communicate relevant feedback to the team.
  • Help identify recurring issues that may affect customer satisfaction.
  • Support consistent service quality through timely communication and follow-through.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in a virtual assistant, administrative, customer service, or similar role.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with U.S.-based homeowners.
  • Experience managing calendars, appointments, and scheduling changes.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, CRM platforms, or scheduling software.
  • Strong data entry skills and attention to detail when handling client and booking information.
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle customer concerns professionally.
  • Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting a residential cleaning, home services, hospitality, or field-service business.
  • Familiarity with home services scheduling or customer management software.
  • Experience coordinating service appointments, managing customer bookings, or handling post-service feedback.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You stay organized while managing multiple bookings and customer requests.
  • You communicate proactively and identify scheduling conflicts before they become bigger issues.
  • You are dependable, self-directed, and comfortable working with minimal supervision.
  • You take ownership of details, from confirming appointments to updating client records.
  • You handle customer concerns with patience, professionalism, and a helpful attitude.
  • You follow through on outstanding tasks and ensure clients feel informed and supported.

What Success Looks Like

  • Cleaning appointments are scheduled accurately and calendars remain up to date.
  • Clients receive timely responses, confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups.
  • New bookings are processed smoothly with all necessary details recorded.
  • Scheduling conflicts and customer concerns are addressed promptly.
  • Client records and internal documentation remain accurate and organized.
  • Customer feedback is collected and communicated effectively to support service quality.

Typical Day

You’ll start by reviewing the day’s cleaning appointments, confirming outstanding bookings, and responding to client messages. Throughout the day, you’ll process new inquiries, update client profiles, coordinate rescheduling requests, and communicate appointment changes to homeowners.

You’ll also maintain accurate records, assist the administrative team with routine tasks, and follow up with clients after completed cleanings to gather feedback. By the end of the day, you’ll ensure outstanding requests are addressed and upcoming appointments are organized.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

Location

Our GTM Systems Engineer will be an integral part of our Enterprise Systems team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, or Sweden. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

The OpportunityWe're looking for an engineering-minded owner of the systems our Sales, Marketing and Revenue Operations teams run on: CRM, marketing automation, CPQ and the tools around them. This is not a ticket-queue role. Business teams will bring you solutions ("add a field", "build me a report"). Your job is to find the problem behind the request and see how a change affects every connected system. Then fix it once, ideally so the next person can do it themselves without filing a request. You'll have an internal engineering team to lean on, and you'll use AI tools daily to build faster.

Responsibilities

  • Own the GTM systems as one connected whole: know how CRM, CPQ, marketing automation and sales-engagement tools share data, and design every change with that in view.
  • Turn requests into problems: ask what the business is trying to solve, propose options, explain trade-offs, and say "no" or "not like that" when it's the right call.
  • Remove recurring manual work: measure the effort, then replace it with automation or self-service tools that business users run themselves.
  • Build automations, small tools and integrations, choosing the simplest approach that will hold up.
  • Keep the data model lean and trustworthy: retire unused fields and legacy workarounds, and enforce data quality where data enters rather than cleaning it up later.
  • Keep integrations reliable: use native connectors where they do the job; where something custom is needed, respect API limits, add error handling and monitoring, and keep sandbox and production consistent. Collaborate with our internal engineering team as necessary.
  • Use AI tools to build, investigate issues, and speed up routine work.
  • Provide EMEA-hours support for the GTM stack, and use what you see there to pick the next fix.
  • Document changes and follow change management from sandbox to production.

Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL and REST APIs, and able to write scripts in Python or JavaScript.

  • Systems thinking: good judgment about where logic and data should live across connected systems.

  • Salesforce Platform App Builder or Platform Developer I certification;
  • Git/SFDX; depth in Gong, ZoomInfo or HubSpot; cloud platform experience;
  • experience with an integration platform or event-driven systems.

The start date for this position is 11/16/2026. Training period: 6 weeks.


During the training period, the hours will be Monday through Friday 9am - 5:30pm ET. Once training is completed, schedules will be assigned as noted below:


Consult: Monday through Friday

  • OH- 11:30 am – 8 pm ET

POSITION SUMMARY

The Staff Pharmacist interprets physicians’ prescriptions, contacts doctors or other prescribers and/or patients to verify information on prescriptions and expedite processing of order.

The Staff Pharmacist may track order status and outstanding issues as well as consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions.

This individual may take calls from customers regarding lost orders or dispensing errors, maintain daily production, quality and service levels, vary work priorities and activities to accommodate business needs.

The Staff Pharmacist may also train less experienced pharmacists.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions. Contact physicians for new and/or transfer authorization. Collaborate with physicians to convert prescriptions to generic or preferred drugs whenever possible. Interpret physicians’ or prescribers’ prescriptions. Contact doctors and/or patients to verify information on prescriptions such as drug strength, prescription sig., and drug name in order to expedite processing of orders. Provide oversight and quality assurance to pharmacy technicians. Verify and confirm validity of controlled substances. Verify prescription information entered in the system by data entry or order entry. Back up other pharmacists as needed, perform additional duties as assigned by management, or train less experienced pharmacists.


QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy required, PharmD preferred

Current active resident pharmacist license in good standing.

Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other departments to resolve issues.

Good oral and written communication skills.

Ability to read and interpret prescriptions.

Strong focus on customer service, quality and accuracy.

Ability to manage timelines and meet tight client deadlines.

Ability to adapt in a changing environment.

Ability to work a flexible schedule for peak volume times.

raw.description:
Country Manager Benin

As Country Manager in Benin, you understand the crucial role strong business ecosystems play in driving economic growth, social inclusion, and sustainable development. You bring a solid local network of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and partners, combined with proven experience in programme management and team leadership. Do you thrive on building meaningful partnerships, leading a result-driven team, and creating lasting impact across your country? This is your opportunity!

About PUM

PUM is a unique organisation committed to making a positive impact on a global scale. With a network of 1,200 skilled voluntary experts, we collaborate with ambitious entrepreneurs in 26 countries and 12 programmes, sharing expertise to strengthen business ecosystems and create economic, social, and environmental value. We work closely with SMEs, as well as the organisations that support them. We believe in the power of collaboration and in the magic that happens when diverse perspectives come together; Together we grow!

The role

You will lead the country acquisition team in Benin, consisting of 5 country representatives on a freelance basis who engage change-driven SMEs to participate in PUM's impactful programmes. You hold end-to-end responsibility for client relationship management after acquisition, ensuring continuity, quality of engagement, and strategic alignment. You will be part of the Africa regional team, reporting to the head of region and collaborating closely with 15 other country managers in the region, 12 programme managers, as well as other departments such as recruitment and communications & partnerships. Your daily activities will be varied and challenging:

  • You develop and implement the Country Impact Plan (CIP) in line with PUM’s mission, strategy, and organisational ambitions.

  • You center on strengthening business ecosystems, based on strategic analysis and in line with PUM’s programmes. You are able to establish partnerships and collaborate with wider networks of entrepreneurs, business organisations and other enabling organisations to advance business ecosystems.

  • You identify, develop, and secure funding opportunities from institutional donors, foundations, corporate partners, and other possible sponsors, contributing to the sustainability and growth of PUM's impact in Benin.

  • You foster strategic partnerships with SMEs and stakeholders through proactive account management and ongoing engagement, building trust and long-term impact, while expanding PUM's visibility, credibility and country influence.

  • You build, lead, and coach the country representative team, safeguarding the quality and continuity of acquisition.

  • You ensure team capacity, motivation, accountability, and performance through effective people management, including organising country team meetings (CTMs).

  • You qualify new clients using assessment criteria that emphasise diversity, inclusion, and alignment with PUM’s green and social goals within business ecosystems.

  • You approve project proposals, ensuring accurate and complete information so programme managers can identify the right expert match.

  • You collaborate closely with programme managers to ensure alignment, shared goals, and successful projects. Occasionally, you will welcome and accompany visiting experts.

  • You personally engage with clients after acquisition, ensuring continuity, quality of engagement, and strategic fit.

  • You lead professional briefing and debriefing sessions to ensure quality assurance, data collection, and learning.

  • You monitor performance and use data to share insights and improve results. 

  • You ensure compliance with organisational policies, quality standards, and project timelines.

Who are you?

As Country Manager, you combine strategic vision with operational excellence. You understand the challenges that local SMEs face and know how to translate entrepreneurial ambition into tangible impact. Does this sound like you?

  • You are a proactive, hands-on and strategic thinker with a bachelor's or master's degree.

  • You bring at least 10 years of experience in a coordinating role and leading a commercial or acquisition-focused team.

  • You have a strong local SME network and a deep understanding of business ecosystem development in your country.

  • You are familiar with European work culture and experienced in remote collaboration within international organisations.

  • You demonstrate strong intercultural communication skills and collaborate effectively across departments and stakeholders.

  • You have proven leadership and accountability skills, with experience in performance management and stakeholder engagement.

  • You are experienced in managing a remote team operating across the country.

  • You are willing to travel occasionally within Benin for project development visits, partnership meetings, and country team meetings.

  • You are strongly focused on impact, quality, and measurable results.

  • You thrive in an organisation in growth and transition and enjoy contributing to further professionalisation.

  • You are data-driven and comfortable using digital tools, including Microsoft 365.

  • You have excellent command of English and speak French fluently.

  • You are permanently based in Benin and available for 30 hours per week.

What we offer

This assignment is offered on an independent contractor basis with an expected commitment of approximately 30 hours per week, up to a maximum of 1.440 hours per year. The initial assignment is for one year, with the possibility of extension based on organisational needs and a successful collaboration. You will receive a competitive fee aligned with local market standards, reflecting the responsibilities and scope of the role. As an independent contractor, you are responsible for your own taxes, social security contributions, insurance and any other statutory obligations that apply in your country of residence. Reference checks and a declaration of good conduct are part of the selection process. At PUM, we celebrate diversity and inclusion as essential pillars of our organisation. We embrace the uniqueness of each individual, fostering an environment where everyone can thrive by being their authentic selves.

Ready to make a difference? Join us!

Becoming a Country Manager at PUM isn’t just a career move; it’s a chance to drive meaningful change. Working at a volunteer organisation like PUM offers extra fulfilment. In addition to the benefits mentioned, here’s what else awaits you:

  • Building a brighter future: Contribute to the sustainable development of communities, cultivating a profound sense of fulfilment

  • Optimal knowledge utilisation: Put your expertise to its best use, making tangible impact on businesses worldwide.

  • Continuous learning: Embrace new perspectives and gain insights by connecting with diverse people and cultures.

  • Building a professional network: Collaborate with a vast network of stakeholders, including institutional funders, government entities, and NGOs.

  • International exposure: Immerse yourself in a multicultural environment, broadening your horizons.

Apply now and be part of something truly meaningful!

Get inspired by one of our successful projects within our Horticulture programme in Benin: Sustainable growth in greenhouses in Benin - PUM

In the case of a high volume of applications we reserve the right to close the vacancy early and begin interviews before the deadline on 3 November 2026. Please submit your CV and motivation letter in English.

Highlights

Picture yourself as people manager, leading the country team of Benin. Are you ready to shape a brighter tomorrow? Join PUM and let’s make a lasting impact together!

raw.excerpt: Get ready to Leave your MarkGemeinsam entwickeln wir Inspektions-, Klassifikations- und Zertifizierungslösungen.
raw.description:
Get ready to Leave your Mark

Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Inspektions-, Klassifikations- und Zertifizierungslösungen. Mit großem Erfolg: Heute vertrauen mehr als 400.000 Unternehmen weltweit darauf, dass wir ihre Welt sicherer machen. Tag für Tag, mit mehr als 78.000 starken Persönlichkeiten in über 140 Ländern.

Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity sucht eine/einen Senior IT/OT Security Consultant (m/w/d)

Stellen Sie sich vor, Ihr Kunde ist ein führendes Produktionsunternehmen oder Betreiber kritischer Infrastrukturen, das auf die Herstellung spezialisierter Produkte oder die Bereitstellung essenzieller Dienstleistungen fokussiert ist, die Industrie und Gesellschaft am Laufen halten. Als OT-Security-Experte verfolgen Sie eine anspruchsvolle Mission: die Optimierung der Betriebseffizienz, die Sicherstellung der Compliance mit branchenführenden Zertifizierungen sowie den Schutz der Systeme, die das Herzstück der Betriebsabläufe Ihrer Kunden bilden.

Genau hier kommen Sie ins Spiel. Durch gezielte Schulungen führen Sie Ihre Kunden in die Welt der IEC 62443 ein, dem Goldstandard für OT-Cybersicherheit, sowie des Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), der zentralen Cybersicherheitsverordnung für Produkte. Unsere Gap-Analysen decken Schwachstellen in Prozessen und Systemen auf und schaffen eine klare Grundlage für mehr Cybersicherheit und Compliance. Sie arbeiten eng mit Ihren Kunden zusammen und unterstützen sie mit fundierter Beratung und praxisnaher Begleitung bei der Bewältigung ihrer Herausforderungen.

Mit unserer Expertise in Risikoanalysen und unabhängigen OT-Security-Assessments befähigen Sie Ihre Kunden, ein außergewöhnlich hohes Maß an Cyber-Resilienz zu erreichen. Von der Absicherung industrieller Steuerungssysteme bis zum Schutz kritischer Prozesse stärken Ihre Maßnahmen nicht nur die Sicherheitslage, sondern ebnen auch den Weg zu erfolgreichen Zertifizierungen.

Ihre Erfolgsgeschichte? Sie besteht nicht nur darin, Compliance-Anforderungen zu erfüllen. Sie sorgen dafür, dass die OT-Umgebung Ihrer Kunden widerstandsfähig, sicher und zukunftsfähig ist.

Als Cybersecurity-Sparte von Bureau Veritas möchten wir unser Beraterteam in Deutschland weiter ausbauen. Deshalb suchen wir einen Senior IT/OT Security Consultant (m/w/d) mit Sitz in Deutschland, der OT-Sicherheitsprojekte in verschiedenen Branchen begleitet.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Beratung unserer Kunden zu SCADA-, ICS- und OT-Infrastrukturen in kleinen bis großen Projekten. Dazu gehören Sicherheitsrisikoanalysen auf Basis der IEC 62443, Gap-Analysen, Security-Maturity-Assessments, Trainings sowie Beratungsleistungen.
  • Unterstützung bei der Konzeption von Sicherheitsarchitekturen und Sicherheitsdesigns für industrielle Netzwerke sowie Ableitung konkreter Verbesserungsempfehlungen.
  • Unterstützung unserer Kunden beim Aufbau oder der Weiterentwicklung ihrer SCADA-/ICS-/OT-Sicherheitsprogramme durch die gemeinsame Entwicklung von Roadmaps.
  • Anwendung von Secure-by-Design-Prinzipien, Threat Modeling und Risikoanalysen auf OT-Produkte.
  • Nachweisbare Kenntnisse der Normenreihe IEC 62443, des Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), von NIS2 sowie branchenspezifischer Standards wie TISAX, UR E26/E27, EASA Part-IS und weiterer relevanter Vorgaben.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse deutscher Cybersecurity-Behörden, Themen und Regulierungen wie BSI, KRITIS sowie branchenspezifischer Sicherheitsanforderungen.
  • Durchführung von OT-Cybersecurity-Schulungen zu IEC 62443, CRA sowie weiteren Standards und gesetzlichen Anforderungen.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering- und Supply-Chain-Teams zur Implementierung und Überprüfung wirksamer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen.
  • Bewertung von Sicherheitslücken, Risiken, Richtlinien und Prozessen im Hinblick auf deren betriebliche Auswirkungen.
  • Planung und Durchführung von Assessments auf Basis international anerkannter Frameworks oder spezifischer Bureau-Veritas-Cybersecurity-Methoden sowie Unterstützung von Kunden auf ihrem Zertifizierungsweg.
  • Unterstützung unseres Vertriebsteams durch Ihre technische Expertise.

Ihr Profil

  • Erfahrung mit industriellen Systemen wie PLCs, DCS oder SCADA.
  • Kenntnisse industrieller Kommunikationsprotokolle wie Modbus oder IEC 104.
  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen und Threat Modeling.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch. Sie sind in der Lage, auf allen Ebenen zu kommunizieren, von der Geschäftsführung bis hin zu technischen Spezialisten und nicht-technischen Ansprechpartnern.
  • Kenntnisse relevanter Standards und Frameworks wie IEC 62443, MITRE ATT&CK for ICS, NIST CSF oder NIST SP 800-82.
  • Erfahrung im Wissenstransfer, beispielsweise durch Whitepaper, Fachvorträge, Präsentationen oder öffentliche Vorträge, beziehungsweise die Motivation, sich in diesem Bereich zu engagieren, ist ein großer Pluspunkt.
  • Eine proaktive Persönlichkeit. Sie denken gemeinsam mit Kunden an Lösungen und verstehen es, Menschen für Ihre Ideen zu gewinnen.

Was Sie bei Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity erwartet

Bei Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity arbeiten Sie in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Fachkompetenz und gesellschaftlicher Mehrwert im Mittelpunkt stehen. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Sie den größten Beitrag leisten können, wenn Sie Raum zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung erhalten und aktiv an einer sichereren digitalen Gesellschaft mitwirken.

Sinnstiftende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die Cybersecurity-Sparte von Bureau Veritas wächst dynamisch, und Sie haben die Möglichkeit, mit uns zu wachsen. Ob mehr Verantwortung, eine höhere Sichtbarkeit innerhalb und außerhalb der Organisation oder Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen: Ihre berufliche Entwicklung hat für uns hohe Priorität.

Darüber hinaus arbeiten Sie an Projekten mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert. Ob beim Schutz intelligenter Geräte vor Cyberangriffen oder bei IT-Audits im öffentlichen Sektor – Sie erweitern Ihre Fähigkeiten und leisten gleichzeitig einen wichtigen Beitrag. Strukturierte Entwicklungspfade, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche und vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten unterstützen Ihren Erfolg.

Arbeiten mit einem vielfältigen Kundenportfolio

Unsere Kunden stammen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen und Kontexten, haben jedoch eines gemeinsam: Sie verlassen sich auf unsere Expertise, um Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen zu erfüllen und ihre Cyber-Resilienz zu stärken.

In Ihrer Rolle tragen Sie zum Schutz von Menschen, Prozessen und Technologien in IT-, OT- und IoT-Umgebungen bei und unterstützen Kunden dabei, Risiken zu erkennen und gezielt zu adressieren.

Zusammenarbeit in einer hochqualifizierten Experten-Community

Cybersicherheit kennt keine Landesgrenzen – und unsere Zusammenarbeit ebenso wenig. Gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Ländern, Fachbereichen und Kulturen arbeiten Sie an innovativen Lösungen, verbunden durch ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Qualität und Integrität.

Wir teilen Wissen, lernen voneinander und entwickeln neue Ansätze, unterstützt durch unsere Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprogramme sowie praxisnahe Testlabore.

Eine Kultur von Respekt, Zusammenhalt und Wohlbefinden

Wir fördern aktiv ein sicheres, inklusives und positives Arbeitsumfeld. Unsere Werte bestimmen, wie wir zusammenarbeiten, Feedback geben und Leistungen bewerten.

Das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeitenden unterstützen wir durch Teamaktivitäten, den Zugang zu OpenUp.com sowie flexible Arbeitsmodelle, die eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance ermöglichen. Wir feiern Erfolge gemeinsam und legen großen Wert auf ein angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld.

Sind Sie der Senior IT/OT Security Consultant, den wir suchen?

Job Summary

Camping World's customers aren't just shoppers. They are a community of people who are passionate about the RV lifestyle, the outdoors, and the experiences that come with both. As a Social Media Specialist, you will be the person who shows up for that community every day across every platform where they gather. We are not looking for someone to manage a queue. We are looking for someone who genuinely wants to represent this brand and the people behind it.


Social media is 24/7, and so is our community. The right person for this role understands that and is comfortable with the flexibility that comes with it, including occasional evening or weekend availability as needed.


You will be part of our Community Experience team, working closely with our Social Media Community Manager, but operating independently and owning your work from start to finish.


Responsibilities

  • Own each customer interaction, ensuring every person who reaches out feels heard, helped, and valued.
  • Respond to comments, questions, and direct messages across all brand social platforms in a timely, accurate, and on-brand way.
  • Proactively engage with followers, community members, and relevant conversations to strengthen brand relationships and keep conversations going.
  • Participate authentically in the spaces where our audience already gathers, including Facebook, Reddit, and beyond.
  • Write in a way that reflects the Camping World brand voice while adapting naturally to each platform's tone and culture.
  • Resolve issues with empathy, turning challenging interactions into positive experiences wherever possible.
  • Escalate when needed and follow through until the issue is resolved.
  • Monitor brand mentions and social conversations to identify engagement opportunities and surface anything that needs attention.

Requirements

  • Strong copywriting skills with the ability to write with clarity, personality, and tonal awareness across platforms.
  • A genuine passion for social media. You are fluent on Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, Threads, Reddit, and LinkedIn, and understand the culture and expectations of each platform.
  • Critical thinking and sound judgment. You can read a situation and determine the right response without a script for every scenario.
  • The ability to engage proactively and reactively, shifting naturally between initiating and resolving conversations.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple conversations across multiple platforms independently.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A passion for the RV lifestyle, camping, or the outdoors.
  • RV industry or product knowledge is a plus.
  • Prior experience in customer service, community management, or social media in any context, professional or otherwise.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM platform.
  • Experience with Sprout Social or a comparable social media management tool.

General Compensation Disclosure

The pay range for this role considers several factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At Camping World, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the factors stated. A reasonable estimate of the current range is listed below.

Pay Range:

$18.45-$22.14 Hourly

In addition to competitive pay, we offer Paid Time Off, 401(k), an Employee Assistance Program, Good Sam Roadside Assistance, discounts, paid parental leave (if eligibility is met), Tuition Reimbursement (if eligibility is met), and on the job training opportunities. Full-time associates are offered a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision and more! Part-time associates are offered access to dental & vision coverage! Summary

About the role
Our ANZ InsuranceSuite practice delivers Guidewire implementations and cloud transformations for some of the largest insurers in the region. As an Architect, you own the design and delivery of one workstream on a customer program, either Functional (PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, BillingCenter) or Integration. You work alongside a Lead or Senior Architect and mentor the consultants and developers on your track.

You'll be hands-on. You design the solution, build the hard parts, review your team's work, and are the person the customer's project leadership relies on for your track. We hire Architects with the expectation that they grow into Senior Architects, and we put the mentoring and project exposure in place for that.

Job Description

What you'll do

  • Design and estimate: Turn business requirements into designs for medium-complexity product gaps and enhancements. Estimate the work accurately and explain the trade-offs clearly.
  • Lead a workstream: Take full responsibility for defining, planning and delivering your track, from backlog shape and quality reviews to delivering on commitments.
  • Build and review: Write production-quality configuration and code in Gosu and Java on Guidewire Cloud Platform. Lead code and design reviews so your track meets Guidewire Cloud standards.
  • Anticipate problems: Find risks and issues before they land. Bring facts, analysis and options to the customer and the project team, not just the problem.
  • Deliver with AI: Use AI-assisted engineering tools in design, configuration, integration and testing to deliver faster without lowering quality, and help your team adopt the patterns that work.
  • Coach the team: Mentor junior consultants and the customer's or partner's developers on Guidewire functionality, best practice and delivery methodology.
  • Work with project leadership: Communicate clearly with project managers, product owners and customer architects. Adjust your message for the audience and help them make informed decisions.
  • Contribute to the practice: Share what you learn through reusable assets, knowledge articles and internal sessions.

Track focus

Functional:

  • Configure PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter or BillingCenter across the insurance lifecycle: product model, rules, workflows and UI.
  • Use Advanced Product Designer (APD) and product-definition patterns to model and change products.
  • Work with business analysts and product owners to turn user stories into configuration and to find gaps against base product early.

Integration:

  • Design and build integrations using Cloud API, Integration Gateway, App Events and messaging.
  • Connect InsuranceSuite to the customer's systems and third parties, such as payments, documents, rating, data and identity.
  • Own the integration contracts, error handling and non-functional behaviour (performance, resilience, security) for your track.

What success looks like in your first year

  • You're running a workstream on a customer program on your own, and the customer's project leadership treats you as the go-to person for your track.
  • Your designs and estimates hold up in delivery, and your team's work consistently passes Guidewire Cloud standards and quality reviews.
  • At least one junior team member has visibly improved through your coaching.
  • You've contributed at least one reusable asset or pattern back to the practice.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years delivering core insurance or enterprise systems, including at least 3 years hands-on with Guidewire InsuranceSuite (PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter or BillingCenter).
  • Delivery across most phases of an implementation, including Inception, build, stabilisation and go-live.
  • Strong knowledge of one InsuranceSuite product and a working understanding of at least one other.
  • Proficiency in Gosu and Java, plus Git-based delivery and CI/CD (TeamCity, Jenkins or similar).
  • Experience leading a small team or a workstream, including reviewing other people's work.
  • A good understanding of P&C insurance operations: policy, claims and billing.
  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working directly with customer stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Delivery on Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP), or a self-managed-to-cloud migration.
  • Experience with Jutro, Guidewire Data Platform, or the wider Guidewire portfolio.
  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents in a delivery team.
  • Experience in Agile delivery, including holding a Scrum Master or delivery-lead role.
  • Knowledge of the ANZ insurance market, including regulatory context such as APRA.

Qualifications

  • Guidewire ACE certification in at least one InsuranceSuite product (or the ability to get one within six months of joining).
  • A degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • AWS or other cloud certification is a plus.

Why join us

  • Work on the platform itself, alongside the people who build it, on some of the largest insurance programs in the region.
  • A defined path from Architect to Senior Architect and beyond, with mentoring from experienced Lead Architects.
  • Early access to how Guidewire is using AI to change InsuranceSuite delivery

.

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.


As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

Remote-first, fast-paced, people-driven and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams beyond borders. And we're looking for people who want to win while doing it.

More Than a Role

The UK and Irish markets are full of ambitious companies trapped by hiring borders. A London scale-up has found the perfect engineer in Lisbon but doesn't know how to employ her compliantly. A Dublin founder wants to put fresh funding into expanding to three countries by next quarter. As our Junior Account Executive UK & Ireland, your mission is powerful: Open up the world's talent pool to UK and Irish companies.

This is a Junior AE role, built for a top-performer who's ready to close their own deals, not by pushing a product, but by advising with substance and closing with confidence. You're confident in front of decision-makers, curious enough to ask the questions others don't, and ambitious about your numbers: hitting target is the minimum, outperforming it is what drives you. Your energy shows in your can-do attitude and follow-through, day in, day out.


Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity:

  • Command Your Territory: Own the full sales cycle in he UK and Ireland, from first conversation to onboarded talent.
  • Curious Questioner: Ask the second and third question. Uncover where, why and how fast a company is hiring, and what's at stake if compliance goes wrong.
  • Champion Builder: Equip your HR champion with the arguments Finance, Legal and leadership care about, so decision-makers see the value, not just the price.
  • Deal Momentum: Create urgency, negotiate with confidence and keep deals moving.
  • Self-Made Pipeline: Roll your sleeves up and team up with the BDRs to go after the biggest opportunities in your territory.


What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…

  • Your Background: BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS, or another targetdriven, customer-facing role. You're self-driven, learn fast and know your numbers.
  • Discovery Experience: You've led conversations to uncover a prospect's or client's needs, and you're eager to take them all the way to a signed deal.
  • Outbound DNA: A cold call is a chance, not a threat. You know how to get a busy founder's attention, from a well-timed call after a funding round to a voice note they actually listen to.
  • AI-Savvy & Organized: AI is a natural part of how you work, making you faster and sharper every day. And your HubSpot (or similar CRM) is always up to date.
  • Coachable: You ask for feedback and put it into action the same day.
  • Native-Level English: You communicate with ease and credibility, and you understand what makes UK and Irish buyers tick.

Bonus Points If You Bring:

  • Experience with HR tech, payroll, EOR or other compliance-heavy solutions
  • First closing experience, for example running your own demos or closing smaller deals
  • Creativity in getting your foot in the door: find a smart way to reach the hiring managers directly, and show them why you're the right person for this role

Not Your Typical Team:

We're a team of 26 sales minds, from BDRs, AEs and Team Leads to our CRM, Sales Enablement and Campaign Manager, based across Europe, Africa and the Middle East, a motivated, fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected." We don't just work together, we push, challenge and grow together. We share what works, celebrate each other's successes, learn from every win and loss, and jump in when a colleague needs a second voice to get a deal over the line. If you're looking for an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your voice is heard, and bold strategies thrive on collective brainpower and high-energy teamwork, you'll feel right at home.


The Perks of Being Here…

  • Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
  • Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day, a full day off just to recharge and relax.
  • Get fit and stay active: Whether it's yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog, work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidized gym memberships.

  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!
  • Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

RubinBrown is one of the nation’s leading accounting and professional consulting firms with a commitment to building personal relationships and delivering totally satisfied clients. The RubinBrown name and reputation are synonymous with experience, integrity and value. RubinBrown has revenue of approximately $265 million with 1,000+ team members across locations in Chicago, Denver, Detroit, Kansas City, Las Vegas, Mumbai (India), Nashville, and St. Louis.

RubinBrown is seeking a Manager – System of Quality Management & Audit Quality to join its Professional Standards Group (PSG) within the Firm’s Assurance Services practice. The individual will work closely with Assurance leadership, response and process owners, and other stakeholders across the Firm to support the monitoring, evaluation, remediation, and continuous improvement of the SoQM

Major Responsibilities

  • Support the ongoing monitoring and continuous improvement of the firm’s System of Quality Management (SoQM) and related quality initiatives in accordance with applicable professional standards, including SQMS 1 and PCAOB QC 1000.
  • Support the Firm’s quality risk assessment process, including the identification and assessment of quality risks and the design, implementation, and documentation of responses to address those risks.
  • Plan and execute SoQM monitoring activities, including testing the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of quality responses and controls; evaluating and documenting exceptions and testing results; and developing clear, supportable conclusions.
  • Coordinate monitoring and testing activities across multiple process and response owners, including planning work, managing dependencies and deadlines, following up on outstanding items, and driving assigned workstreams to completion.
  • Provide direction and oversight to team members supporting SoQM monitoring and testing activities, including coordinating assignments, reviewing work performed, and providing coaching and feedback.
  • Evaluate observations and findings identified through SoQM monitoring, internal and external inspections, engagement reviews, and other sources of quality information
  • Perform and facilitate root cause analyses and collaborate with stakeholders to develop, implement, and evaluate appropriate remedial actions.
  • Support the Firm’s annual evaluation of the SoQM, including analyzing findings, deficiencies, remediation activities, trends, emerging risks, and other relevant information and preparing clear, concise documentation and reporting for Firm leadership.
  • Analyze quality-related information from monitoring activities, inspections, root cause analyses, audit quality indicators, and other sources to identify trends, emerging risks, recurring themes, and opportunities to enhance audit quality.
  • Prepare clear, concise reports, dashboards, presentations, and other communications regarding SoQM results, trends, findings, remediation activities, and other quality matters for PSG and Firm leadership.
  • Support the Firm’s internal and external inspection programs and monitoring activities, including PCAOB inspections, peer reviews, internal engagement inspections, and other quality reviews, as applicable.
  • Assist with the development and enhancement of Firm policies, procedures, methodologies, tools, templates, training, and other resources supporting audit quality and the SoQM.
  • Stay informed of changes in applicable professional standards and regulatory requirements and assist in assessing their impact on the Firm’s SoQM and related policies and processes.

Preferred Experience / Background / Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field (advanced degree a plus)
  • 6+ years of relevant public accounting experience, with significant US GAAP exposure
  • Active CPA license, required
  • Experience in one or both of the following areas, preferred:
    • System of quality management, audit quality, professional practice, internal inspections, monitoring, remediation, or related quality-management activities
    • Audits of internal control over financial reporting (ICFR) or similar controls-based audit work, including experience testing the design and operating effectiveness of controls, evaluating exceptions, and documenting conclusions
  • Significant knowledge of U.S. generally accepted auditing standards and experience applying professional auditing standards in practice
  • Familiarity with PCAOB auditing and quality control standards, AICPA quality management standards, and related regulatory requirements preferred
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to evaluate testing results and other complex information,
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills while maintaining appropriate objectivity and professional skepticism.
  • Exceptional communication skills, verbal and written.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently drive matters to completion.
  • Able to research, learn, and implement quality and auditing tools and technologies.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound professional judgment, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, prioritize competing demands, and appropriately identify and escalate matters requiring leadership attention.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with data analysis, reporting, dashboarding, or quality management tools is a plus.

Working Conditions

  • Typical office hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday
  • Ability to work extra hours as necessary based on workload, deadlines, and other Firm requirements
  • Ability to travel periodically, as needed, for Firm meetings, inspections, training, or other PSG and Assurance activities.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods of time and work in a professional office or remote location
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, pull up to 10-20 pounds
  • Ability to speak, read, and write English fluently to communicate with team members and leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects under deadlines with high attention to detail.

raw.title: Medical Director, AI Safety
raw.excerpt: About AvoAvo is the leading AI platform for healthcare enterprises, helping clinicians make better decisions, move faster, and improve the quality of patient care.
raw.description:
About Avo

Avo is the leading AI platform for healthcare enterprises, helping clinicians make better decisions, move faster, and improve the quality of patient care. Serving as a central hub for care teams, Avo brings together patient data, clinical knowledge, and AI-powered workflows to support diagnosis, care planning, documentation, orders, and evidence-based decision-making at the point of care. Clinicians today navigate dozens of tabs, applications, datasets, hospital protocols, medical guidelines, and payer policies to deliver high-quality care. Avo changes that.

We are product-obsessed, collaborative, and scrappy, united by a mission to improve healthcare delivery through AI. Our investors include Noro-Moseley Partners, AlleyCorp, Scrub Capital, and several leading hospitals and universities.

The Role

We are seeking a Medical Director, AI Safety that will own the safety of Avo's AI-generated clinical content. That means deciding what "safe enough to ship" means for a discharge summary, a pre-visit summary, or a decision-support module, building the tests that enforce it, and signing off before it reaches a clinician. You will design the grading rubrics, run the evaluations, classify failures by clinical severity, and turn the findings into changes the Studio and engineering teams make.

Roughly 85% of your time goes to safety. The remaining 15% splits two ways: building clinical modules yourself in Avo's Studio, so your safety judgments are grounded in how the content is actually produced, and joining sales and customer conversations as the physician who can explain how we test and why a CMIO should trust the output.

You report to the CMIO, with a dotted line to the Chief Commercial Officer.

What You'll Do

  • AI safety (core of the role)

    • Define the safety standard for each product line: what counts as a hallucination, an omission, or a clinically material error, and how severe each is
    • Design and run evaluation protocols for clinical AI modules, including hallucination detection, omission analysis, and accuracy checks against source records and evidence-based guidelines
    • Build and maintain a clinical harm taxonomy and grading rubric (NCC MERP-style severity scoring) and apply it across benchmark sets
    • Review AI-generated clinical content directly, and grade the automated graders so we know when to trust them
    • Own the release gate: write the go/no-go safety assessment for new modules and major prompt or model changes
    • Investigate reported clinical errors from customers, trace root cause, and drive the fix through Studio and engineering
    • Write the safety reports, validation summaries, and white papers that buyers and their clinical governance committees ask for
    • Track the regulatory and standards landscape for clinical AI (FDA, ONC, CHAI, Joint Commission) and translate it into internal requirements

    Clinical builder (~5-10%)

    • Build or revise clinical modules in Avo's Studio, applying evidence-based guidelines and your own practice experience
    • Feed what you learn from building back into the safety protocols, and vice versa

    Sales-forward clinician (~5-10%)

    • Join prospect calls and pilot evaluations as the physician who can speak to how Avo's content is validated
    • Present the safety program to CMIOs, CIOs, and clinical quality leaders, and answer their hardest questions about failure modes
    • Challenge the status quo in the room: name where legacy documentation and CDS workflows fail patients, and show how a tested AI alternative does better

What You Bring

  • Active clinical license (MD/DO, NP, or PA) with hands-on patient care experience
  • 3-7 years of clinical practice; you can read a discharge summary and spot the missed anticoagulation plan in under a minute
  • Experience with or strong interest in clinical AI, CDS, or health informatics
  • A testing mindset: you like designing the rubric, arguing about edge cases, and finding the error nobody else caught
  • Ability to write a clear, defensible safety report for a clinical governance committee
  • Comfort presenting to C-suite clinical leaders and answering pointed questions about AI failure modes
  • Willingness to define the role's scope as the product and company grow

*Travel: Some travel expected for customer meetings and demos, up to 10%

Nice to Have

  • Experience with EHR systems (Epic, Meditech, Athena)
  • Background in clinical informatics, quality improvement, or patient safety
  • Prior experience in a sales engineering, solutions, or customer-facing clinical role
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM evaluation methodologies

Why Join Avo

Impact: Avo’s products run inside hospitals, helping clinicians make better calls at the point of care. The work is real, and the mission is meaningful.

Ownership: We have a bias for action; you'll work alongside teams who take initiative, follow through on commitments, and take accountability for results.

High Agency: We move fast, trust our people, and avoid bureaucracy.

Great Team: Work alongside a talented, low-ego group of clinicians, engineers, and product folks who care deeply about craft.

Remote-First: Work from anywhere in the US. The company has offices in NYC, so if you’re in the area we’d love the chance to work in-person together 2 days/week.

How We Take Care of Our Team

  • Generous Time Off: Flexible and generous PTO
  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
  • 401K Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future
  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax-free funds for personal device usage
  • Compensation and Equity: $175,000 - $200,000 OTE and equity
