raw.description:
Help Shape the Future of Behavioral Addiction Treatment

As online gambling and gaming continue to expand, so does the need for specialized behavioral health care. At Kindbridge Behavioral Health, a Joint Commission-accredited telehealth organization, we help individuals and families affected by gambling, gaming, and related challenges while providing therapists the opportunity to build expertise in this growing field.

We're seeking part-time Therapists licensed to practice in Louisiana (residency in LA not required) who are interested in expanding their clinical skill set, working with a unique client population, and making a meaningful impact through flexible, remote work.

Why Choose Kindbridge:

Develop a Specialized Clinical Skill Set — Gain hands-on experience treating gambling, gaming, and other behavioral addictions while building expertise in one of behavioral health's fastest-growing specialties

Receive Clinical Training & Mentorship — We provide ongoing education, clinical consultation, and support pursuing the International Certified Gambling Counselor (ICGC-I) credential through mentorship from a nationally recognized, Ph.D.-trained, ICGC-II-certified gambling addiction clinician

Join an Accredited Behavioral Health Organization — Work with a Joint Commission-accredited organization committed to the highest standards of quality, safety and patient care

Focus on Clinical Work — We handle credentialing, billing, insurance claims, collections, and other administrative tasks so you can focus on providing care

Build a Flexible Remote Practice — Set your own schedule and maintain a caseload that aligns with your availability and professional goals

Work Alongside Experts in the Field — Join a collaborative team of clinicians who are passionate about advancing care for individuals and families seeking support for compulsive or overuse behaviors, or emotional dysregulation struggles through compassionate, evidence-based treatment

What We Provide:

  • ICGC-I certification support
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Clinical consultation and peer support
  • Insurance credentialing support
  • Assistance with and funding for additional state licensure
  • Administrative and billing support
  • Flexible scheduling and remote work
  • W-2 employment
  • 401(k) with employer match

Who We're Looking For:

  • Active clinical licensure in the state of Louisiana: LPC, LPCC, LCSW, LMFT, or equivalent license
  • Interest in gambling disorder, gaming disorder, and other behavioral challenges
  • Desire to pursue ICGC-I certification with company support
  • Commitment to evidence-based, client-centered care
  • Interest in collaborating with a team that’s driving innovation in teletherapy
  • Spanish fluency is a plus

Join Our Mission:

At Kindbridge, you'll have the opportunity to expand your expertise into a highly specialized area of behavioral health while helping individuals and families affected by gambling, gaming, and related behavioral challenges.

If you're looking for meaningful clinical work, ongoing mentorship, and the opportunity to become a leader in an emerging field, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a remote position.

A Crypto wallet security infrastructure provider are looking for a VP of Solutions Engineering

They develop the most secure wallet-as-a-service infrastructure in Web3 : an API-first wallet management system, ideal for applications and organizations seeking to provide secure access to all blockchains through a single integration). APIs and SDKs were designed for wallet programmability and efficient implementations, enabling fast deployments, smart automation flows, as well as granular sets of permissions and policies via secure authentication credentials. They are on the way to become the leading wallet infrastructure for the multi-trillion-dollar digital asset industry.

The company is SOC-2 certified, employs 30 people across 6 countries and has raised over $20M since creation with prestigious investors. Their solution is used and trusted by major international corporations.

As the VP of Solutions Engineering you will help financial institutions and enterprises adopt the company's platform with confidence and ease.
This high-impact role is both strategic and hands-on:
  • You’ll design integrations for complex legacy systems, guide clients through deployment, and offer end-to-end technical support.
  • You’ll pair deep technical expertise with strong client-facing skills, serving as an advisor to CTOs, architects, and engineering teams at banks, fintechs, and enterprises.
  • You’ll design tailored solutions, deliver technical proposals, and drive adoption via troubleshooting, clear docs, and tight collaboration with engineering, security, and product.
  • You’ll sit at the intersection of engineering and customer success, equally comfortable whiteboarding ideas, writing code examples, and jumping on late calls to help a customer.
MISSIONS
Guide financial institutions through safe and seamless onboarding to the company's platform.
Architect secure, scalable deployment pathways that fit into legacy and modern systems.
Provide hands-on support: troubleshoot, fix, and build solutions alongside client teams.
Collaborate with sales to design technical proposals, demos, and RFP responses.
Maintain and improve technical docs and developer guides to industry standards.
Gather client feedback, analyze competitors, and turn insights into product tweaks.
Represent the company at conferences, workshops, and meetings as a technical thought leader.

Profil

  • 10+ years in solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise integration, with leadership experience.
  • Proven track record helping financial institutions deploy mission-critical systems.
  • Proficient in TypeScript (or similar languages) with strong API experience (REST).
  • Deep knowledge of cloud-native systems (AWS essential; GCP/IBM/Thales a plus), microservices, and serverless architectures.
  • Skilled in troubleshooting technical issues and delivering under pressure.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise security compliance (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS)
  • Excellent communicator, able to bridge technical and business threads with clients.
  • Excellent doc and demo skills; able to clarify matters for tech and non-tech teams.
  • Knowledge of blockchain, digital assets, and financial workflows strongly preferred.
  • Certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect) a plus; multilingual fluency also valued.

Informations contractuelles

  • Contract : Permanent role (Hybrid remote) in Nigeria or South Africa. remote first, office optional
  • Salary: 160,000–240,000 USD.
  • Equity: 100-200 stock options (0.1-0.4%) vested over 4 years with a one-year cliff.
  • Work essentials: MacBook Pro, iPhone, AirPods, screens, headsets, AirPods.
  • Training and coursework in Crypto, Blockchain, Security, code, Coding languages and other topics are paid for on-demand to encourage personal and professional growth.
  • Benefits: healthcare and life insurance, retirement plan, sponsored transportation, gym, lunch card, home office equipment, and other perks.
Recruitment process :
  • Video call with COO/CTO (30mn).
  • Cognitive and personality tests (45mn).
  • Coding test in a language of your choice
  • Focus interview (30mn x 3) : Code Review - Architecture review -Pre-sales fundamentals - Culture check fit

What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Basic Function and Scope of the Position:

The Applied Genomics Specialist (Infectious Disease Testing, Microbial Genomics, Agrigenomics) will be responsible in supporting the potential channel sales opportunities by facilitating translation of expertise and product knowledge into competitive and compelling sales strategies. The goal is to support the promotion of rapid adoption of lllumina technology. The Specialist will support in developing practical solutions and facilitate to build a community of satisfied customers by partnering with sales channel partners and marketing in both pre- and post-sales activities.

This role will focus on supporting lllumina's Infectious Disease Testing, Microbial Genomics, and Agrigenomics business in ASEAN to facilitate adoption of lllumina technology across Infectious Disease Testing, Microbial Genomics, Agrigenomics, and Environmental Genomics applications and others where opportunity presents. Occasional business trip may be required to support operational needs.

Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Apply the relevant local expertise for Infectious Disease Testing, Microbial Genomics, Agrigenomics, and Environmental Genomics applications and communicate customers’ needs to regional management, global product management, marketing and market development
  • Facilitate communicating a broad knowledge of the market environment including: current and possible future market trends, practices and information affecting the business; industry trends; competition and competitive environment; marketplace strategies and tactics
  • Communicate to customers on several aspects where necessary such as end-to-end workflows, study design, possible solutions, product positioning and competitor comparisons.
  • Support channel sales teams to impart deep domain knowledge, including discussion of relevant publications and supporting literature with key customers.
  • Have a deep knowledge of Illumina’s products and the value to customers
  • Provide engaging presentations to facilitate promotion of market interest in lllumina technologies
  • Demonstrate the ability being a valuable addition to discussions and conference programs
  • Attend relevant trade shows and conferences
  • In collaboration with channel sales and marketing teams, coordinate and execute strategic plans for winning new business for the purpose of expanding market share, and building upon existing programs.
  • Support the identification and interaction with key customer types such as Public Health and Infectious Disease Molecular Testing Laboratories, Academic Researchers, Plant and Animal Testing Service Providers, Professional Societies, to facilitate the introduction of Illumina products into new customer groups
  • Support channel sales management to approach the district market with new assays and technologies or customers to promote solutions within target customer base.
  • Regularly communicate updates to management of in-district, trends and any issues related to their specific product line performance, competitor activities, or other issues emerging in assigned territory.

  • Spend majority working time in the field, connect customers with channel partners to maintain positive relationships, support to execute strategies, tactics and to promote key solutions related to Illumina’s products.
  • Identify and interact with key opinion leaders and key customers in the Infectious Disease Testing, Microbial Genomics, Agrigenomics, and Environmental Genomics to communicate possible solutions and facilitate the introduction of Illumina products into new customer groups
  • Assist, as time permits, with other business development activities

Additional Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Liaison with customer and Illumina for custom and/or customized product development project (e.g. custom genotyping arrays)

  • Facilitate early adoption of Illumina’s multi-omics solutions across Infectious Disease Testing, Microbial Genomics, Agrigenomics, and Environmental Genomics applications

All listed tasks and responsibilities are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require additional tasks and responsibilities as is reasonable.

  • M.Sc. or PhD in a Microbiology, Virology, Public Health, Statistical / Population / Molecular Genetics, Molecular Biology degree preferred.

Preferred Experience & Skills:

  • 5-8 years experience in a related environment
  • Experience in at least one of the in the following fields: Infectious Disease Testing, Microbial Genomics, Agrigenomics, and Environmental Genomics required
  • Fluency in English required

  • Use of independent judgement in developing methods, techniques or evaluation criteria for obtaining results
  • Excellent time management skills – is able to prioritise workload accordingly

  • Independently works on highly complex problems requiring analysis of multiple variables

  • Demonstrated proactiveness in initiating and accomplishing tasks

  • Network of established customer relationships preferred
  • Experience in reporting basic financial data

Additional experiences

  • Experience with DNA microarray technology , molecular diagnostics , genotyping applications is preferred

raw.description:
VIATEQ Corporation is looking for an ICAM Migration Subject Matter Expert (SME)to support our Prime contractor and government customer. This is a remoterole based out of the Montgomery, AL area. This position requires an active Secret clearance at minimum.

The ICAM Migration Subject Matter Expert will serve as the primary technical director uniting access management and identity governance into a cohesive Zero Trust architecture. This position will design and execute high-throughput application onboarding lanes, leveraging automated DevSecOps deployment models to rapidly integrate legacy workloads across enterprise platforms like Okta and SailPoint without disrupting mission operations. By establishing standardized migration playbooks and coordinating specialized engineering teams, the role ensures that each transition strictly adheres to the client’s compliance and continuous authentication mandates. Ultimately, the ICAM Migration SME will act as the strategic cornerstone between technical execution and client leadership, accelerating the delivery of a secure, unified enterprise identity fabric at an unprecedented scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary technical authority for integrating access management and identity governance into a unified Zero Trust architecture across enterprise environments.
  • Design and execute scalable, high-throughput application onboarding and migration processes to integrate legacy and modern workloads with enterprise platforms such as Okta and SailPoint while minimizing mission disruption.
  • Implement automated migration pipelines and repeatable deployment workflows to accelerate application onboarding, configuration, testing, and production releases.
  • Develop and maintain standardized migration playbooks, technical procedures, validation criteria, and rollback plans to ensure consistent, secure, and repeatable ICAM transitions.
  • Coordinate engineers, application owners, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure teams, and client stakeholders to resolve migration dependencies, manage risks, and maintain delivery timelines.
  • Ensure all migrations meet client security policies, regulatory requirements, identity governance controls, least-privilege principles, and continuous authentication mandates.
  • Translate technical migration strategies, execution risks, and program milestones into actionable recommendations for client leadership, supporting informed decisions and enterprise-wide adoption.

Required Education and Experience:

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise ICAM Identity and Access Management and Authorization support for a federal customer
  • Okta Certified Consultant Certification
  • Active Secret Clearance or higher

Required Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), federation, and lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise identity platforms such as Okta and SailPoint, including application integrations, access policies, provisioning, governance workflows, and identity lifecycle processes.
  • Deep understanding of Zero Trust principles, least-privilege access, continuous authentication, privileged access controls, and enterprise identity security architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess legacy applications, resolve authentication and authorization dependencies, and execute complex enterprise migrations with minimal operational disruption.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), API integrations, scripting, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices using tools such as Git, Terraform, Python, or PowerShell.
  • Working knowledge of security control frameworks and compliance requirements, such as NIST SP 800-53, FICAM, and applicable FedRAMP or agency-specific mandates.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams, establish technical standards, manage migration risks, and communicate complex technical concepts to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to design repeatable onboarding processes, manage high-volume application migration backlogs, track delivery metrics, and maintain service availability throughout enterprise transitions.

Compensation Range:

$120,000 – 150,000. This represents the typical compensation range for this position based on experience, location, and other factors.

About VIATEQ

VIATEQ is a proactive provider of collaborative solutions for federal government agencies. Our collaborative service framework and flexibility allow employees, customers, and business partners to work together successfully anywhere, anytime. VIATEQ’s service areas also allow government agencies to respond to competitive pressures and achieve new performance levels.

VIATEQ offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, 11 paid federal holidays, flexible spending accounts, and a professional development reimbursement.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
